blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Establishing effective scaling laws for medical multimodal large language models (MLLMs) remains a persistent and fundamental challenge. Our systematic evaluation shows that existing medical MLLMs tend to underperform frontier general-purpose MLLMs across a range of medical tasks, while scaling model size primarily improves text capabilities rather than multimodal perception, and enabling reasoning modes fails to close this visual gap. To investigate how medical multimodal intelligence scales in practice, we introduce Sage-Med-Preview, a 35B-parameter medical multimodal model with 3B activated parameters, built by combining stage-specific curation over 322.7 million candidate records with a progressive training curriculum spanning medical pretraining, staged supervised fine-tuning, and adaptive reinforcement learning. Across this curriculum, progressive supervised refinement and adaptive reinforcement learning yield consistent stage-wise gains, substantially advancing both specialized visual understanding and medical language capabilities. Evaluated against 77 competing models across 238 clinical tasks spanning 61 public and 13 private multi-center benchmarks in more than 40 modalities, Sage-Med-Preview achieves an average score of 58.26% on the 31 public multimodal benchmarks. It outperforms the state-of-the-art open-source medical model Hulu-Med-235B-A22B at 50.99% and the general scientific model Intern-S2-Preview at 52.24%, and approaches the advanced proprietary model GPT-6.2-Sol across multiple tasks such as comprehensive multimodal understanding, report generation, and visual grounding. Although substantial challenges remain in complex medical reasoning and multi-step clinical workflows, this report provides empirical evidence, actionable data and training recipes, and a rigorous benchmark toward scalable clinical multimodal intelligence.
blocks.zh: 为医疗多模式大型语言模型制定有效的扩展法仍然是一项长期和根本的挑战。 我们的系统评价表明,现有的医疗MLLMs在一系列医疗任务中往往表现不佳,而模型规模的缩小主要提高了文本能力,而不是提高了多模式感知能力,使能推理模式无法弥合这一视觉差距。 为了调查医疗多模式情报的实际规模,我们引进了Sage-Med-Preview,一种35B参数医疗多模式,有3B活性参数,将3.227亿份候选记录与涵盖医疗预训、有监督地微调和适应性强化学习的渐进培训课程相结合。 在整个课程中,逐步进行有监督的完善和适应性强化学习,在阶段性上取得了一致的成果,大大地提高了专业视觉理解和医疗语言能力。 Sage-Med-Preview在超过40种模式的超过61个公共和13个私人多中心基准的238个临床任务中,与77个相互竞争的模式进行了评价,在31个公共多模式基准中平均得分达到58.26%。 它的性能超过了最先进的开源医学模型Hulu-Med-235B-A22B的50.99%和一般科学模型Intern-S2-Preview的52.24%,并接近了先进的专有模型GPT-6.2-Sol,跨越了综合多模式理解,报告生成,视觉地基等多个任务. 尽管在复杂的医疗推理和多步骤临床工作流程方面仍然存在重大挑战,但本报告提供了经验证据、可操作的数据和培训配方,以及可扩展临床多模式智能的严格基准。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Medical image interpretation is a rate-limiting step in diagnostic care. Diagnostic capacity is distributed far less evenly than disease burden: shortages of radiologists, pathologists and other diagnostic specialists are projected to widen through 2050, and are most acute in the low- and middle-income regions that already carry the heaviest burden [ 1 ] , so that the standard of interpretation a patient receives varies with where, and by whom, they are seen. Closing that gap requires more than assigning a label to an image: a clinically useful system must reach a judgement and express it in terms a colleague can act upon, placing perception and language within one model [ 2 , 3 ] . Where the input is text, this has largely been achieved: large language models encode clinical knowledge at expert level [ 4 , 5 ] and, once optimized for diagnostic dialogue, produce differential diagnoses more accurate than those of unassisted clinicians [ 6 , 7 ] . On images, capability has instead accumulated one specialty at a time, in retinal imaging [ 8 ] , dermatology [ 9 ] and computational pathology [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 ] , each model trained for a single specialty and adapted task by task rather than instructed in language across them. Medical multimodal large language models are intended to unite the two, and report broad gains across image and video tasks [ 15 , 16 , 17 ] . Efforts to organize their assessment around clinician-validated task taxonomies, however, have so far addressed text alone [ 18 , 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 医疗图像判读是诊断护理中限制费率的一个步骤. 诊断能力的分布远远低于疾病负担:预计到2050年,放射科医生、病理学家和其他诊断专家的短缺将扩大,在已经承担最重负担的中低收入地区最为严重[1],因此,病人得到的诊断标准随所见及由谁所见而有所不同。 缩小这一差距不仅需要给图像贴上标签:临床上有用的系统必须作出判断,并以同事可以采取行动的措辞表达,将认知和语言置于一个模式[2,3]。 在输入为文本的地方,这已基本实现:大型语言模型在专家一级编码临床知识[4,5],一旦优化用于诊断对话,产生比无援助临床医生更准确的差别诊断[6,7]. 在图像上,能力一次积累了一个专业,即视网膜成像[8]、皮肤病理学[9]和计算病理学[10-、11-、12-、13-、14],每个模型都接受了单一专业的培训,并按任务调整了任务,而不是用语言指导。 医疗多模式大型语言模型旨在将两者统一起来,并报告在图像和视频任务方面的广泛进展[15、16、17]。 然而,围绕临床医生认证的任务分类法组织评估的努力迄今仅涉及案文[18、19]。

blocks.en: Progress toward this unification has been rapid. Instruction tuning on image-caption pairs from the biomedical literature first allowed models to answer questions about medical images in natural language [ 20 , 21 ] . A single generalist model then reached competitive performance across radiography, pathology and dermatology [ 22 ] , and openly released medical model families showed this breadth to rest at least as much on the composition and curation of training data as on architecture [ 23 , 24 ] . Inputs have since widened from single two-dimensional images to volumetric scans, whole-slide images, procedural videos and serial examinations [ 25 , 26 , 27 , 28 ] ; outputs, from answers to localized findings and diagnostic reports, are judged by blinded radiologists rather than by benchmark score alone [ 29 , 28 ] . A smaller body of work places interpretation and synthesis in one model, over a narrow range of synthesis tasks, and finds the two mutually reinforcing [ 30 , 31 ] . These gains are uneven across modalities, tasks and settings, and rest on curated datasets under controlled conditions; where image and text are presented together, accuracy tracks the informativeness of the text rather than of the image [ 32 ] , so how much of a reported capability is read from the image at all is seldom established. No such system is yet in routine diagnostic use, and what these models can be relied upon to do across a diagnostic pathway, and where that reliability ends, remains undrawn.
blocks.zh: 实现统一的进展是迅速的。 关于生物医学文献中图像-封装对的指令调试首先使模型能够用自然语言回答关于医疗图像的问题[20,21]. 然后,一个单一的通论模型在射线学、病理学和皮肤学方面都取得了竞争性表现[22],并公开发布了医学模型家庭,显示了这种宽度至少与建筑学培训数据的构成和校准相同。 自此,投入从单二维图像拓宽到卷片扫描,全平面图像,程序视频和连环检查[25,26,27,28];产出从答案到局部发现和诊断报告,都由失明的放射学家判断,而不只是根据基准分数[29,28]. 较小的一组工作将解释和合成放在一个模型中,在范围狭窄的合成任务上,并发现两者相辅相成[30,31]. 这些收益在模式、任务和设置上是不均衡的,而依赖于在受控条件下整理的数据集;如果图像和文本一起显示,准确性跟踪文本而不是图像的信息性[32],因此很少确定从图像中读取多少报告的能力。 目前还没有这种系统在常规诊断中使用,这些模型可以依靠它来跨越诊断路径,在可靠性结束的地方,这些模型仍然无法使用。

blocks.en: Establishing effective scaling principles for medical MLLMs presents three challenges: (1) limited data (high-quality medical image-text supervision remains scarce and unevenly distributed across specialties, modalities and conditions, while expert curation is costly; expanding training corpora therefore requires maintaining clinical accuracy and diversity as data volume increases [ 23 ] ); (2) effective adaptation (general-purpose vision-language models provide a strong foundation, but translating heterogeneous medical data into specialist capabilities requires careful coordination of visual-language alignment, clinical knowledge acquisition and instruction learning; how to compose and sequence these training signals while preserving general capabilities remains an open design problem [ 23 , 33 ] ); and (3) rigorous evaluation (widely used benchmarks often assess isolated image-question pairs or examination-style cases, incompletely representing clinical workflows that require gathering information, integrating imaging with patient context and making sequential decisions [ 34 , 35 , 19 ] ; documented quality defects include erroneous reference answers and questions answerable without inspecting the image [ 36 ] , while overlap between training corpora and publicly available test data introduces a risk of contamination [ 36 , 33 ] ). Addressing these challenges requires scalable data curation, training strategies that integrate complementary sources of medical supervision, and rigorous evaluation grounded in clinical practice.
blocks.zh: 制定医疗MLLMs的有效缩放原则提出了三个挑战:(1) 数据有限(高质量的医疗图像文本监督仍然稀缺,在专业、模式和条件上分布不均,而专家审校费用高昂;因此,随着数据量的增加,扩大培训公司需要保持临床准确性和多样性[23]);(2) 有效的适应(通用视觉语言模型提供了一个坚实的基础,但将多种多样的医疗数据转化为专家能力需要仔细协调视觉语言的校正、临床知识获取和教学;如何在保持一般能力的同时对这些培训信号进行编译和排序仍然是一个开放的设计问题[23、33];(3) 严格的评价(广泛使用的基准往往评估孤立的图像问题对子或检查式案例,不完全代表临床工作流程,需要收集信息,将成像与病人的情况相融合,并作出相继决定[34、35、19];记录的质量缺陷包括错误的参考答案和问题,无需检查图像[36],而培训公司和公开提供的测试数据重叠带来污染风险[36、33]。 应对这些挑战需要可扩展的数据校正、整合医疗监督补充来源的培训战略以及基于临床实践的严格评价。

blocks.en: Here we investigate how medical multimodal large language models scale in practice and how well the resulting capabilities generalize across specialties and clinical settings. We introduce Sage-Med-Preview, a 35B-parameter medical multimodal model with 3B activated parameters initialized from Intern-S2-Preview, built by combining stage-specific data curation with a progressive training curriculum spanning medical pretraining, staged supervised fine-tuning, and adaptive reinforcement learning. We evaluate Sage-Med-Preview systematically across public benchmarks and multi-center clinical datasets. Our main contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 在这里,我们调查医学多模式的大型语言模型在实践中的规模,以及由此产生的能力在专业和临床环境中的普及程度。 我们引入了Sage-Med-Preview,一种35B参数的医疗多模式模型,由Intern-S2-Preview初始化的3B活性参数,通过将阶段特定数据解析与涵盖医学预训、有监督地微调和适应性强化学习的渐进式培训课程相结合而建立。 我们系统评价Sage-Med-Preview在公共基准和多中心临床数据集上. 我们的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: • Scalable medical data curation. We assemble 322.7 million stage-indexed candidate records from over 200 public datasets, over 120 million biomedical literature records derived from 25 million source documents (including PDF documents, books and web pages), and more than 100 private resources. The resulting pool comprises 233.8 million multimodal and 88.9 million text-only records. Through source-aware evidence organization and three stage-specific six-step curation pathways, we construct filtered pools of approximately 93.8 million records for pretraining, 69.6 million for supervised fine-tuning, and 0.3 million for reinforcement learning, spanning 51 fine-grained modality and 31 anatomical categories. We document the composition of each candidate pool, stage-wise retention after filtering, and the data mixtures used for training. • Progressive medical multimodal alignment. We develop a curriculum combining continual pretraining on 83.8 million records and task-oriented mid-training on 28.1 million records, three-stage progressive supervised fine-tuning, and adaptive reinforcement learning with policy-conditioned difficulty sampling and independent reference replay, while retaining general-purpose supervision throughout specialization. Medical pretraining builds medical knowledge and visual–semantic alignment. The three fine-tuning stages then establish instruction alignment, broaden task coverage and refine reasoning-intensive tasks. Adaptive reinforcement learning finally focuses on tasks of informative difficulty and anchors updates to reference answers. • Comprehensive evaluation. We evaluate Sage-Med-Preview alongside 77 general-purpose and medical models, comprising 68 open-source and nine proprietary models, on 238 clinical tasks from 61 public benchmarks and 13 private multi-center benchmarks contributed by 14 hospitals and institutions, covering more than 40 modalities under unified test splits and standardized scoring protocols. On the 31 public multimodal benchmarks, this evaluation shows that existing medical MLLMs still trail general-purpose MLLMs on 29 of them, which indicates that domain-specific training alone has not yet closed the gap to general foundation models. Sage-Med-Preview narrows this gap: it leads all open-source models on the same 31 benchmarks with an average of 58.26%, and it outperforms the proprietary GPT-6.2-Sol in comprehensive multimodal understanding and report generation while performing comparably in visual grounding. This advantage also holds beyond public data. On the private multi-center benchmarks, Sage-Med-Preview is the strongest of all evaluated models, averaging 57.72% against 51.24% for GPT-6.2-Sol.
blocks.zh: • 可扩展的医疗数据校正。 我们收集了来自200多套公共数据集的3.227亿份阶段索引候选记录、来自2 500万份原始文件(包括PDF文件、书籍和网页)的1.2亿多份生物医学文献记录以及100多份私人资源。 由此形成的集合包括2.338亿多式和8 890万只文本记录。 通过来源意识证据组织和三个阶段特定的六步校正路径,我们建造了大约9 380万份预训记录、6 960万份监督微调记录和30万份强化学习记录的过滤池,跨越51个精细模式和31个解剖类别。 我们记录每个候选人才库的构成、过滤后分阶段保留的情况以及用于培训的数据混合物。 • 逐步调整医疗多式联运。 我们制定了课程,将8 380万份记录的连续预训和2 810万份记录的面向任务的中期培训、三阶段的渐进式监督微调、适应性强化学习与政策条件下的困难取样和独立参考重放结合起来,同时在整个专业中保留普通用途监督。 医学预训培养出医学知识和视觉-语义结合. 随后,三个微调阶段建立指令对接,扩大任务覆盖面并完善推理密集型任务. 适应性强化学习最终侧重于信息化难度的任务,并锁定了参考答案的更新. • 综合评价。 我们评价Sage-Med-Preview与77个通用模型和医疗模型,包括68个开源模型和9个专有模型,对来自61个公共基准和14所医院和机构提供的13个私人多中心基准的238个临床任务进行评估,这些基准涵盖统一测试分拆和标准化评分规程下的40多个模式。 关于31项公共多模式基准,本评价显示,现有的医疗性最低水平最低水平最低水平最低水平最低水平最低水平最低水平最低水平最低水平最高的有29项,这表明,仅针对特定领域的培训还没有弥补与一般基础模式的差距。 Sage-Med-Preview缩小了这一差距:它以平均58.26%的相同31个基准引导所有开源模型,在综合多模式理解和报告生成中,它的表现超过了专有的GPT-6.2-Sol,同时在视觉地平面上进行相仿. 这一优势也超出了公共数据的范围。 在私人多中心基准上,Sage-Med-Preview是所有被评价模型中最强的,平均57.72%,而GPT-6-Sol为51.24%.
