blocks.en: 2 Sage-Med-Preview
blocks.zh: 2 Sage-Med-Preview (英语).

blocks.en: 2.1 Scaling Medical Training Data to over 300 Million Candidate Records
blocks.zh: 2.1 将医疗培训数据扩大到3亿多份候选人记录

blocks.en:
Recent medical vision–language foundation models, including MedGemma, Lingshu, Hulu-Med and ClinFusion, have demonstrated the value of combining medical images, biomedical knowledge and task-oriented supervision [ 24 , 23 , 27 , 28 ] .
Scaling these resources requires preserving evidence across heterogeneous source formats and matching supervision to distinct training objectives, as data composition and quality shape the utility of additional training data [ 37 , 38 ] .
We therefore combined source-aware evidence organization with stage-specific curation to assemble approximately 322.7 million stage-indexed candidate records: 232.8 million for the pretraining (PT) family, 87.4 million for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and 2.5 million for reinforcement learning (RL) (Fig. 3 b).
The inventory contains approximately 233.8 million multimodal and 88.9 million text-only records.
These counts describe candidates before stage-specific filtering, rather than the records used in individual training stages.
Record definitions and inventory accounting are detailed in Supplementary Section S1.1 .
blocks.zh:
最近的医疗视觉-语言基础模型,包括MedGemma、Lingshu、Hulu-Med和ClinFusion,都证明了结合医疗影像、生物医学知识和以任务为导向的监督[24、23、27、28]的价值。
扩大这些资源需要保留不同来源格式的证据,并将监督与不同的培训目标相匹配,因为数据组成和质量决定了额外培训数据的效用[37、38]。
因此,我们把了解来源的证据组织与具体阶段的校正结合起来,收集了大约3.227亿份有阶段索引的候选人记录:23.280万份用于预训家庭,8 740万份用于监督微调(SFT)和250万份用于强化学习(RL)(图3b)。
库存包括约2.338亿多式和8 890万只文本记录。
这些计数描述的是具体阶段筛选之前的候选人,而不是个别培训阶段所用的记录。
记录定义和清单核算详见补充部分S1.1.。

blocks.en: 2.1.1 Data Collection and Source Organization
blocks.zh: 2.1.1 数据收集和来源组织

blocks.en:
We integrated more than 200 public medical datasets, over 120 million biomedical literature records derived from 25 million source documents (including PDF documents, books and web pages), and more than 100 private data resources, spanning image–text pairs, task collections and specialty imaging resources.
As summarized in Fig. 3 a, public resources and private corpora were processed through document extraction or dataset integration according to their source structure.
For PDF documents and web page files, MinerU [ 39 ] extracted text and figures.
Existing multimodal collections were standardized by checking media references and image–text pairing structure, normalizing metadata, and preserving available annotations and source context.
Text-only and task-oriented resources were organized while retaining available references, source links and supervision targets.
Modality, anatomical and medical-concept metadata were retained where available, supporting subsequent record selection and coverage analysis.
blocks.zh:
我们整合了200多套公共医疗数据集、来自2500万份原始文件(包括PDF文件、书籍和网页)的1.2亿多份生物医学文献记录,以及100多份私人数据资源,它们跨越图像-文本对、任务收集以及特殊成像资源。
如图3a所概述,公共资源和私人公司是通过文件提取或数据集整合根据其来源结构处理的。
对于PDF文件和网页文件,MinerU[39]取出文本和数字.
通过检查媒体参考文献和图像文本配对结构,使元数据正常化,以及保留现有说明和源上下文,使现有的多式收藏标准化。
在保留现有参考资料、源链接和监督目标的同时,还安排了仅以文字和任务为导向的资源。
模式、解剖学和医学概念元数据(如果有的话)被保留下来,支持随后的记录选择和覆盖面分析。

blocks.en:
The two processing routes converged on source-linked evidence: extracted figures were associated with their original legends, in-text references and relevant surrounding passages, whereas standardized dataset records retained their accompanying text, annotations and available source context (Fig. 3 a).
This evidence supported three curation operations: retaining usable supervision, refining deficient descriptions or responses, and synthesizing additional tasks supported by the source material.
The resulting supervision was organized into four groups: image descriptions, question answering and reasoning, report generation, and visual grounding.
Report supervision preserved available section structure, such as clinical history, findings and impression, while grounding required appropriate localization references or annotations.
Source links were preserved throughout processing, allowing revised and synthesized targets to be checked against the available evidence during stage-specific filtering.
Further details on evidence organization and supervision construction are provided in Supplementary Section S1.2 .
blocks.zh:
两条处理路线在与源相关联的证据上趋同:取出的数字与其原始传说,文字参考和相邻相关段落相关,而标准化的数据集记录则保留了相伴随的文本,说明和可用源上下文(图3 a).
这一证据支持了三项管理行动:保留可用的监督,完善不充分的说明或答复,以及综合来源材料支持的额外任务。
由此产生的监督分为四组:图像描述、问答和推理、报告生成和视觉地面。
报告监督保留了现有的部分结构,如临床历史、发现和印象,而基础需要适当的本地化参考或说明。
在整个处理过程中都保留了源链接,从而能够在具体阶段的过滤过程中,根据现有证据检查修订和综合的目标。
关于证据组织和监督建筑的进一步详情见补充部分S1.2.。

blocks.en: 2.1.2 Stage-specific Data Filtering
blocks.zh: 2.1.2 特定阶段的数据过滤

blocks.en:
The organized records and their source evidence supported three distinct six-stage curation pathways (Fig. 3 c).
PT emphasized medically relevant content and reliable image–text associations, SFT required accurate instruction–response demonstrations, and RL required reliable evaluation targets and informative model outcomes.
Each pathway combined exclusion with the applicable revision, verification and routing operations.
Intermediate and retained-pool counts in the figure are illustrative estimates; stage-wise accounting is provided in Supplementary Table S2 .
blocks.zh:
有组织的记录及其原始证据支持了三个不同的六阶段管理途径(图3c)。
PT强调医学相关内容和可靠的图像-文本协会,SFT要求准确的指令-反应演示,RL要求可靠的评价目标和信息化的模型结果.
每条途径都与适用的修订、核查和路线操作相结合。
图中的中间数和保留库数为说明性估计数;补充表S2提供了分阶段核算。

blocks.en:
The PT pathway processed 232.8 million candidate records.
First, visual and textual usability checks assessed media accessibility, content readability and record completeness to exclude unusable inputs.
Second, medical-content selection retained material relevant to medical or biomedical learning, removing accessible but out-of-domain content.
Third, textual and visual deduplication identified repeated and near-identical records to limit redundant supervision, using MinHash-based text retrieval and image difference hashing.
Fourth, image–text consistency assessment checked whether paired descriptions agreed with the associated images and available source context, identifying mismatches and unsupported claims.
Fifth, caption rewriting and rechecking addressed descriptions that were incomplete, repetitive or weakly aligned but could be improved using the image, original legend and linked passages.
Adequate descriptions were retained unchanged, and revised targets were verified against the source evidence.
Sixth, image-quality assessment examined clarity, exposure, contrast, noise and artifacts using modality-specific criteria to exclude images whose degradation compromised interpretation.
Text-only records underwent the applicable textual checks and bypassed image-dependent assessments.
The pathway is summarized by an estimated retained pool of 93.8 million records.
Selection criteria, duplicate detection and caption refinement are detailed in Supplementary Section S1.3 .
blocks.zh:
PT路径处理2.328亿候选人记录.
首先,视觉和文字可用性检查评估了媒体的可访问性、内容可读性和记录完整性,以排除无法使用的投入。
第二,医疗内容选择保留了与医学或生物医学学习相关的材料,删除了无障碍但领域外的内容。
第三,文字和视觉分解确定了重复和近似相同的记录,以限制冗余监督,使用基于MinHash的文本检索和图像差异散开。
第四,图像-文本一致性评估检查了配对描述是否与相关图像和可用源上下文一致,找出不匹配和无支持的索赔。
第五,标题重写和重新检查涉及的描述不完整、重复或弱等同,但可以利用图像、原始传说和链接段落加以改进。
适当说明保持不变,并根据来源证据核实了订正目标。
第六,图像质量评估利用特定模式的标准,检查清晰度、曝光度、对比度、噪音和文物,以排除其退化会影响解释的图像。
只有文字记录经过了适用的文字检查,并绕过以图像为基础的评估。
估计共有9 380万份记录,总结了这一途径。
甄选标准、重复检测和说明的改进详见补充部分S1.3.。

blocks.en:
The SFT pathway processed 87.4 million candidate instruction–response records.
First, rule-based screening checked required fields, conversation structure, media references and non-empty targets to establish valid training instances.
Second, deduplication removed repeated instruction instances to limit redundant demonstrations.
Third, language-model-assisted quality scoring assessed medical accuracy, instruction relevance, completeness, logical consistency and evidential support to screen the overall quality of each demonstration.
The main scoring branch required a score of at least 3 on a five-point scale, with source-specific acceptance rules applied in other branches.
Fourth, length and format checks assessed whether responses met the task’s length and output requirements, including the required answer representation and structure.
Fifth, task and reasoning verification assessed substantive correctness: direct answers were compared with reference targets, structured outputs with required fields, and image-grounded claims with visual evidence or annotations.
Explicit reasoning was checked for internal consistency and support for intermediate claims.
Sixth, retained-pool consolidation assembled accepted records into a common instruction pool for subsequent curriculum selection.
The pathway is summarized by an estimated retained pool of 69.6 million records.
Scoring criteria and task-verification procedures are provided in Supplementary Section S1.4 .
blocks.zh:
SFT路径处理了8 740万份候选说明 - 答复记录。
首先,基于规则的筛选检查所需的字段、对话结构、媒体参考和非空目标,以建立有效的培训实例。
第二,调试取消了重复指令,以限制多余的示威。
第三,语言模型辅助质量评分评估了医疗准确性、教学相关性、完整性、逻辑一致性和证据支持,以筛选每个演示的整体质量。
主得分分分会要求分数在五分制上至少为三分,其他会分会适用特定来源的接受规则.
第四,长度和格式检查评估了答复是否符合任务的长度和产出要求,包括所需的答复说明和结构。
第五,任务和推理核查评估了实质性正确性:将直接答复与参考目标进行比较,将结构化产出与所需字段进行比较,将图像依据的索赔与视觉证据或说明进行比较。
对内部一致性和中间索赔的支持进行了明确论证。
第六,保留库合并将已接受的记录汇编成一个共同的教学库,以便随后选择课程。
估计保留了6 960万份记录,总结了路径。
S1.4. 补充部分规定了计分标准和任务核查程序。

blocks.en:
The RL pathway processed 2.5 million candidate records.
First, prompt and schema checks established valid task specifications and input fields so that candidates could be presented and evaluated consistently.
Second, task typing assigned the appropriate task family and evaluator, accounting for differences between closed-answer, open-ended and spatial outputs.
Third, reference validation checked evaluation targets against original annotations or supporting source evidence, including numerical units, clinically important findings and spatial references where applicable.
This step established the evaluation basis before model performance was used to estimate difficulty.
Fourth, blind rollouts and task evaluation measured model performance.
The answering model received task inputs without reference targets, which were available only to the evaluator.
In the closed-answer branch, eight responses per prompt provided an initial estimate of model-relative difficulty.
Fifth, difficulty-based routing prioritized prompts with two to six correct responses, favouring tasks on which the model could succeed but remained inconsistent.
Other success-rate groups were routed to further selection, review or capability retention.
Sixth, semantic checks and replay routing assessed agreement with reference conclusions and supporting evidence, complementing the earlier task evaluation.
Grounding retained task-specific spatial verification, and eligible records were assigned to RL task families or supervised replay.
These offline assessments established the initial candidate selection and routing before RL optimization.
The figure summarizes the pathway with an estimated retained pool of approximately 0.3 million records.
Reference validation, task-specific evaluators and routing rules are detailed in Supplementary Table S7 and Supplementary Section S1.5 .
blocks.zh:
RL路径处理了250万候选人记录。
首先,迅速和有计划地进行检查,确定有效的任务规格和输入字段,以便能一致地介绍和评价候选人。
第二,任务打字指定了适当的任务家族和评估者,说明闭门回答、开放式产出和空间产出之间的差异。
第三,参考证明对照原始说明或佐证来源证据,包括数值单位、临床上重要的发现和适用的空间参考,核对了评价目标。
这一步骤在使用模型业绩来估计困难之前就确定了评价的基础。
第四,盲目推出和任务评价衡量模型性能.
答复模式得到的任务投入没有参考目标,只提供给评价人员。
在闭门回答处,每个快件有8个答复提供了模型相对难度的初步估计.
第五,基于困难的路由安排有2至6个正确响应的提示,倾向于该模式能够取得成功但不一致的任务。
其他成功率高的团体被安排到进一步挑选、审查或保留能力。
第六,语义检查和重放评估的路由协议,附有参考结论和佐证证据,补充了先前的任务评价.
对保留的任务进行空间核查,并将合格记录分配给RL任务家庭或监督重播。
这些离线评估在RL优化前确定了初步候选人甄选和路线.
该数字汇总了路径,估计保留了约30万个记录。
参考证明、特定任务评价员和路线规则详见补充表S7和补充表S1.5.

blocks.en:
After filtering, the annotated image-reference subset of the curated multimodal data spans 15 modality groups (Fig. 3 d) and 10 anatomical categories (Fig. 3 f).
Coverage is broad but uneven, with pathology, MRI and CT the most prevalent modality groups, and head and neck, thorax and abdomen/pelvis the most frequent anatomical categories.
Complementary t-distributed stochastic neighbor embedding (t-SNE) projections visualize local structure in sampled image representations, coloured by modality (Fig. 3 e) and anatomical category (Fig. 3 g).
Category mappings and analysis procedures are detailed in Supplementary Section S1.6 .
The retained pools provide candidates for subsequent training-stage allocation, with selected record counts reported separately in Supplementary Section S1.7 and Supplementary Table S11 .
blocks.zh:
在过滤后,被整理的多式数据的附加注释的图像参考子集跨越了15个模式组(图3d)和10个解剖类(图3f).
覆盖范围广泛但不均衡,病理、核磁共振和CT是最常见的模式组,头部和颈部、胸腺和腹部/骨盆是最常见的解剖类别。
互补的t-分布相邻嵌入(t-SNE)可视化地将局部结构在被取样的图像表示中,以模式(图3 e)和解剖类(图3克)为颜色.
分类绘图和分析程序详见补充部分S1.6.
保留人才库为以后的培训阶段分配提供了候选人,选定的记录数在补充部分S1.7和补充表S-11中分别报告。

blocks.en: 2.2 Model Architecture and Training
blocks.zh: 2.2 示范建筑和培训

blocks.en:
Sage-Med was initialized from Intern-S2-Preview, a 35-billion-parameter scientific multimodal foundation model [ 40 ] .
We organized training into medical adaptation, progressive supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and adaptive reinforcement learning (RL), progressively shifting the emphasis from medical knowledge and visual–semantic alignment to instruction following and reward-guided policy refinement (Fig. 2 c).
Medical adaptation combined continual pretraining with task-oriented mid-training.
Three successive SFT stages then expanded medical instruction coverage and selectively introduced more demanding supervision, while retaining examples from earlier stages.
Finally, adaptive RL allocated rollouts according to the evolving policy, alongside independent reference supervision on medical and general-purpose tasks.
blocks.zh:
Sage-Med由Intern-S2-Preview(英语:Intern-S2-Preview)初始化而来,这是350亿参数的科学多模式基础模型 [40].
我们组织了医疗适应、渐进式监督微调(SFT)和适应性强化学习(RL)方面的培训,逐步将重点从医疗知识和视觉-语义调整转向遵循和奖励性政策完善(图2c)的指导。
医学适应将持续的预训与面向任务的中期培训相结合。
随后连续三个SFT阶段扩大了医疗指导覆盖面,并有选择地引入了更严格的监督,同时保留了早期的例子.
最后,根据不断演变的政策,在对医疗和普通用途任务进行独立参考监督的同时,还分配了适应性RL。

blocks.en: 2.2.1 Medical Multimodal Knowledge Pretraining
blocks.zh: 2.2.1 医疗多式联运知识

blocks.en:
Continual pretraining used 83.8 million records comprising medical image–text pairs, document-derived evidence, textual medical knowledge and supplementary scientific content.
These records were assembled through the source integration and stage-specific filtering procedures described in Section 2.1.2 .
Image-associated text provided supervision linking visual content to medical descriptions and concepts, whereas text-only records extended coverage of medical terminology and knowledge.
This stage provided broad medical-domain exposure before the introduction of more task-oriented training mixtures.
blocks.zh:
连续的预训使用了8,380万份记录,包括医疗图像-文本对、文件证据、文本医学知识和补充科学内容。
这些记录是通过第2.1.2节所述源集成和特定阶段的过滤程序收集的。
图像相关文本提供监督,将视觉内容与医疗说明和概念联系起来,而仅文本记录则扩大了医疗术语和知识的范围。
这一阶段在采用更注重任务的培训混合物之前,提供了广泛的医疗领域接触。

blocks.en:
Mid-training used 28.1 million records to introduce task structure alongside continued medical and scientific supervision.
The mixture combined medical task data and knowledge-and-reasoning examples with sampled pretraining records and general scientific examples.
Question–response formats increased the emphasis on using knowledge to address explicit requests, while the retained pretraining material maintained broader content coverage.
The transition from continual pretraining to mid-training therefore shifted the data mixture towards task-oriented learning before the subsequent SFT curriculum.
blocks.zh:
中级培训利用2 810万份记录,在继续进行医疗和科学监督的同时引入任务结构。
该混合物结合了医疗任务数据和知识与理性范例,以及抽样培训前记录和一般科学实例。
问题-答复格式更加强调利用知识处理明确的请求,而保留的培训前材料则保持更广泛的内容覆盖面。
因此,从连续的预训到中训的过渡,将数据组合转移到了随后的SFT课程之前面向任务的学习上.

blocks.en: 2.2.2 Progressive Supervised Fine-tuning
blocks.zh: 2.2.2 逐步监督的微调

blocks.en:
Progressive SFT organized medical instruction learning around three successive priorities: instruction alignment, task diversification and selective refinement (Fig. 2 c).
The curriculum established coverage of medical requests and response formats, expanded image-conditioned tasks, and then introduced targeted supervision for difficult examples and explicit reasoning.
Medical and general-purpose supervision were retained across stages, with selected earlier-stage examples incorporated into later mixtures.
The reported stage sizes describe complete training mixtures, including replay, and are not mutually exclusive sample counts.
blocks.zh:
渐进式SFT围绕三个连续的优先事项组织医学教学:教学协调、任务多样化和选择性改进(图2c)。
课程规定了医疗请求和反应格式的覆盖范围,扩大了以形象为条件的任务,然后对困难的例子和明确的理由进行了有针对性的监督。
医疗和普通用途监督在各阶段得到保留,一些较早的例子被纳入以后的混合物中。
所报告的阶段尺寸描述的是完整的训练混合物,包括回放,而不是相互排斥的样本数。

blocks.en:
Stage 1 used 6.1 million records to align medical responses with explicit instructions across text-only, single-image and multi-image inputs.
Medical question answering, report generation, visual grounding and selected reasoning tasks linked medical knowledge and visual evidence to different response requirements.
The length-stratified medical subset contained approximately 25% short (up to 64 characters), 50% medium-length (65–512 characters) and 25% long (more than 512 characters) reference responses, providing supervision across different levels of response detail.
Focused questions were paired with concise answers, whereas explanatory tasks supplied more extended responses; conversational examples additionally supervised the use of context across turns.
General-purpose examples complemented these medical tasks with broader instruction-following supervision.
Together, these components established initial coverage of task-appropriate answers, explanations and interactions for the subsequent expansion of multimodal tasks.
blocks.zh:
第一阶段使用610万份记录,使医疗反应与文字、单一图像和多图像输入的明确说明保持一致。
医疗问题回答,报告生成,可视化地定位和有选择的推理任务将医疗知识和可视化证据与不同的响应要求联系起来.
长度平分的医疗子集包含约25%的短(最多64个字符),50%的中长(65-512个字符)和25%的长(超过512个字符)的参考响应,为不同级别的反应细节提供监督.
重点问题与简明的答案搭配在一起,而解释性任务则提供了更详尽的答复;对话的例子还监督了背景跨度的使用。
通用实例补充了这些医疗任务,提供了更广泛的指导监督。
这些组成部分共同确定了与任务相适应的答案、解释和互动的初步范围,以便随后扩大多式联运任务。

blocks.en:
Stage 2 used 9.6 million records to broaden image-conditioned instruction learning through additional medical visual tasks and task collections.
The mixture comprised approximately 60% multimodal and 40% text-only records, combining expanded visual-task supervision with continued text-based instruction learning.
Visual tasks required image content to be used according to the request, with reference outputs ranging from focused answers and localization outputs to longer medical descriptions.
Medical text and general-purpose examples complemented this supervision with knowledge-based responses and broader instructions.
A dedicated Stage 1 replay component accounted for approximately 1.6% of the complete mixture, retaining supervision on selected earlier tasks and response formats as additional task collections were introduced.
This stage thus broadened medical visual-task coverage while continuing to train on textual instructions and previously introduced requests.
blocks.zh:
第2阶段使用960万个记录,通过增加医疗视觉任务和任务收集,来扩大图像化教学。
该混合物包括大约60%的多式记录和40%的只用文本的记录,将扩大的视觉任务监督与持续的以文本为基础的教学相结合。
视觉任务需要根据请求使用图像内容,参考产出从重点答案和本地化产出到较长的医学描述不等.
医疗文本和一般用途实例以基于知识的对策和更广泛的指示来补充这种监督。
专门的第一阶段重放部分约占全部混合物的1.6%,随着额外任务收集的引入,保留了对先前选定任务和反应格式的监督。
因此,这一阶段扩大了医疗视觉任务覆盖面,同时继续就文字说明进行培训,并以前提出过请求。

blocks.en:
Stage 3 used 6.2 million records to combine targeted supervision for difficult tasks and explicit reasoning with broader medical instruction learning.
The mixture comprised approximately 53% multimodal and 47% text-only records, retaining substantial coverage of both image-conditioned and textual tasks.
Dedicated difficult-example and chain-of-thought pools accounted for approximately 8.5% and 13% of the complete mixture, respectively.
The former concentrated supervision on selected challenging questions, whereas the latter provided intermediate reasoning steps alongside final answers.
A separate replay component from Stages 1 and 2 contributed approximately 7%, maintaining supervision on earlier tasks alongside broader medical and general-purpose examples.
Direct-answer examples remained part of the mixture, so explicit reasoning supervision was accompanied by continued training on concise responses.
The final stage therefore introduced targeted refinement across input modalities while retaining a wider range of tasks and response requirements.
blocks.zh:
第3阶段使用了620万份记录,将针对困难任务的定向监督和明确推理与更广泛的医学教学结合起来。
混合体包括约53%的多式记录和47%的只用文字的记录,保留了大量图像和文字任务。
专用的、困难的和有思维的池分别占全部混合物的8.5%和13%。
前者集中监督选定的有挑战性的问题,而后者则在提供最后答案的同时提供中间推理步骤。
第1阶段和第2阶段的一个单独的重播部分贡献了大约7%,与更广泛的医疗和一般用途实例一起维持对以前各项工作的监督。
直接回答的例子仍然是混合体的一部分,因此,在进行明确的推理监督的同时,还继续提供关于简明答复的培训。
因此,最后阶段对投入模式进行了有针对性的改进,同时保留了更广泛的任务和应对要求。

blocks.en: 2.2.3 Adaptive Reinforcement Learning
blocks.zh: 2.2.3 适应性强化学习

blocks.en:
RL extended reference-based instruction learning through task-specific reward feedback, using group relative policy optimization (GRPO) [ 41 ] .
The framework combined policy-dependent difficulty assessment, task-specific rewards and adaptive sampling with independent reference replay (Fig. 2 c).
The RL and replay pools each comprised 80% multimodal and 20% text-only examples.
Within RL, the task-design quotas were 85% closed-form and 15% open-ended tasks.
Initial policy-based assessment classified 14.98% of the assessed prompts as difficult, 73.37% as intermediate or inconsistently solved, and 11.65% as relatively easy.
blocks.zh:
RL通过针对特定任务的奖励反馈,利用群体相对政策优化(GRPO)[41].
该框架将政策依赖性难度评估、任务特定奖励和适应性抽样与独立参考重放结合起来(图2c)。
RL和重放集合各由80%的多式和20%的文本独行实例组成。
在RL内,任务设计配额为85%的封闭式和15%的开放式任务.
初步政策评估将14.98%的评测提示列为难解,73.37%为中间或不一致解答,11.65%为相对容易解答.

blocks.en:
Because prompt difficulty changes as the policy learns, we initialized difficulty estimates from responses generated by the SFT checkpoint and updated them using fresh rollouts during RL.
Evaluation followed the supervision available for each task.
For closed-form tasks, task-specific verifiers compared responses with reference targets, providing correctness observations for estimating prompt-level success rates.
For open-ended tasks, including report generation and explanatory responses, a fixed judge applied task-specific rubrics using reference answers and available supporting evidence.
These rubrics assessed medical content and evidence agreement, including clinically consequential errors where applicable.
Verifier outcomes and rubric scores provided task-specific reward feedback and informed subsequent sampling updates.
For difficulty tracking, these assessments were kept separate from auxiliary reward components, so that formatting improvements alone did not indicate improved medical correctness.
blocks.zh:
因为随着政策学习的迅速困难变化,我们从SFT检查站生成的响应中初始化了困难估计,并在RL期间使用新的推出来更新.
评价是在对每项任务进行监督之后进行的。
对于封闭式任务,特定任务的核查人员将答复与参考目标进行比较,为估计速率水平的成功率提供正确的观察。
对于开放式任务,包括报告生成和解释性答复,一名固定法官利用参考答案和现有证据应用了特定任务的标题。
这些主题评估了医疗内容和证据协议,包括酌情评估临床结果错误。
验证结果和分数提供了针对特定任务的奖励反馈,并提供了随后的抽样更新信息。
由于难以跟踪,这些评估与辅助奖励部分分开,因此,单是格式上的改进并不能表明医疗的正确性有所改善。

blocks.en:
Sampling priorities reflected the training signal available under the current policy.
For closed-form tasks, smoothed success estimates were used to estimate the probability of obtaining both correct and incorrect responses within a rollout group.
For open-ended tasks, priorities reflected within-group variation in rubric scores after accounting for judge variability, with uniform sampling retained when reliable calibration was unavailable.
Priorities were updated within the four categories defined by multimodal/text-only inputs and closed-form/open-ended tasks, subject to cumulative coverage quotas.
Exposure-based downweighting reduced repeated concentration on individual prompts, while a uniform exploration component maintained a non-zero sampling probability for each prompt.
Alongside this adaptive RL stream, independent reference replay supplied teacher-forced supervision on reference responses sampled from a separate distribution.
Replay remained outside the adaptive RL sampler and did not inherit its sampling weights.
The replay loss was combined with the GRPO loss to update the same policy, maintaining direct reference-based supervision as RL sampling priorities evolved.
blocks.zh:
抽样优先事项反映了现行政策下提供的培训信号。
对于封闭式任务,采用平滑的成功估计数来估计在推出组内获得正确和不正确答复的可能性。
对于没有期限的任务,优先次序在计算法官的可变性后,在数字分数上反映组内的差异,在无法可靠校正时,则保留统一的抽样。
优先事项在多式联运/仅限文本的投入和封闭式/开放式任务确定的四类范围内得到更新,但须遵守累积的覆盖配额。
以接触为基础的减重降低了单个喷出物的重复浓度,而统一的勘探成分则保持了每个喷出物的非零采样概率。
除了这种适应性的RL流外,独立参考重放为教师提供了对从单独分布中抽取的参考答复的监督。
重放仍留在适应性RL采样器外,没有继承其取样权重.
重播损失与GRPO损失相结合,以更新同样的政策,随着RL取样重点的演变,保持直接基于参考的监督.

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Evaluation Settings
blocks.zh: 3.1 评价设置

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Benchmarking on 70+ LLMs and MLLMs
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 70+法学硕士和硕士学位硕士的基准

blocks.en:
The core evaluation compares Sage-Med-Preview with 77 LLMs and MLLMs. These models cover the general and medical domains and include 68 open-source and nine proprietary models. By model type, they span autoregressive LLMs and MLLMs, diffusion large language models, and unified understanding–generation models. SDAR-Chat, Lumina-DiMOO, and MMaDA-Base are diffusion large language models, and all other open-source models are autoregressive models. Model sizes range from 0.182B parameters for BiomedGPT to 1T total parameters for Intern-S1-Pro. In the general domain, the open-source LLMs are SDAR-Chat [ 42 ] and DeepSeek-V3.2 [ 43 ] .
The general MLLMs include Qwen3-VL in its Instruct and Thinking variants [ 44 ] , Qwen3.5 at 4B, 9B, and 35B-A3B [ 45 ] , Qwen3.8 [ 46 ] , InternVL3.5 [ 47 ] , LLaVA-OneVision [ 48 ] , LLaVA-OneVision-1.5 [ 49 ] , MiniCPM-V 2.6 [ 50 , 51 ] , Llama 3.2-Vision [ 52 ] , and Gemma-4-IT [ 53 ] . We also evaluate the scientific multimodal models Intern-S1 [ 54 , 55 , 56 ] and Intern-S2-Preview [ 40 , 40 ] . The general unified understanding–generation models are Show-o2 [ 57 ] , BAGEL [ 58 ] , Janus-Pro [ 59 ] , Lumina-DiMOO [ 60 ] , InternVL-U [ 61 ] , MMaDA-Base [ 62 , 63 ] , SenseNova-U1 [ 64 ] , and Lance [ 65 ] . In the medical domain, the open-source LLMs are MMed-Llama-3 [ 66 ] , Baichuan-M3 [ 67 ] , and AntAngelMed [ 68 ] . The medical MLLMs include BiomedGPT [ 69 ] , LLaVA-Med [ 20 ] , MedDr [ 70 ] , HuatuoGPT-Vision [ 71 ] , BiMediX2 [ 72 ] , GMAI-VL [ 73 ] , MedGemma [ 74 ] , MedGemma 1.5 [ 75 ] , Lingshu [ 23 ] , Hulu-Med [ 27 ] , and ClinFusion [ 28 ] . They also include MedVLM-R1 [ 76 ] and QoQ-Med [ 77 ] , which employ reinforcement learning to enhance medical reasoning capabilities. The medical unified understanding–generation models are HealthGPT [ 30 ] and UniMedVL [ 31 ] . The proprietary models are GPT-4o [ 78 ] , GPT-5.4 [ 79 ] , Gemini-2.5-Flash [ 80 ] , Claude-Sonnet-4 [ 81 ] , and Claude-Opus-4.6 [ 82 ] , together with GPT-6.2-Sol and GPT-6.2-Astra [ 83 ] , Gemini-4-Argon [ 84 ] , and Claude-Opus-5.5 [ 85 ] , which are evaluated on a subset of the benchmarks.
blocks.zh:
核心评价将Sage-Med-Preview与77个LLM和MLLM进行比较. 这些模型涵盖一般领域和医疗领域,包括68个开源模型和9个专有模型. 按模型类型,它们跨越自递回式LLMs和MLLMs,传播出大型语言模型,并统一理解-生成模型. SDAR-Chat,Lumina-DimoO,和MMADA-Base都是传播出大型语言模型,而所有其他开源模型都是自旋模型. 模型尺寸从BiomedGPT的0.182B参数到Intern-S1-Pro的1T总参数不等. 在一般领域,开源LLM是SDAR-Chat [42]和DeepSeek-V3.2 [43].
一般的MLLM在其指令和思维变体中包括了Qune3-VL [44], Qune3.5 at 4B, 9B, 和 35B-A3B [45], Qune3.8 [46], InternVL3.5 [47], LLaVA- One Vision [48], LLaVA-One Vision-1.5 [49], MiniCPM-V 2.6 [50, 51], Llama 3.2- Vision [52], 和 Gemma-4-IT [53]. 我们还对科学的多模式模型Intern-S1[54、55、56]和Intern-S2-Preview[40、40]进行评价。 一般的统一理解-生成模型有show-o2 [57],BAGEL [58],Janus-Pro [59],Lumina-DimoO [60],InternVL-U [61],MMaDA-Base [62,63],SenseNova-U1 [64],和Lance [65]. 在医学领域,开源LLMS为MMed-Llama-3 [66],Baichuan-M3 [67],AntAngelMed [68]. 医疗MLLMs包括 BiomedGPT [69],LLaVA-Med [20],MedDr [70],HuatuoGPT-Vision [71],BiMediX2 [72],GMA-VL [73],MedGemma [74],MedGemma 1.5 [75],Lingshu [23],Hulu-Med [27],和ClinFusion [28]. 它们还包括MedVLM-R1[76]和QoQ-Med[77],它们利用强化学习来加强医学推理能力. 医学统一理解-生成模型为HealthGPT[30]和UniMedVL[31]. 专有型号有:GPT-4o [78],GPT-5.4 [79],双子座-2.5-Flash [80],克洛德-索内特-4 [81],克洛德-奥普斯-4.6 [82],连同GPT-6.2-Sol和GPT-6.2-Astra [83],双子座-4-Argon [84],克洛德-奥普斯-5.5 [85],其评价依据基准的子集.

blocks.en: 3.1.2 Comprehensive Evaluation across Clinical Task Types
blocks.zh: 3.1.2 跨临床任务类型的综合评价

blocks.en: The evaluation covers 238 clinical tasks from 74 benchmarks: 222 tasks from 61 public benchmarks and 16 tasks from 13 private benchmarks. Table S12 in Appendix S2.1 gives an overview. These benchmarks together cover more than 40 modalities across medical imaging and clinical text. The 45 core public benchmarks span eleven categories. Five comprehensive multimodal understanding benchmarks, including OmniMedVQA [ 86 ] and GMAI-MMBench [ 87 ] , assess cross-modality image understanding. Two knowledge-intensive understanding benchmarks, MMMU-Med [ 88 ] and MMMU Pro-Med [ 89 ] , test college-level knowledge on medical figures. The multi-frame understanding benchmark MedFrameQA [ 90 ] requires reasoning over multiple images, and the medical visual grounding benchmark MedSG-Bench [ 91 ] requires localizing targets with bounding boxes. Fifteen specialized multimodal understanding benchmarks, including PathVQA [ 92 ] , each target a single modality or anatomical region. Seven medical reasoning benchmarks, including MedXpertQA [ 35 ] , test expert-level image and text reasoning. Five comprehensive text understanding benchmarks, including MedQA [ 93 ] , assess clinical text comprehension. Two medical examination benchmarks, MedMCQA [ 94 ] and MMLU-Med [ 95 ] , test knowledge through multiple-choice questions. Three real-world clinical workflow benchmarks, including MedR-Bench [ 96 ] , test multi-step clinical decisions. The multilingual understanding benchmark MMedBench [ 66 ] evaluates text in multiple languages, and three medical report generation benchmarks, including MIMIC-CXR [ 97 ] , evaluate chest X-ray reports. The other 16 public benchmarks are ClinHallu [ 98 ] for clinical hallucination identification and 15 additional specialized-modality benchmarks described in Appendix S2.3 . The private benchmarks, detailed in Appendix S2.2 , span ten imaging modalities from 14 hospitals and institutions, covering disease classification, cancer staging, outcome prediction, lesion localization, and report generation.
blocks.zh: 评价涵盖来自74个基准的238个临床任务:来自61个公共基准的222个任务和来自13个私人基准的16个任务。 附录S2.1中的表S12概述了情况。 这些基准共涵盖40多种医疗成像和临床文本模式。 45项核心公共基准分为11个类别。 五项全面的多模式理解基准,包括OmniMedVQA[86]和GMAI-MM Bench[87],评估跨模式图像理解。 两个知识密集型的理解基准,MMMU-Med [88]和MMMU Pro-Med [89],测试大学一级的医学人物知识. 多框架理解基准 MeDFrameQA [90] 要求对多幅图像进行推理,医学视觉定位基准 MeDSG-Bench [91] 需要将目标定位为有边框的目标. 15项专门的多模式理解基准,包括PathVQA[92],每个基准针对单一模式或解剖区域。 7个医学推理基准,包括MedXpertQA [35],测试专家级图像和文本推理. 包括MedQA[93]在内的五项全面文本理解基准评估了临床文本理解. 两个体检基准,MedMCQA[94]和MMLU-Med[95],通过多选题测试知识. 包括MedR-Bench等三个现实世界临床工作流程基准[96],测试多步骤临床决策. 多语种理解基准MMed Bench[66]以多种语言评价文本,包括MIMIC-CXR[97]在内的三个医疗报告生成基准评价胸X光报告. 其他16个公共基准是ClinHallu [98]用于临床幻觉鉴定和附录S2.3所描述的另外15个专业模式基准。 附录S2.2详述的私人基准涵盖14所医院和机构的10个成像模式,涵盖疾病分类、癌症发作、结果预测、损伤局部化和报告生成。

blocks.en: We apply the same inference hyperparameters in Table S15 to all open-source autoregressive models and to proprietary models accessed through their official APIs. Diffusion large language models instead keep the default inference hyperparameters of each model. During inference, we prompt non-reasoning models to answer directly and reasoning models to produce a thinking process before the final answer. Appendix S2.6 provides the prompt templates for both model types. After inference, we score model responses on closed-ended benchmarks by accuracy with rule-based matching. On open-ended benchmarks, we follow their official metrics and judge models when these are provided. Otherwise, model performance on open-ended benchmarks is measured by accuracy with GPT-6-Luna-High as the judge model. For report generation, BLEU [ 99 ] , METEOR [ 100 ] , and ROUGE [ 101 ] measure the semantic similarity between model-generated reports and reference reports, while RaTEScore [ 102 ] assesses the clinical correctness of key medical entities in the generated reports. Table S12 in Appendix S2.1 details the metric and judge model of each benchmark.
blocks.zh: 我们对所有开源自递回模型以及通过其官方API访问的专有模型采用表S15中的同一种推论超参数. 传播出大型语言模型,取而代之的是保留每个模型的默认推论超参数. 在推论期间,我们促使非理性模型直接回答,推理模型在最后答案之前产生一个思考过程. 附录S2.6提供了两种型号的即时模板. 推论后,我们通过精确度和基于规则的匹配,对封闭式基准的模型响应进行分数. 关于开放式基准,我们在提供这些基准时遵循其官方衡量标准并判断模式。 否则,以GPT-6-Luna-High为评委模型的准确性来衡量开放式基准的模型性能。 对于报告生成,BLEU [99],METEOR [100],ROUGE [101] 测量模型生成的报告和参考报告之间的语义相似性,而RATEScore [102] 在生成的报告中评估了关键医疗实体的临床正确性. 附录S2.1中的表S12详细列出了每个基准的衡量和判断模型。

blocks.en: 3.2 Comprehensive Evaluation across Understanding and Reasoning Tasks
blocks.zh: 3.2 跨越理解和理性任务的全面评价

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Performance Patterns across Models and Tasks
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 各种模式和任务的业绩模式

blocks.en: Domain-specific training has not yet lifted medical MLLMs above general-purpose foundation models, and the gap widens against frontier models. We compare 22 medical MLLMs with 29 general MLLMs, including GPT-6.2-Sol, among 68 multimodal models evaluated on the 45 core public benchmarks. As Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence a shows, the medical group scores lower in all 11 core public categories and on 43 of 45 core public benchmarks, except PathVQA and TemMed-Bench. The largest gaps appear on knowledge and text tasks. Medical MLLMs average 42.71% on knowledge-intensive understanding and 65.00% on comprehensive text understanding, whereas general MLLMs reach 57.12% and 78.14%. Even medical report generation, the category with the smallest gap, shows 49.22% against 52.19%. The gap is larger still for the strongest models. Hulu-Med-235B-A22B averages 59.84% over the 45 core public benchmarks, above every other medical MLLM, whereas GPT-6.2-Sol averages 71.49% and scores lower on only seven of them. GPT-6.2-Sol also exceeds every medical MLLM in nine of 11 core public categories. It scores 86.18% against at most 57.16% on knowledge-intensive understanding and 64.25% against at most 5.65% on medical visual grounding. Open-source general models with far fewer activated parameters already match the strongest medical MLLMs. Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B activates 3B parameters against 22B for Hulu-Med-235B-A22B, yet averages 59.90%. Hulu-Med-235B-A22B wins 17 of their 45 benchmarks. Hulu-Med-30B-A3B has the same 3B activated parameters as Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, yet averages 56.17% against 58.18% and wins 12 of the 45 benchmarks. Among proprietary models outside Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence , GPT-5.4 averages 61.47% against 60.02% for Hulu-Med-235B-A22B on their 44 shared core benchmarks. Medical MLLMs hold a clear lead only over the previous Qwen3-VL generation. ClinFusion-32B averages 57.34% against 53.85% for Qwen3-VL-Instruct-32B and wins 31 of their 43 shared benchmarks. Domain training thus brings smaller gains than one generation update of general foundation models.
blocks.zh: 特定领域培训尚未将医疗最低生活水平提升到普通用途基础模型之上,差距与前沿模型相比有所扩大。 我们比较了按45个核心公共基准评估的68个多式联运模式中的22个医疗最低生活水平和29个一般最低生活水平,包括GPT-6.2-Sol。 如来相. Sage-Med:扩大医疗多式联运 情报显示,医疗小组在所有11个核心公共类别中得分较低,在45个核心公共基准中,只有43个是PathVQA和TemMed-Bench。 在知识和文本任务方面出现的最大差距。 医学上的MLLM平均为知识密集型理解42.71%,综合文本理解65.00%,而一般的MLLM则达到57.12%和78.14%. 即使医疗报告生成,差距最小的类别也显示49.22%,52.19%。 对于最强的模型来说,差距更大。 Hulu-Med-235B-A22B在45个核心公共基准中平均为59.84%,高于所有其他医疗MLLLM,而GPT-6.2-Sol平均为71.49%,只有7个的分数较低. 在11个核心公共类别中,GPT-6.2-Sol也超过了每一个医疗MLLM. 它在知识密集型理解方面得分86.18%,在医学视觉基础方面得分最多57.16%,在医疗视觉方面得分最多5.65%。 开源一般模型的激活参数要少得多,已经匹配了最强的医学MLLM. Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B对Hulu-Med-235B-A22B的22B参数激活了3B参数,但平均为59.90%. Hulu-Med-235B-A22B赢得了他们45个基准中的17个. Hulu-Med-30B-A3B拥有与Quen3.5-35B-A3B相同的3B活性参数,然而平均比分为56.17%,而58.18%,赢得了45个基准中的12个. 在Fig以外的专有模型中. Sage-Med:扩大医疗多模式情报,GPT-5.4,Hulu-Med-235B-A22B根据其44个共同核心基准,平均为61.47%,60.02%。 医学MLLMs仅在前一代的Qune3-VL中保持了明显的领先. ClinFusion-32B平均为57.34%,而Qune3-VL-Instruct-32B的平均比分为53.85%,并赢得了他们43个共享基准中的31个. 因此,与一代人更新一般基础模型相比,域培训带来的收益较小。

blocks.en: Beyond the gap between model groups, all models vary widely across task types. As Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence b shows, models score lower on multimodal benchmarks than on text-only benchmarks. The 68 multimodal models average 68.93% on the eight text-only understanding benchmarks but 44.59% on the 24 multimodal understanding benchmarks. Within the multimodal benchmarks, performance declines sharply from comprehensive to specialized categories. The models average 63.02% on five comprehensive multimodal understanding benchmarks, 50.26% on the multi-frame understanding benchmark, and 48.93% on two knowledge-intensive understanding benchmarks. On the 15 specialized multimodal understanding benchmarks, they average 40.09%. Medical visual grounding is the weakest, with an all-model mean of 5.56% on MedSG-Bench. Models score even lower on medical reasoning than on multimodal understanding. The models average 36.36% on the seven medical reasoning benchmarks, below the 44.59% on multimodal understanding and the 68.93% on text-only understanding. On the real-world clinical workflow benchmarks, which require multi-step decisions over whole clinical cases, the average drops to 31.97%. These results reveal two gaps in current training data. First, public medical data still lack high-quality, modality-balanced paired multimodal data [ 23 ] , leaving models with persistent weaknesses on multimodal understanding tasks. Second, single-turn, complete-information questions and short answers dominate training data, providing little supervision for seeking information or handling uncertainty across turns [ 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 除了模型组之间的差距外,所有模型都因任务类型而大相径庭. 如来相. Sage-Med:扩大医疗多式联运 b 情报显示,模型在多式联运基准上的得分低于仅以文字为主的基准。 68个多式联运模式平均为68.93%,仅以文字理解的8个基准,而24个多式联运理解基准为44.59%。 在多式联运基准内,业绩从全面类别急剧下降为专门类别。 模型平均为63.02%,五个综合多模式理解基准,50.26%,以及48.93%,两个知识密集型理解基准。 在15项专门的多式联运理解基准中,平均为40.09%。 医学视觉地平面最弱,在MedSG-Bench上的全模型平均为5.56%. 模型在医学推理方面的得分甚至低于多式联运的理解。 在7个医学推理基准中,模型平均为36.36%,低于44.59%的多式联运理解和68.93%的文本唯一理解。 在现实世界临床工作流程基准方面,需要对整个临床病例采取多步骤决定,平均降至31.97%。 这些结果表明,现有培训数据存在两个差距。 首先,公共医疗数据仍然缺乏高质量、模式平衡的配对多式联运数据[23],使模型在多式联运理解任务方面长期存在弱点。 第二,单回合、完整的信息问题和简短的答案主导着培训数据,对寻求信息或处理跨回合的不确定性几乎没有监督。

blocks.en: Models from the same family, and families from the same team, show consistent strengths and weaknesses across task types. The nine Qwen3-VL models average 80.92% on the eight comprehensive text, medical examination, and multilingual benchmarks in Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence c. On the radiology and pathology VQA benchmarks VQA-RAD, SLAKE, and PathVQA, however, they average 59.65%, below the 62.86% average of the 22 medical MLLMs. ClinFusion and Lingshu, from Alibaba DAMO Academy, average 75.66% on these three benchmarks, 14.82% above the all-model mean. On the 15 specialized multimodal understanding benchmarks, they average 44.55%, narrowing their lead over the all-model mean to 4.47%. Five Hulu-Med models average 74.30% on these three VQA benchmarks and PMC-VQA but 48.95% on knowledge-intensive understanding. Scaling within a family adds mainly text ability, as Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence e shows. Across 10 series, the largest member gains 9.90% on text-only understanding and 12.37% on text-only reasoning over the smallest, but 4.34% on multimodal understanding. These patterns likely reflect training data composition: general corpora with little radiology and pathology VQA for Qwen3-VL, radiology and pathology VQA for the DAMO families, and radiology and biomedical literature figure VQA for Hulu-Med.
blocks.zh: 同一家庭的模型和同一团队的模型,在任务类型上显示出一致的优缺点. 9个Qwen3-VL模型平均为80.92%,在Fig的8个综合文本,体检和多语种基准上. Sage-Med:扩大医疗多模式情报 c. 然而,在放射学和病理学方面,VQA基准为VQA-RAD、SLAKE和PathVQA,平均为59.65%,低于22个医疗MLLM中62.86%的平均值。 ClinFusion and Lingshu,来自阿里巴巴DAMO学院,在这三项基准上平均为75.66%,比全模型的平均值高出14.82%. 在15项专门的多模式理解基准中,平均为44.55%,将其领先于所有模式的程度缩小到4.47%。 5个Hulu-Med模型平均在三个VQA基准和PMC-VQA中占74.30%,但在知识密集型理解中占48.95%。 家庭内部的扩展主要增加了文字能力,如Fig。 Sage-Med:扩大医疗多式联运 情报显示。 在10个系列中,最大的成员获得9.90%的纯文本理解,12.37%获得12.37%的纯文本理解,但4.34%获得多式联运理解。 这些模式可能反映了培训数据组成:Qune3-VL的放射学和病理学VQA的普通子公司,DAMO家族的放射学和病理学VQA,以及Hulu-Med的放射学和生物医学文献图VQA.

blocks.en: Reasoning models among general MLLMs achieve substantial gains on text-based reasoning and knowledge tasks but not on image perception, as Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence d shows. The eight reasoning models comprise the Qwen3-VL-Thinking and Intern-S1 series and GPT-6.2-Sol, whereas the 21 non-reasoning models include the Qwen3-VL-Instruct, InternVL3.5, and Gemma-4 series. Across the 45 core public benchmarks, the reasoning group averages 55.35% against 50.81% for the non-reasoning group. The reasoning group scores higher on medical reasoning, comprehensive text understanding, and knowledge-intensive understanding by 9.62%, 7.70%, and 16.01%, respectively, and leads on all 14 benchmarks in these categories. On the four perception categories, however, the two groups show no consistent difference. The reasoning group scores 65.92% against 67.68% on comprehensive multimodal understanding and 50.07% against 53.08% on multi-frame understanding, but 44.22% against 43.08% on specialized multimodal understanding. Its lead on medical visual grounding, 14.86% against 8.43%, comes mainly from GPT-6.2-Sol, which scores 64.25% on MedSG-Bench. The other seven reasoning models average 7.80%. With the 22 perception benchmarks weighted equally, the two groups average 48.09% and 47.55%, a difference of only 0.54%. Within the same backbone, enabling the reasoning mode does not improve perception and even weakens it. Across all four Qwen3-VL pairs that share a backbone and size, the Thinking variant gains on knowledge-intensive understanding and medical reasoning but loses on comprehensive and specialized multimodal understanding. Among medical MLLMs, the two QoQ-Med-VL reasoning models, built on the same backbones as Lingshu-7B and Lingshu-32B, lose an average of 13.55% on comprehensive multimodal understanding but only 5.35% on medical reasoning.
blocks.zh: 一般的 MLLMs 的理性模型在基于文本的推理和知识任务上取得了巨大的收益,但是在图像感知上却没有,如 Fig. Sage-Med:扩大医疗多式联运 情报显示。 这8个推理模型包括:Qune3-VL-思维和Intern-S1系列和GPT-6.2-Sol,而21个非推理模型包括:Qune3-VL-Instruct,InternVL3.5和Gemma-4系列. 在45项核心公共基准中,推理组平均为55.35%,非推理组为50.81%。 推理组在医学推理,综合文字理解和知识密集型理解方面的分数分别高出9.62%,7.70%和16.01%,并领先于这些类别的所有14个基准. 然而,在四个认识类别方面,这两个群体没有表现出一贯的差异。 推理组对综合多式联运理解的评分为65.92%,对综合多式联运理解的评分为67.68%;对多框架理解的评分为50.07%;对专业多式联运理解的评分为44.22%,对43.08%。 它在医学视觉地平面上的领先率为14.86%,相较于8.43%,主要来自GPT-6.2-Sol,在MedSG-Bench上得分为64.25%. 其他7个推理模型平均为7.80%. 由于22个感知基准的加权均匀,这两个群体的平均比例分别为48.09%和47.55%,差距仅为0.54%。 在同一骨干范围内,使推理模式不能提高知觉甚至削弱知觉. 在所有四个具有骨干和大小的Quen3-VL配对中,思维变体在知识密集型理解和医学推理方面有所收获,但在全面和专门的多模式理解方面却有所损失。 在医疗MLLMs中,与Lingshu-7B和Lingshu-32B相同的骨干基础上所建的两个QoQ-Med-VL推理模型在综合多式理解上平均损失了13.55%,而医疗推理上却只损失了5.35%.

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Results of Sage-Med-Preview
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 Sage-Med-Preview的结果

blocks.en: Medical multimodal understanding. Sage-Med-Preview outperforms all eight open-source comparators on comprehensive multimodal and knowledge-intensive understanding. We compare Sage-Med-Preview with 12 models in three series. The first series includes four open-source models with 7B to 30B parameters, Qwen3.8-27B, InternVL3.5-30B-A3B, ClinFusion-8B, and Hulu-Med-30B-A3B. The second includes four open-source models with more than 30B parameters, Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, ClinFusion-32B, and Hulu-Med-235B-A22B. The third includes four proprietary models, GPT-5.4, Claude-Opus-4.6, Gemini-2.5-Flash, and GPT-6.2-Sol. The rest of this section and Section 3.3 use the same 12 comparators unless stated otherwise. Across the eight benchmarks in three categories, Sage-Med-Preview averages 75.61%, above all eight open-source averages that reach at most 71.46% for ClinFusion-32B. This average also exceeds Claude-Opus-4.6, GPT-5.4, and Gemini-2.5-Flash at 67.74%, 67.22%, and 65.22%, respectively. On the five comprehensive multimodal understanding benchmarks, Sage-Med-Preview averages 80.05% and exceeds all 12 comparators, as the bar charts in Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence a show. Hulu-Med-235B-A22B and GPT-6.2-Sol score 78.37% and 76.81%, respectively. Sage-Med-Preview reaches 95.54% on OmniMedVQA, above all 12 comparators. On the validation and test splits of GMAI-MMBench, Sage-Med-Preview scores 70.07% and 71.26%, above all eight open-source models and GPT-5.4, Claude-Opus-4.6, and Gemini-2.5-Flash. The radar charts cover knowledge-intensive understanding, multi-frame understanding, and ClinHallu, and Sage-Med-Preview exceeds the 7B to 30B series on all seven axes. The knowledge-intensive mean of Sage-Med-Preview at 69.54% exceeds all eight open-source models, which reach at most 61.64% for Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B. This mean also exceeds the 67.09% of GPT-5.4. The MedFrameQA score of Sage-Med-Preview at 65.52% exceeds all four proprietary models, including 62.78% for GPT-6.2-Sol. Table 1 lists the full results.
blocks.zh: 医疗多式联运。 Sage-Med-Preview在综合多式联运和知识密集型理解方面,超越了所有八个开放源码比较国。 将"Sage-Med-Preview"与"12个模型"相提并论,分为3个系列. 第一系列包括有7B至30B参数的4个开源模型,Quen3.8-27B,InternVL3.5-30B-A3B,ClinFusion-8B和Hulu-Med-30B-A3B. 第二种包括有超过30B参数的4个开源模型,Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B,Quen3.5-35B-A3B,ClinFusion-32B和Hulu-Med-235B-A22B. 第三种包括四种专有型号:GPT-5.4,克洛德-奥普斯-4.6,双子座-2.5-Flash和GPT-6.2-Sol. 除另有说明外,本节其余部分和第3.3节使用相同的12个参照国。 在分为三类的8个基准中,Sage-Med-Preview的平均比例为75.61%,高于ClinFusion-32B的8个开源平均比例,最高达到71.46%。 这一平均值也超过了克洛德-奥普斯-4.6,GPT-5.4和双子座-2.5-Flash,分别为67.74%,67.22%和65.22%. 在五个全面的多式联运理解基准上,Sage-Med-Preview平均为80.05%,并超过所有12个参照国,作为图中的条形图. Sage-Med:扩大医疗多式联运 情报节目。 Hulu-Med-235B-A22B和GPT-6.2-Sol分别得分78.37%和76.81%. Sage-Med-Preview在OmniMedVQA上达到95.54%,高于所有12个比较国. 在GMAI-MM Bench的验证和测试分出上,Sage-Med-Preview的分数分别为70.07%和71.26%,高于所有8个开源模型和GPT-5.4,克洛德-Opus-4.6,和双子座-2.5-Flash. 雷达图涵盖知识密集型理解,多帧理解,克林哈卢,塞奇-梅德-普雷维特在所有七轴上都超过了7B到30B系列. Sage-Med-Preview中的知识密集型平均值为69.54%,超过了所有8个开源模式,对Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B来说,这一比率高达61.64%. 这也超过了GPT-5.4%的67.09%. 地中海论坛 Sage-Med-Preview的QA分数为65.52%,超过了所有四个专有型号,其中GPT-6.2-Sol的分数为62.78%. 表1列出了全部结果。

blocks.en: Specialized multimodal understanding. Sage-Med-Preview outperforms every open-source model on average across the 15 specialized multimodal understanding benchmarks. Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence a–g groups these benchmarks by imaging modality and adds Claude-Opus-5.5, Gemini-4-Argon, and GPT-6.2-Astra to the proprietary series. Sage-Med-Preview scores 59.81% on the 15-benchmark average, whereas the eight open-source models reach at most 51.62% for Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B and 51.55% for Hulu-Med-235B-A22B. This average also exceeds those of GPT-5.4, Claude-Opus-5.5, Gemini-2.5-Flash, and Claude-Opus-4.6, which reach 54.27%, 52.95%, 48.29%, and 46.94%, respectively. Sage-Med-Preview scores higher than each open-source model on at least 11 of the 15 benchmarks and higher than Claude-Opus-4.6 on 13. Sage-Med-Preview outperforms all eight open-source models on nine benchmarks across five modalities, including Fundus-MMBench and UWF-DR in Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence a, PET-Bench in Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence b, TemMed-Bench in Table 2 , MMOral-OPG-Bench and PlaTiF in Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence d, FETAL-GAUGE and SMC-LUD in Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence e, and SurgWound-Bench in Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence g. On two of these, Sage-Med-Preview exceeds all 15 models. For temporal-change assessment across chest X-rays, Sage-Med-Preview scores 46.55% on TemMed-Bench, against 40.01% for GPT-6.2-Sol. For liver lesion classification on B-mode ultrasound, Sage-Med-Preview reaches 99.81% on SMC-LUD, against 72.78% for ClinFusion-8B. The TemMed-Bench subtask table in Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence c shows the source of this advantage. Sage-Med-Preview achieves a temporal-change VQA accuracy of 91.15%, exceeding the 83.25% of Gemini-4-Argon. The BLEU-1, ROUGE-L, and METEOR scores of Sage-Med-Preview for report generation exceed those of all 14 models. Table 2 lists the full results.
blocks.zh: 专门的多式联运理解。 Sage-Med-Preview平均优于15个专门的多模式理解基准的每个开源模式。 发相. Sage-Med:扩大医疗多式联运 a-g 以成像方式将这些基准分组,并将克洛德-奥普斯-5.5、双子座-4-Argon和GPT-6.2-Astra加入专利系列。 Sage-Med-Preview在15个基准平均得分59.81%,而8个开源模型最多达到51.62%的Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B和51.55%的Hulu-Med-235B-A22B. 这一平均数也超过了GPT-5.4、克洛德-奥普斯-5.5、双子座-2.5-Flash和克洛德-奥普斯-4.6,分别为54.27%、52.95%、48.29%和46.94%。 Sage-Med-Preview在15个基准中至少有11个比每个开源模型都高分,13个比克洛德-奥普斯-4.6高分. Sage-Med-Preview在包括Fundus-MM Bench和在Fig的UWF-DR在内的五种模式的9个基准上,所有8个开放源代码模型都取得了优异成绩. Sage-Med:扩大医疗多模式情报a,PET-Bench in Fig. Sage-Med:扩大医疗多模式情报b、表2中的TemMed-Bench、图中Mmoral-OPG-Bench和PlaTiF。 Sage-Med:扩大医疗多模式情报d、FETAL-GAUGE和SMC-LUD在Fig。 Sage-Med:扩大医疗多模式情报e和SurgWound-Bench in Fig。 Sage-Med:扩大医疗多模式情报g. 其中2个,Sage-Med-Preview超过了所有15个模型. 对于胸X射线的时间变化评估,Sage-Med-Preview在TemMed-Bench上的得分为46.55%,而GPT-6.2-Sol的得分为40.01%. 对于B-mode超声波的肝脏损伤分类,Sage-Med-Preview在SMC-LUD上达到99.81%,而ClinFusion-8B上达到72.78%. Fig中的TemMed-Bench子任务表. Sage-Med:扩大医疗多式联运 情报c显示了这种优势的来源. Sage-Med-Preview实现时间变化VQA精度为91.15%,超过了双子座4-Argon的83.25%. BLEU-1、ROUGE-L和METEOR对报告生成的Sage-Med-Preview的分数超过了所有14个模型的分数。 表2列出了全部结果。

blocks.en: Medical language understanding, knowledge, and hallucination identification. Sage-Med-Preview outperforms all open-source comparators on medical text understanding and identifies clinical hallucinations more accurately than 11 of the 12 comparators. On the eight comprehensive text understanding, medical examination, and multilingual benchmarks in Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence b, c, and f, Sage-Med-Preview averages 89.58%, above the 87.43% of Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B, the 85.86% of GPT-5.4, and the 85.84% of Claude-Opus-4.6. Sage-Med-Preview surpasses all 12 comparators on PubMedQA and CMB with 81.00% and 92.50%. On the three Chinese benchmarks CMB, CMExam, and CMMLU, Sage-Med-Preview averages 92.35%, above all 12 comparators, including 91.79% for GPT-6.2-Sol and 91.31% for Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B. Sage-Med-Preview also scores higher than six of the eight open-source models, GPT-5.4, and Gemini-2.5-Flash on all eight benchmarks, and higher than Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B and Hulu-Med-235B-A22B on seven. On the multilingual medical benchmark MMedBench in Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence f, the Chinese accuracy of Sage-Med-Preview at 96.12% exceeds all 12 comparators, including 94.78% for Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B. The overall accuracy of Sage-Med-Preview at 91.71% surpasses all eight open-source models, which reach at most 90.01%, as well as the 91.34% of GPT-5.4. On the clinical hallucination identification benchmark ClinHallu, shown in the radar charts of Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence c–e, Sage-Med-Preview reaches 77.48%. This score exceeds all eight open-source models, which reach at most 74.76% for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, as well as Claude-Opus-4.6, GPT-5.4, and Gemini-2.5-Flash at 76.20%, 75.90%, and 71.63%, respectively. Tables 5 and 6 list the full results.
blocks.zh: 医学语言理解,知识和幻觉识别. Sage-Med-Preview在医学文本理解上优于所有开源参照器,比12个参照器中的11个更准确地识别出临床幻觉. 关于8个综合文本理解、体检和多语种基准的Fig。 Sage-Med:扩大医疗多模式情报b、c和f,Sage-Med-Preview平均为89.58%,高于实习人员S2-Preview-35B-A3B的87.43%,GPT-5.4的85.86%和Claude-Opus-4.6%。 Sage-Med-Preview在PubMedQA和CMB上以81.0%和92.50%的成绩超越了所有12个比较者. 根据中国三大基准CMB,CMExam和CMMLU,Sage-Med-Preview平均为92.35%,高于所有12个参照国,其中GPT-6.2-Sol为91.79%,Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B为91.31%. Sage-Med-Preview也比8个开源模型中的6个GPT-5.4和双子座-2.5-Flash在全部8个基准中得分高,比Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B和Hulu-Med-235B-A22B在7个基准上得分高. 在多语种医疗基准上, Sage-Med:放大医学多模式智能 f,Sage-Med-Preview的中文精度为96.12%,超过了所有12个参照国,包括94.78%的Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B. Sage-Med-Preview的总精度为91.71%,超过了所有8个开源模型,最高达到90.01%,以及91.34%的GPT-5.4. 在临床幻觉识别基准ClinHallu上,在Fig的雷达图上显示. Sage-Med:扩大医疗多模式情报 c-e,Sage-Med-Preview达到77.48%. 这一分数超过了所有8个开源模式,以最高74.76%的成绩达到Quen3.5-35B-A3B,以及克洛德-奥普斯-4.6,GPT-5.4和双子座-2.5-Flash分别达到76.20%,75.90%和71.63%. 表5和表6列出了全部结果。

blocks.en: Clinical report generation. Sage-Med-Preview writes chest X-ray reports with more accurate clinical entities than the comparators on MIMIC-CXR and CheXpert Plus. We measure clinical correctness with RaTEScore, which compares key medical entities in generated and reference reports. As the table in Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence f shows, the RaTEScore of Sage-Med-Preview at 53.20% on CheXpert Plus exceeds all 12 comparators, with Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B at 53.10%. The RaTEScore of Sage-Med-Preview at 54.63% on MIMIC-CXR surpasses 11 of them. On MIMIC-CXR, the BLEU-3, BLEU-4, ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L of Sage-Med-Preview also exceed those of all 12 comparators, with a ROUGE-L of 33.37% against 31.90% for Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B. Averaged over the three benchmarks, the BLEU-3, BLEU-4, ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L of Sage-Med-Preview exceed those of all four proprietary models, with a mean ROUGE-L of 37.14% against 35.09% for GPT-6.2-Sol. The advantage holds across metrics. Over the 27 pairs of benchmark and metric, Sage-Med-Preview scores higher than Claude-Opus-4.6, Gemini-2.5-Flash, and Hulu-Med-30B-A3B on 26 each, than ClinFusion-32B on 24, than GPT-5.4 on 23, and than Hulu-Med-235B-A22B on 21. Table 7 reports all metrics on the three benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 临床报告生成. Sage-Med-Preview写出胸X射线报告,临床实体比MIMIC-CXR和CheXpert Plus上的比较者更准确. 我们用RETEScore来衡量临床正确性,后者在生成和参考报告中比较了关键的医疗实体. 如来入法相. Sage-Med:扩大医疗多式联运 f 情报显示,CheXpert Plus上的Sage-Med-Preview的RATES分数53.20%超过了所有12个比较者,Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B为53.10%. Sage-Med-Preview的RATES分数在MIMIC-CXR上为54.63%,超过了其中的11. 在MIMIC-CXR上,BLEU-3,BLEU-4,ROUGE-1,ROUGE-2和ROUGE-L of Sage-Med-Preview也超过了所有12个参照国,ROUGE-L比为33.37%,而实习生S2-Preview-35B-A3B为31.90%. 平均而言,BLEU-3、BLEU-4、ROUGE-1、ROUGE-2和ROUGE-L的Sage-Med-Preview超过了所有四种专利型号,平均ROUGE-L为37.14%,而GPT-6.2-Sol为35.09%。 优点是跨指标的。 在27对基准和度量衡上,Sage-Med-Preview的分数比克洛德-奥普斯-4.6,双子座-2.5-Flash,和Hulu-Med-30B-A3B各高26分,比Clinfusion-32B高24分,比GPT-5.4高23分,比Hulu-Med-235B-A22B高21分. 表7报告了三个基准的所有衡量标准。

blocks.en: Medical visual grounding. Sage-Med-Preview localizes findings more accurately than all compared open-source models. Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence b reports mIoU, the mean IoU between predicted and ground-truth boxes, for the six models on MedSG-Bench and on the eight localization tasks of the additional specialized-modality benchmarks in Appendix S2.3 . These tasks span ultrasound, CT, MRI, PET, X-ray angiography, colonoscopy, and histopathology. Sage-Med-Preview exceeds the other five models on all nine benchmarks. On the eight localization tasks, Sage-Med-Preview reaches a mean mIoU of 36.45%, against 25.63% for Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B, 20.28% for ClinFusion-32B, 13.91% and 13.86% for Hulu-Med-235B-A22B and Hulu-Med-30B-A3B, respectively, and 5.04% for Lingshu-32B. On renal CT lesion localization in RCC-AID, Sage-Med-Preview reaches 58.20% against at most 27.76% for the other five models. Current models localize poorly on MedSG-Bench. The 68 multimodal models average only 5.56% in ACC@.5, as Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence b shows. On this benchmark, Sage-Med-Preview reaches an ACC@.5 of 30.74%. The eight open-source models reach at most 28.22% for Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B. Sage-Med-Preview also exceeds GPT-5.4, Claude-Opus-4.6, and Gemini-2.5-Flash, which stay at or below 9.57%. At the stricter ACC@.7, Sage-Med-Preview reaches 16.93% against at most 11.55% for the open-source models. Tables 1 and 3 list the full results.
blocks.zh: 医学视地. Sage-Med-Preview比所有的开源模型更准确地将发现本地化. 发相. Sage-Med:扩大医疗多式联运 情报b 报告mIoU,即预测箱和地面真实箱之间的平均IoU,用于MedSG-Bench上的6个模型和附录S2.3中额外专门模式基准的8个本地化任务。 这些任务跨越了超声波、CT、核磁共振、PET、X射线血管造影、结肠镜检查以及组织病理学。 Sage-Med-Preview在所有9个基准上都超过了其他5个模型. 在8个本地化任务上,Sage-Med-Preview分别达到36.45%和25.63%的mIoU,Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B为25.63%,Clinfusion-32B为20.28%,Hulu-Med-235B-A22B和Hulu-Med-30B-A3B为13.91%和13.86%,而Lingshu-32B为5.04%. 在RCC-AID的肾上腺CT损伤局部化方面,Sage-Med-Preview达到58.20%,而其他五个模型最多达到27.76%。 目前模式在MedSG-Bench上定位不佳. 68个多式联运模式在ACC@5中平均只占5.56%。 Sage-Med:扩大医疗多式联运 情报b显示。 根据这一基准,Sage-Med-Preview达到30.74%的ACC@5. 8个开源模型最多达到28.22%的Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B. Sage-Med-Preview也超过了GPT-5.4,克洛德-奥普斯-4.6和双子座-2.5-Flash,它们保持在或低于9.57%. 在更严格的ACC@7中,Sage-Med-Preview达到16.93%,而开源模型最多达到11.55%。 表1和表3列出了全部结果。

blocks.en: Real-world clinical workflow and reasoning. Sage-Med-Preview outperforms the open-source models above 30B parameters on whole-case clinical workflow and exceeds the 7B to 30B series on four of the seven medical reasoning benchmarks. LiveClin follows each case through the clinical stages from assessment to follow-up and credits a case only when every question is correct. As Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence d shows, Sage-Med-Preview reaches a case accuracy of 47.48% and a question accuracy of 84.83%. The above-30B series reaches at most 40.23% and 81.88% for Hulu-Med-235B-A22B, and Gemini-2.5-Flash reaches 41.22% and 83.16%. Covering examination recommendation, diagnosis, and treatment planning, MedR-Bench evaluates models on clinical cases in single-turn, free-turn, and oracle settings. In Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence e, Sage-Med-Preview achieves a OneTurn accuracy of 52.14%, exceeding InternVL3.5-30B-A3B, ClinFusion-8B, Hulu-Med-30B-A3B, and Hulu-Med-235B-A22B. The OracleTreatment accuracy of Sage-Med-Preview at 29.03% exceeds Qwen3.8-27B, ClinFusion-8B, Hulu-Med-30B-A3B, and ClinFusion-32B. On the seven medical reasoning benchmarks in Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence a, Sage-Med-Preview averages 49.39%, above seven of the eight open-source models, including Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B at 48.97%, Hulu-Med-30B-A3B at 48.85%, and Qwen3.8-27B at 47.21%. The MMLU-Pro-Med score of Sage-Med-Preview at 80.07% exceeds all eight open-source models, GPT-5.4, and Gemini-2.5-Flash. On Medbullets, SuperGPQA-Med, and MedXpertQA, Sage-Med-Preview reaches 75.81%, 59.35%, and 38.53%, whereas the 7B to 30B series reaches at most 71.27%, 48.13%, and 36.82%. Tables 4 and 6 list the full results.
blocks.zh: 真实世界临床工作流程与推理. Sage-Med-Preview在全病例临床工作流程上超越了30B参数以上的开源模型,并在7个医学推理基准中的4个上超过了7B到30B系列. LiveClin在从评估到后续的临床阶段跟踪每个病例,只有在每个问题都正确时,才将一个病例计入。 如来相. Sage-Med:扩大医疗多式联运 情报d显示,Sage-Med-Preview达到了47.48%的案件精度和84.83%的问题精度. 以上-30B系列Hulu-Med-235B-A22B最多达到40.23%和81.88%,双子座-2.5-Flash达到41.22%和83.16%. Medr-Bench在单转、自转和甲骨文环境中对临床病例模型进行评价。 入法义. Sage-Med:放大医疗多模式智能e,Sage-Med-Preview实现一转精度52.14%,超过InternVL3.5-30B-A3B,ClinFusion-8B,Hulu-Med-30B-A3B和Hulu-Med-235B-A22B. Sage-Med-Preview的OracleTreatment精度为29.03%,超过了Quen3.8-27B,ClinFusion-8B,Hulu-Med-30B-A3B和ClinFusion-32B. 关于Fig中的7个医学推理基准. Sage-Med:放大医疗多模式智能 a,Sage-Med-Preview平均为49.39%,高于8个开源模式中的7个,包括Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B48.97%,Hulu-Med-30B-A3B48.85%,Qune3.8-27B47.21%. Sage-Med-Preview的MMLU-Pro-Med得分为80.07%,超过了所有8个开源模型,GPT-5.4和双子座-2.5-Flash. 在Medbullets、SuperGPQA-Med和MedXpertQA上,Sage-Med-Preview达到75.81%、59.35%和38.53%,而7B至30B系列达到最多71.27%、48.13%和36.82%。 表4和表6列出了全部结果。

blocks.en: 3.3 Multi-center Evaluation on Private Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.3 私营数据集多中心评价

blocks.en: The private evaluation comprises 13 benchmarks with 16 tasks from 14 hospitals and institutions, as Table S13 lists. All benchmarks except PET/CT are isolated from the training data of Sage-Med-Preview at both the institution and the case level, so the unseen results below exclude PET/CT. We compare Sage-Med-Preview with the same 12 comparators as in Section 3.2.2 , and Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence summarizes the results. The 12 unseen understanding tasks yield 14 scores. Only Hulu-Med-30B-A3B, Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B, ClinFusion-32B, and Hulu-Med-235B-A22B have results on Lung-DP and EndoLoc, so we summarize the comparison at two levels. Over the 11 scores of the nine tasks that all 12 comparators complete, Sage-Med-Preview averages 57.72%, above the 51.24% of GPT-6.2-Sol. The other 11 comparators average at most 42.97%. Over all 14 scores, Sage-Med-Preview averages 58.55%, whereas the four comparators with complete results reach at most 45.61%. On five of the 14 scores, Sage-Med-Preview exceeds every comparator with results.
blocks.zh: 私人评价包括13项基准,其中16项任务来自14所医院和机构,如表S13所列。 除PET/CT之外,所有基准都与机构一级和案例一级的Sage-Med-Preview培训数据相隔离,因此下文所未见的结果不包括PET/CT。 我们把Sage-Med-Preview与第3.2.2节和Fig节中的12个比较者进行比较。 Sage-Med:扩大医疗多式联运 情报总结了结果。 12个不见人知的任务得到14分 只有Hulu-Med-30B-A3B,Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B,ClinFusion-32B,和Hulu-Med-235B-A22B在龙发和远东禄克上都有结果,所以我们总结了两个层次的比较. 在全部12个参照国完成的9个任务中的11个分数中,Sage-Med-Preview平均57.72%,高于GPT-6.2-Sol的51.24%. 其他11个参照国平均最多为42.97%。 在所有14个分数中,Sage-Med-Preview平均为58.55%,而四个获得完整结果的比较方最多达到45.61%。 在14分中的5分上,"Sage-Med-Preview"以结果超过每个比较者.

blocks.en: Melanoma metastasis outcome prediction. This task requires a model to predict the metastasis outcome of each lesion from dermoscopy images. As Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence c shows, Sage-Med-Preview achieves 76.80% and exceeds 11 of the 12 comparators. These include GPT-6.2-Sol at 75.26%, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B at 74.74%, the similar-sized Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B and Hulu-Med-30B-A3B at 72.94% and 72.42%, respectively, Claude-Opus-4.6 at 71.91%, and GPT-5.4 at 59.79%. Table 8 gives the full results.
blocks.zh: Melanoma metastasis 结果预测. 这项任务需要一个模型来预测从皮肤镜像中得出的每次损伤的元化结果. 如来相. Sage-Med:扩大医疗多式联运 c 情报显示,Sage-Med-Preview实现76.80%,并超过12个参照方中的11个. 其中GPT-6.2-Sol为75.26%,Quen3.5-35B-A3B为74.74%,相近规模的Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B和Hulu-Med-30B-A3B分别为72.94%和72.42%,克洛德-Opus-4.6为71.91%,GPT-5.4为59.79%. 表8提供了全部结果。

blocks.en: Fundus disease classification and report generation. This benchmark requires a model to classify fundus diseases and to generate a fundus report from color fundus photographs. On disease classification in Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence a, Sage-Med-Preview achieves 70.70% and exceeds 10 of the 12 comparators, including Hulu-Med-30B-A3B at 69.60%, Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B at 64.10%, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B at 59.71%, and GPT-5.4 at 57.14%. For report generation in Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence e, the ROUGE-2 of Sage-Med-Preview at 13.79% exceeds all eight open-source models, among which ClinFusion-8B reaches 13.55%. Sage-Med-Preview also surpasses Claude-Opus-4.6 at 11.96% and Gemini-2.5-Flash at 11.16%. Tables 8 and 9 report both tasks.
blocks.zh: Fundus疾病分类和报告生成. 这一基准要求有一个模型来分类基金疾病,并从彩色基金照片中生成基金报告. 关于"Fig"中的疾病分类. Sage-Med:放大医疗多模式智能 a,Sage-Med-Preview实现70.70%,并超过12个参照方中的10个,包括Hulu-Med-30B-A3B69.60%,Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B64.10%,Quen3.5-35B-A3B59.71%,GPT-5.4%57.14%. 在Fig为报告生成。 Sage-Med:放大医疗多模式智能e,Sage-Med-Preview的ROUGE-2以13.79%的速度超过了所有8个开源模型,其中ClinFusion-8B达到13.55%. Sage-Med-Preview也以11.96%的成绩超过了克洛德-奥普斯-4.6,双子座-2.5-Flash以11.16%的成绩超过了克洛德-奥普斯-4.6. 表8和表9都报告了这两个任务.

blocks.en: Nasopharyngeal carcinoma staging. This task, denoted NPC, evaluates nasopharyngeal carcinoma staging on MRI at the slice level and the patient level. On slice-level staging, Sage-Med-Preview achieves 62.70% and exceeds all 12 comparators, including GPT-6.2-Sol at 57.79%, InternVL3.5-30B-A3B at 52.05%, Hulu-Med-235B-A22B at 51.97%, and the similar-sized Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B at 50.41%. On patient-level staging, Sage-Med-Preview reaches 49.18% and exceeds 10 of the 12 comparators, including GPT-6.2-Sol at 43.44%, Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B at 31.15%, and GPT-5.4 at 27.87%. On the two-level average in Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence c, Sage-Med-Preview reaches 55.94%, compared with 50.62% for GPT-6.2-Sol and 49.67% for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B. Both tasks appear in Table 8 .
blocks.zh: Nasopharyngeal 癌细胞瘤正在形成。 这项任务是国家计生委,它评估在切片和病人一级进行核磁共振的鼻血清癌。 在切片级中继器上,Sage-Med-Preview实现62.70%,并超过了所有12个参照器,包括GPT-6.2-Sol为57.79%,InternVL3.5-30B-A3B为52.05%,Hulu-Med-235B-A22B为51.97%,相类似大小的Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B为50.41%. 在病人一级,Sage-Med-Preview达到49.18%,超过12个参照方中的10个,其中包括43.44%的GPT-6.2-Sol、31.15%的实习生S2-Preview-35B-A3B和27.87%的GPT-5.4。 在Fig的两级平均值上. Sage-Med:放大医疗多模式智能c,Sage-Med-Preview达到55.94%,而GPT-6.2-Sol为50.62%,Qune3.5-35B-A3B为49.67%. 这两项任务均载于表8。

blocks.en: Orthopedic admission diagnosis. This text-only task, denoted Ortho-Admission, requires a model to determine the orthopedic admission diagnosis from EHR notes. Sage-Med-Preview achieves 61.25% and exceeds nine of the 12 comparators, as Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence a shows. These include GPT-5.4 and Gemini-2.5-Flash at 60.00%, Hulu-Med-235B-A22B at 58.75%, and Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B at 55.00%. Table 8 gives the full results.
blocks.zh: 矫形入院诊断. 这种仅以文字表示的任务,即Ortho-Addission,需要一个模型来决定EHR注释中的正文收录诊断. Sage-Med-Preview实现61.25%,并超过12个参照国中的9个,作为"Fig". Sage-Med:扩大医疗多式联运 情报节目。 其中包括:GPT-5.4和双子座-2.5-Flash为60.0%;Hulu-Med-235B-A22B为58.75%;Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B和Quen3.5-35B-A3B为55.0%. 表8提供了全部结果。

blocks.en: Pneumonia detection and localization. This task requires a model to detect pneumonia on chest X-rays and to localize each lesion with a bounding box. The evaluation metrics are mIoU and the accuracy at IoU above 0.3, denoted ACC@.3. As Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence d shows, Sage-Med-Preview outperforms 11 of the 12 comparators on both metrics, achieving an ACC@.3 of 61.41% and an mIoU of 44.18%. The open-source models reach at most 56.52% ACC@.3 and 40.92% mIoU, both from Qwen3.5-35B-A3B. Claude-Opus-4.6 reaches 52.17% and 33.86%. Medical MLLMs localize lesions less accurately, as Hulu-Med and ClinFusion stay at or below 30.43% ACC@.3 and 19.69% mIoU. Table 8 gives the full results.
blocks.zh: 肺炎检测与局部化. 这个任务需要有一个模型来检测胸部X光上的肺炎,并且用一个边框将每次损伤都定位. 评价指标是mIoU,0.3以上IoU的准确性表示ACC@.3. 如图。 Sage-Med:扩大医疗多式联运 情报d显示,Sage-Med-Preview在两个衡量标准上都优于12个参照国中的11个,实现了61.41%的ACC@3和44.18%的MIOU。 开源模型达到最高为56.52%的ACC@.3和40.92%的MIOU,均取自Quen3.5-35B-A3B. Claude-Opus-4.6,达到52.17%和33.86%. 由于Hulu-Med和ClinFusion保持在或低于30.43%的ACC@.3%和19.69%的MIOU,医疗MLLMs将损伤局部化,结果不准确。

blocks.en: Surgical attention region localization. This task, denoted Surg-Attention, requires a model to localize the region on which the surgeon focuses in each laparoscopic frame. Sage-Med-Preview outperforms all 12 comparators on both metrics, as Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence d shows. Sage-Med-Preview reaches 78.85% ACC@.3 and 48.50% mIoU, while the strongest comparator, GPT-5.4, reaches 58.90% and 35.06%. The margin over medical MLLMs is larger, since Hulu-Med-30B-A3B and ClinFusion-8B reach ACC@.3 of 42.90% and 38.35%. These results are consistent with the grounding supervision in Section 3.2.2 , which transfers from public and in-house data to this unseen surgical setting. Table 8 gives the full results.
blocks.zh: 外科专注区就地化. 这项任务是Surg-Attention,它要求有一个模型,使外科医生在每个腹腔镜框中所关注的区域本地化。 Sage-Med-Preview在两个度量衡上都优于所有12个比较者,作为Fig. Sage-Med:扩大医疗多式联运 情报显示。 Sage-Med-Preview达到78.85%的ACC@.3%和48.50%的mIoU,而最强的比较器GPT-5.4%达到58.90%和35.06%. 由于Hulu-Med-30B-A3B和ClinFusion-8B的CAC@3. 比例为42.90%和38.35%,因此与医疗的MLLM的比值较大。 这些结果与第3.2.2.节的基础监督是一致的,该节将公共和内部数据转移到这种看不见的外科环境。 表8提供了全部结果。

blocks.en: Ear disease classification. This task requires classifying ear diseases from otoscopic images. As Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence a shows, Sage-Med-Preview achieves 41.40% and exceeds all 12 comparators. Hulu-Med-235B-A22B, Hulu-Med-30B-A3B, and ClinFusion-32B reach 27.95%, 27.10%, and 26.90%, respectively. The general-purpose and proprietary models also score lower, with 26.05% for Qwen3.8-27B, 23.00% for GPT-6.2-Sol, and 22.30% for Gemini-2.5-Flash. Table 8 lists the full results.
blocks.zh: 耳病分类. 这项任务需要从视像中将耳朵疾病分类。 如来相. Sage-Med:扩大医疗多式联运 Sage-Med-Preview实现41.40%,并超过所有12个参照国。 Hulu-Med-235B-A22B,Hulu-Med-30B-A3B和ClinFusion-32B分别达到27.95%,27.10%和26.90%. 一般用途和专有模式的得分也较低,Quen3.8-27B为26.05%,GPT-6.2-Sol为23.00%,双子座-2.5-Flash为22.30%. 表8列出了全部结果。

blocks.en: Intracranial tumor classification. This benchmark requires a model to classify the intracranial tumor of each case by integrating several MRI images. Sage-Med-Preview achieves 40.00% and exceeds 10 of the 12 comparators, as shown in Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence a. These include GPT-5.4 at 37.14%, Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B and Claude-Opus-4.6 at 34.29%, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B at 32.86%, and Hulu-Med-235B-A22B at 30.00%. Table 8 lists the full results.
blocks.zh: 内脏肿瘤分类法. 这一基准要求有一个模型,通过整合多幅核磁共振图像来分类每个病例的颅内肿瘤. Sage-Med-Preview实现40.00%,并超过12个比较方中的10个,如"Fig"所示. Sage-Med:扩大医疗多式联运情报a。 其中包括37.14%的GPT-5.4、30.0%的实习生S2-Preview-35B-A3B和克洛德-奥普斯-4.6。 表8列出了全部结果。

blocks.en: Lung diagnosis and progression and endoscopic location recognition. The first benchmark requires a model to diagnose lung diseases on chest X-rays and to assess interval progression between chest X-rays taken at different times, and we denote it Lung-DP. The second requires a model to recognize the anatomical location of each endoscopic image from 27 options, and we denote it EndoLoc. Among the comparators, only Hulu-Med-30B-A3B, Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B, ClinFusion-32B, and Hulu-Med-235B-A22B report results on these tasks, so Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence b shows these models alone. On interval progression, Sage-Med-Preview achieves 82.10%, exceeding all four comparators. Hulu-Med-235B-A22B, Hulu-Med-30B-A3B, Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B, and ClinFusion-32B reach 80.86%, 80.25%, 64.81%, and 56.79%, respectively. Table 8 lists the diagnosis and EndoLoc results.
blocks.zh: 肺部诊断 进取和内视位置识别 第一个基准需要一个模型来诊断胸X光上的肺病,并评估在不同时间拍摄的胸X光之间的间隔进展,我们表示这是肺-DP. 第二种需要模型从27个选项中识别出每个内视图像的解剖位置,我们表示它是远东Loc. 在比较者中,只有Hulu-Med-30B-A3B,Intern-S2-Preview-35B-A3B,ClinFusion-32B和Hulu-Med-235B-A22B报告这些任务的结果,因此Fig. Sage-Med:扩大医疗多式联运 情报b只显示这些模型。 在间隔进度上,Sage-Med-Preview实现82.10%,超过了所有四个参照国. 花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花花 表8列出了诊断结果和EndoLoc结果。

blocks.en: Lung CT report generation. This benchmark, denoted Lung-Cancer, requires a model to generate a CT report for each lung cancer case from several CT images. We assess report quality mainly by RaTEScore, which measures the correctness of clinical entities. Sage-Med-Preview achieves a RaTEScore of 66.52% and exceeds nine of the 12 comparators, as Fig. Sage-Med: Scaling Medical Multimodal Intelligence e shows. These include Hulu-Med-235B-A22B at 66.13%, Qwen3.8-27B at 65.74%, GPT-5.4 at 64.32%, GPT-6.2-Sol at 58.80%, and Claude-Opus-4.6 at 58.56%. Sage-Med-Preview also achieves a ROUGE-2 of 13.81%, exceeding nine of the 12 comparators. Table 9 lists all report metrics.
blocks.zh: 肺CT报告生成. 这一基准是指肺癌,它需要一个模型,从几个肺癌的图像中生成每个肺癌病例的CT报告。 我们主要由RATEScore评估报告质量,它衡量临床实体的正确性。 Sage-Med-Preview实现66.52%的RATES分数,并超过12个参照国中的9个,作为"Fig".
