blocks.en: 4 Training Analysis
blocks.zh: 4 培训分析

blocks.en:
Prioritizing informative content and modality balance yielded greater downstream medical performance gains than pretraining on the full data pool.
Standard continual pretraining (CPT) used the full pretraining dataset, whereas refined CPT used a selected 30-million-record subset with a more balanced modality distribution.
Both recipes were followed by the same SFT1 supervision, allowing their downstream utility to be compared after a common instruction-alignment stage.
All evaluations in Fig. 9 a–d use the same 20 benchmarks, comprising 14 multimodal and six text-only benchmarks, with performance summarized by the macro-average across benchmarks.
Standard CPT followed by SFT1 increased the macro-average from 56.33 for the base model to 61.26, while refined CPT reached 62.82, exceeding the full-data recipe by 1.56 percentage points (Fig. 9 a).
The stronger performance of the smaller mixture highlights the value of increasing information density and balancing complementary sources of medical supervision.
For heterogeneous medical corpora, these findings favor improving content selection and modality composition before further expanding data volume.
blocks.zh:
将信息内容和方式平衡列为优先事项,比对整个数据库进行预先培训,提高了下游医疗业绩。
标准持续预训(CPT)使用完整的预训数据集,而精细的CPT则使用选定的3000万个记录子集,其模式分布更为平衡.
两种食谱都相继被同为SFT1监督,使得它们的下游用途可以在共同的指令-调整阶段后进行比较.
图9 a-d中的所有评价都使用相同的20个基准,包括14个多式和6个仅限文本的基准,业绩按各基准的宏观平均数汇总。
标准CPT之后的SFT1将宏观平均值从基模型的56.33提高到61.26,而精制的CPT则达到62.82,超过全数据配方1.56个百分点(图9 a.
较小的混合物的性能更强,突出了增加信息密度和平衡医疗监督的补充来源的价值。
对于多样性的医学公司来说,这些结论有利于在进一步扩大数据量之前改进内容选择和方式组成。

blocks.en:
Targeted supervised refinement and subsequent RL contributed most of the improvement achieved after initial instruction alignment.
Following CPT and SFT1, the macro-average increased from 61.26 to 61.45 after SFT2 and to 62.02 after SFT3, corresponding to successive gains of 0.19 and 0.57 percentage points.
RL then raised performance to 63.03, adding a further 1.01 points and bringing the cumulative improvement over SFT1 to 1.77 points (Fig. 9 b).
The larger increments during targeted refinement and reward optimization indicate that substantial scope for improvement remained after broad instruction learning and task expansion.
In particular, the additional gain from RL demonstrates the continued utility of task-specific reward feedback after three supervised stages.
These results motivate a progressive curriculum in which successive stages develop task coverage, refine performance through focused supervision and further improve responses through reward-based optimization.
The training-loss trajectory of Sage-Med-Preview-35B-A3B provides a complementary view of this process across pretraining, mid-training and SFT (Fig. 9 e).
Loss generally decreased within individual phases, with changes at stage boundaries followed by further reduction under the next training recipe.
blocks.zh:
有针对性的监督改进和随后的RL有助于在初步指令调整后实现的大部分改进。
继CPT和SFT1之后,宏观平均值从SFT2之后的61.26升至61.45,再从SFT3之后的62.02升至62.02,相對相對相對以0.19分和0.57分相對.
RL随后将性能提升到63.03分,再增加1.01分,使SFT1的累计改进达到1.77分(图9b).
目标明确的改进和奖励优化期间的较大增量表明,在广泛学习教学和扩大任务之后,仍有很大的改进余地。
特别是,从RL获得的额外收益表明,在三个监督阶段之后,针对具体任务的奖励反馈仍然有用。
这些成果激励了一个渐进式的课程,在课程中,相继阶段发展任务覆盖面,通过有重点的监督来改进业绩,并通过基于奖励的优化来进一步改善对策。
Sage-Med-Preview-35B-A3B的训练-损失轨迹提供了从预训、中训和SFT(图9e)对这一进程的补充观点。
损失在个别阶段普遍减少,在阶段界限发生变化,随后在下一个培训方法下进一步减少。

blocks.en:
The performance advantage of Intern-S2-Preview persisted across all three SFT stages, showing that initialization continued to shape the level of medical capability reached after adaptation.
Intern-S2-Preview initialization exceeded Qwen3.5-35B-A3B initialization by 4.31, 2.54 and 2.72 percentage points after SFT1, SFT2 and SFT3, respectively (Fig. 9 c).
Across these stages, the Intern-initialized model improved from 61.26 to 62.02, while the Qwen-initialized model improved from 56.95 to 59.30.
The Qwen-initialized model gained 2.35 points between SFT1 and SFT3, compared with 0.76 points for the Intern-initialized model, narrowing the gap while retaining a lower final macro-average.
This trajectory distinguishes the capacity to improve during adaptation from the capability ultimately achieved.
Evaluating initialization choices across successive checkpoints therefore captures both responsiveness to further training and the performance attainable under the medical curriculum.
The consistently stronger adapted performance of Intern-S2-Preview supports its selection as the base model for Sage-Med.
blocks.zh:
Intern-S2-Preview在所有三个SFT阶段的性能优势依然存在,表明初始化继续塑造了适应后达到的医疗能力水平.
Intern-S2-Preview初始化分别比SFT1,SFT2和SFT3相接后(图9 c)的4分31分,2.54分和2.72分都超过了Quen3.5-35B-A3B初始化.
在这些阶段,实习初始化模式从61.26改进为62.02,而Quen初始化模式从56.95改进为59.30.
SFT1至SFT3的入围模式为Wen初始化,获得2.35分;而实习生初始化模式则为0.76分,缩小了差距,同时保留了较低的最终宏观平均值.
这一轨迹将适应期间改进能力与最终实现的能力区分开来。
因此,评估各个检查站的初始化选择,既能反映对进一步培训的反应,又能反映医疗课程可实现的业绩。
Intern-S2Preview的一贯更强的适应性能支持其被选为Sage-Med的基础模型.

blocks.en:
Greater text coverage within a multimodal-majority mixture and an intermediate short-answer share improved medical instruction alignment in the respective pilot experiments.
For Qwen3-VL-8B, increasing the text share from 29.4% to 38%, with the multimodal share changing from 70.6% to 62%, raised the 20-benchmark macro-average from 48.70 to 49.79, a gain of 1.09 percentage points (Fig. 9 d, left).
The improvement shows that allocating more supervision to text can strengthen aggregate medical performance while preserving a predominantly multimodal training mixture.
Response-length composition exhibited an intermediate optimum among the tested settings.
In the Qwen3-VL-4B pilot, increasing the short-answer share from 15% to 25% improved the same macro-average by 1.87 percentage points, whereas increasing it to 30% yielded a smaller gain of 1.44 points relative to the 15% setting (Fig. 9 d, right).
The strongest result at 25% favors a length-diverse mixture that combines concise response targets with substantial supervision from contextual explanations and extended reasoning.
Guided by this comparison, the final length-stratified medical subset uses 25% short, 50% medium-length and 25% long references.
These pilots identify modality allocation and response-length distribution as actionable components of training-data design, with their value assessed through downstream medical performance.
blocks.zh:
在多模式-多数混合物和中间短答中增加文本覆盖面,有助于在相关试点试验中改进医学指导的一致性。
对Qune3-VL-8B来说,文本份额从29.4%增加到38%,多式联运份额从70.6%增加到62%,将20个基准宏观平均值从48.70提高到49.79,增收1.09个百分点(图9d,左)。
改进表明,对文字进行更多的监督可以加强总体医疗绩效,同时保持一种以多式联运培训为主的混合模式。
反应长的成分在所测试的环境下呈现出最佳的中间结构。
在Qwen3-VL-4B试点中,将短答比例从15%提高到25%,使同一宏观平均数提高了1.87个百分点,而将其提高到30%,与15%的设定相比,收益减少了1.44个百分点(图9d,右)。
最强的结果为25%,倾向于使用长短相差的混合物,将简明的反应目标与从背景解释和延伸推理中进行的实质性监督结合起来。
以这一比较为指导,最终的长度分集使用25%短、50%中和25%长的参考。
这些试点将模式分配和反应长分布确定为培训数据设计中可操作的组成部分,其价值通过下游医疗业绩进行评估。

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en: Although Sage-Med-Preview provides empirical reference points and actionable recipes for scaling medical multimodal intelligence by combining stage-specific data curation, progressive supervision, and adaptive reinforcement learning, formally characterizing quantitative scaling laws across wider parameter, data, and compute regimes warrants systematic multi-scale investigation. In particular, experiments spanning multiple model scales and compute budgets are needed to predict capability emergence and to vary corpus size and image-grounded supervision density independently, thereby distinguishing the returns of broader clinical case coverage from those of richer annotations. Moreover, because modality proportions shifted across post-training stages (approximately 60% and 53% multimodal in the second and third supervised fine-tuning stages, respectively, and 80% in the reinforcement-learning pool) alongside changes in task composition and difficulty, isolating the independent effects of modality balance remains challenging. Controlled mixture experiments, intermediate checkpoint evaluations, and targeted ablations will help clarify how distinct supervisory signals, such as adaptive difficulty sampling and independent reference replay, govern the acquisition and retention of specific capabilities. Furthermore, under a fixed visual token budget, systematic comparisons across tasks and imaging modalities are needed to establish when higher spatial resolution versus broader volumetric slice or temporal frame coverage yields greater diagnostic gains. Finally, owing to API and computational cost constraints, our evaluation did not cover all latest frontier general-purpose models across the full benchmark suite, with several recent proprietary releases assessed only on selected subsets. Nevertheless, it is evident that these frontier models already exhibit remarkably strong medical multimodal capabilities even under standalone inference without external tools or task-specific harnesses. Beyond scaling native model capabilities alone, integrating multimodal foundation models into agentic frameworks equipped with specialized clinical tools, iterative verification, and structured harnesses represents a promising pathway toward general-purpose medical multimodal intelligence.
blocks.zh: 虽然Sage-Med-Preview提供了经验性参考点和可操作的药方,通过结合阶段性数据解析、渐进式监督和适应性强化学习来扩大医疗多模式智能,正式确定跨大参数、数据和计算制度的定量尺度法,值得进行系统的多规模调查。 特别是,需要进行跨越多个模型尺度和计算预算的实验,以预测能力的出现,并独立地改变体积和以图像为基础的监督密度,从而将更广泛的临床病例覆盖的回报与较丰富的说明的回报区分开来。 此外,由于模式比例在培训后阶段(在第二和第三监督的微调阶段分别为约60%和53%,在强化学习库中分别为80%)与任务构成和困难的变化相伴而行,隔离模式平衡的独立效果仍然是挑战。 受控制的混合物试验、中间检查站评价和有针对性的模拟将有助于澄清不同的监督信号,例如适应困难取样和独立参考重放如何制约特定能力的获取和保留。 此外,根据固定的可视化符号预算,需要对任务和成像模式进行系统比较,以确定何时空间分辨率高于较大的分片或时间框架覆盖,从而产生更大的诊断收益。 最后,由于API和计算成本的限制,我们的评价没有涵盖整个基准套装中所有最新的前沿通用模型,最近的一些专有发行只按选定的子集进行评估。 然而,这些前沿模型显然已经显示出非常强大的医疗多模式能力,即使是在没有外部工具或特定任务手段的情况下独立推断出来的。 除了仅扩大本土模型能力外,将多模式基础模型纳入配有专门临床工具的代理框架、迭代核查和结构化利用是通向通用医疗多模式智能的有希望的途径。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Effective scaling of medical multimodal intelligence depends not merely on expanding parameter counts or raw corpus volume, but on aligning supervision quality, modality balance, and training curricula with the diverse capabilities required in clinical practice. Through a systematic evaluation of 77 models across 238 clinical tasks spanning 61 public and 13 private multi-center benchmarks, this study reveals a structural bottleneck in current scaling paradigms: enlarging model size or enabling text-centric reasoning disproportionately advances language performance while failing to close the gap in medical visual perception. To overcome this limitation, Sage-Med-Preview establishes a scalable paradigm that pairs stage-specific curation over 322.7 million candidate records with medical pretraining, progressive supervised fine-tuning, and adaptive reinforcement learning, advancing visual perception and medical language understanding in tandem. This recipe raises average performance across 31 public multimodal benchmarks from 52.24% for the base model Intern-S2-Preview to 58.26%, outperforming all open-source medical and general comparators while generalizing reliably to unseen multi-center clinical cohorts (57.72% versus 51.24% for GPT-6.2-Sol). Complementing these results, our training analyses distill actionable scaling principles, showing that a compact, modality-balanced pretraining mixture outperforms unfiltered full-data scaling, and that targeted supervised refinement followed by adaptive reinforcement learning unlocks consistent post-alignment gains. Taken together, this work provides empirical scaling evidence, practical data and training recipes, and a rigorous clinical evaluation foundation toward scalable generalist medical AI, laying the groundwork for future systems that tightly integrate fine-grained visual evidence with complex reasoning across end-to-end clinical workflows.
blocks.zh: 有效扩大医疗多式联运情报不仅取决于扩大参数数或原始体积,而且取决于使监督质量、模式平衡和培训课程与临床实践所需的不同能力相协调。 通过对238个临床任务中的77个模型进行系统评价,涵盖61个公共和13个私人多中心基准,本研究揭示了当前规模模型中的一个结构性瓶颈:扩大模型规模或使文字中心推理能够不成比例地提高语言性能,而未能弥合医学视觉认知方面的差距。 为了克服这一限制,Sage-Med-Preview建立了一个可扩展的范式,将3.227亿份特定阶段的考生记录与医学预训、渐进式监督的微调和适应性强化学习相结合,同时推进视觉感知和医学语言理解。 这种配方将31个公共多式联运基准的平均业绩从基础模型Intern-S2-Preview的52.24%提高到58.26%,超越了所有开放源码的医学和一般参照人,同时可靠地将多中心临床群体普遍化到看不见的水平(GPT-62-Sol的57.72%和51.24%)。 作为这些成果的补充,我们的培训分析提炼出可操作的分级原则,表明一种紧凑的、模式平衡的预训混合物超越了未过滤的全数据分级,有针对性的监督完善,然后适应性强化学习解锁一致的分级后收益。 综合起来,这项工作提供了经验尺度化的证据、实用数据和培训配方,并为可扩展的通用医学AI奠定了严格的临床评价基础,为未来系统奠定了基础,这些系统将精细的视觉证据与跨端到端临床工作流程的复杂推理紧密结合起来。

Figure 2 : Sage-Med-Preview-35B-A3B: a medical multimodal foundation model with progressive training and broad evaluation. a, Conceptual overview of Sage-Med-Preview-35B-A3B, integrating medical knowledge, visual understanding and clinical reasoning to support diverse medical tasks using evidence from medical images, clinical records, image sequences, literature and guidelines. b, Evaluation landscape encompassing 74 benchmarks and 77 comparison models, spanning 238 clinical tasks, more than 40 modalities and 14 institutions. Donut charts show the composition of benchmark and model categories; icons denote representative modalities and evidence types. c, Training framework comprising medical pretraining, progressive supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and adaptive reinforcement learning (RL). Continual pretraining and mid-training establish medical knowledge and visual–semantic alignment. Three successive SFT stages develop instruction following, broaden task coverage and selectively refine capabilities while retaining supervision from earlier stages. Adaptive RL combines policy-conditioned difficulty assessment, adaptive sampling and task-specific reward checks with supervised capability replay. d, Average evaluation scores (%) across all 42 multimodal benchmarks for Sage-Med-Preview-35B-A3B and selected comparison models.
Each marker represents one model; shaded regions indicate model categories, including general-purpose, proprietary and medical multimodal models, as well as models that jointly support understanding and generation.
blocks.zh:
图2: Sage-Med-Preview-35B-A3B:具有渐进式培训和广泛评价的医学多模式基础模型. a. Sage-Med-Preview-35B-A3B的概念概述,将医疗知识、视觉理解和临床推理结合起来,利用医疗图像、临床记录、图像序列、文献和准则的证据支持各种医疗任务。 b. 评价范围包括74个基准和77个比较模型,涉及238个临床任务、40多个模式和14个机构。 多努图显示基准和模型类别的组成;图标表示代表模式和证据类型。 c. 培训框架,包括医学预训、渐进式监督微调和适应性强化学习。 连续的预训和中训建立了医学知识和视觉-语义的结合。 连续三个SFT阶段制定后续指令,扩大任务范围并有选择地改进能力,同时保留早期的监督。 适应性RL结合了政策条件下的难度评估,适应性采样和任务特定奖励检查与监督能力回放. d. Sage-Med-Preview-35B-A3B的所有42个多式联运基准和选定的比较模型的平均评价分数(%)。
每个标记代表一个模型;阴影区域表示模型类别,包括通用模型、专有模型和医疗多模式模型,以及共同支持理解和生成的模型。

blocks.en:
Figure 3 : Construction and composition of a large-scale medical
multimodal data collection. a, Source integration and supervision construction.
Public datasets and literature are combined with private textbooks
and specialty data through document extraction and dataset
integration. Images, accompanying descriptions, annotations and
source context are organized into source-linked evidence, which
is retained, refined or used to synthesize supervision for
descriptions, question answering and reasoning, report generation,
and grounding. b, Composition of the 322.7 million-record candidate
inventory, comprising 232.8 million pretraining-family records,
87.4 million supervised fine-tuning records and 2.5 million
reinforcement-learning records. The nested chart and accompanying
table distinguish multimodal and text-only records within each
family; stacked bars summarize public and private source
contributions. c, Three stage-specific, six-step curation pathways.
Pretraining curation assesses visual and textual usability,
medical relevance, duplication, image–text consistency,
caption quality and image quality.
Supervised fine-tuning curation combines rule-based screening,
deduplication, language-model quality scoring, length and format
checks, task and reasoning verification, and retained-pool
consolidation.
Reinforcement-learning curation combines prompt and schema checks,
task typing, reference validation, blind rollouts and task
evaluation, difficulty-based routing, and semantic checks with
replay routing.
The pathways yield retained pools of approximately 93.8 million,
69.6 million and 0.3 million records, respectively.
Intermediate annotations indicate approximate retained, excluded
and reviewed record counts; retained-pool sizes are distinct from
the numbers subsequently used in individual training stages. d, Distribution across imaging modalities and examination
types, accompanied by representative examples. e, Two-dimensional visualization of data representations
coloured by modality. f, Distribution across anatomical regions, accompanied
by representative examples. g, Two-dimensional visualization of data representations
coloured by anatomical category.
PT, pretraining; SFT, supervised fine-tuning;
RL, reinforcement learning; MM, multimodal;
M, million; B, billion.

Figure 9 : Training strategy analysis and optimization dynamics. Evaluations in a–d use 20 benchmarks, comprising 14 multimodal and six text-only benchmarks.
Scores are macro-averages across benchmarks, and gains are reported in percentage points. a, Base-model performance and results obtained with standard or refined continual pretraining (CPT), followed by the same first-stage supervised fine-tuning (SFT). b, Performance across three successive SFT stages and subsequent reinforcement learning (RL), with annotations indicating gains between consecutive stages. c, Comparison of Intern-S2-Preview and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B as base-model initializations across the three SFT stages. d, Effects of training-data composition.
Left, average scores of Qwen3-VL-8B with text/multimodal proportions of 29.4%/70.6% and 38%/62%.
Right, performance gains of Qwen3-VL-4B as the proportion of short-answer training examples increases from 15% to 30%, relative to the 15% setting. e, Training loss of Sage-Med-Preview-35B-A3B across pretraining, mid-training and three SFT stages.
Light traces show step-level loss, and the dark line shows the smoothed trajectory.
Coloured bands indicate training stages along the cumulative training-step axis.
The inset expands the three SFT stages.
blocks.zh:

得分是跨基准的宏观平均数,收益按百分点报告。 a. 通过标准或精细的连续预训(CPT)取得的基础模型性能和结果,然后是相同的第一阶段监督微调。 b. 连续三个SFT阶段和随后的强化学习(RL)的性能,说明表明连续阶段之间的增益。 c,比较了Intern-S2-Preview和Quen3.5-35B-A3B作为基础模型在SFT三个阶段的初始化. d. 培训数据构成的影响。
左,平均得分为Qwen3-VL-8B,文字/多式比例为29.4%/70.6%和38%/62%.
对,Qwen3-VL-4B作为短答培训实例的比例从15%增加到了30%,而设定的比例为15%。 e. 在培训前阶段、中期阶段和SFT三个阶段中,Sage-Med-Preview-35B-A3B的培训损失。
光线痕迹显示阶梯级损失,而暗线显示平滑轨迹.

blocks.en: S1 Medical Training Data Construction and Curation
blocks.zh: S1 医疗培训数据构建和校正

blocks.en: S1.1 Data Sources, Inventory and Accounting
blocks.zh: S1.1 数据来源、库存和会计

blocks.en:
We assembled medical training records from more than 200 public datasets, over 120 million biomedical literature records and more than 100 private resources.
These resources included image–text collections, question-answering datasets, textbooks, journal articles, medical documents and specialty imaging collections.
MedTrinity-25M and PubMedQA illustrate the public multimodal and question-answering resources included in the collection [ 103 , 104 ] .
Source counts describe the underlying collections and documents.
For resources redistributed through aggregate datasets, the upstream source and the derived record were distinguished when organizing provenance.
blocks.zh:
我们从200多套公共数据集、1.2亿多份生物医学文献记录和100多份私人资源中收集了医疗培训记录。
这些资源包括图像文本集、问答数据集、教科书、期刊文章、医疗文件和特长成像集。
MedTrinity-25M和PubMedQA说明了收藏中所包含的公共多式和问答资源[103,104].
来源计数说明基本藏品和文件。
对于通过汇总数据集重新分配的资源,在整理出处时区分出上游来源和所得记录。

blocks.en:
A candidate record was a training item indexed by its intended stage family: pretraining (PT), supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or reinforcement learning (RL).
A record could contain one or more images, text alone, or a task with a reference target.
One source item could support several tasks or be considered for more than one stage.
The candidate collection comprised approximately 322.7 million records, including 233.8 million multimodal and 88.9 million text-only records (Fig. 3 b; Table S1 ).
The public/private provenance shares shown in Fig. 3 b were 91.2%/8.8% for PT and 55.7%/44.3% for SFT.
Provenance and multimodal/text-only composition describe different attributes of the same stage-family inventories.
blocks.zh:
一个候选记录是按预定阶段家庭编制索引的培训项目:预训、监督微调或强化学习。
记录可以包含一个或多个图像,仅包含文本,或者包含一个参考目标的任务.
一个来源项目可以支持几个任务,或考虑一个以上阶段。
候选人的收集包括大约3.227亿份记录,包括2.338亿份多式记录和8 890万份仅限文本记录(图3b;表S1)。
图3b显示的公/私来源股份PT为91.2%/8.8%,SFT为55.7%/44.3%。
证明和多式/只用文字的构成描述了同一阶段家庭清单的不同属性。

blocks.en: Table S1: Candidate inventories and filtered data pools. Record counts are in millions (M); token volumes are in billions (B). Candidate counts describe the stage-indexed inventory in Fig. 3 b. Retained-pool record counts are illustrative estimates, consistent with Fig. 3 c. Token volumes refer to the filtered pools rather than cumulative training exposure. The total row sums candidate records across stage families and is not a globally deduplicated corpus size.
blocks.zh: 表S1:候选清单和被过滤的数据库。 记录数量以百万(M);象征数量以十亿(B)。 考生计数在"Fig"中描述了阶段指数化的存货. 3b. 留存资产记录计数是说明性估计,与图表一致。 3克. 托肯卷指被过滤的池而并非累积的训练接触. 候选人总数记录了各个阶段家庭的情况,并非全球范围的累赘。

blocks.en:
We distinguished assembled candidates, records retained in a curated pool and records selected for a training recipe.
The intermediate and final retained-pool counts in Fig. 3 c are illustrative estimates of the three curation streams (Table S2 ).
The stages include exclusion, revision, verification and routing; removal from one stream therefore need not imply that the underlying source is unusable for every training purpose.
Actual training allocations are reported separately in Supplementary Section S1.7 .
Record counts and token volumes are complementary measures of corpus size and should not be interpreted as optimizer steps or repeated training exposures.
blocks.zh:
我们杰出的集合候选人、保存在库中的记录以及挑选用于培训的食谱的记录。
图3c中的中间和最后保留资源库计数是对三个资源流的说明性估计(表S2)。
这些阶段包括排除、修订、核查和路由;因此,从一流中去除不一定意味着基本来源不能用于每一项培训目的。
实际培训拨款在补充部分S1.7单独报告。
记录的清点量和象征量是衡量体积的补充性尺度,不应被解释为最优化的步骤或重复的培训暴露。

blocks.en: Table S2: Illustrative record counts along the six-stage curation pathways. All values are in millions and follow Fig. 3 c. S1–S6 denote the ordered operations within each family, not a shared filtering algorithm. Their definitions are given in Tables S4 , S5 and S6 . S6 gives the final retained-pool estimate.
blocks.zh: 表 S2: 说明性记录沿六级校正路径计算. 所有值以百万为单位,并遵循图3 c. S1-S6表示每个家族内命令的操作,而不是共享过滤算法. 它们的定义载于表S4、S5和S6。 S6给出了最后的保留库估计数.

blocks.en: S1.2 Source-aware Extraction and Evidence Organization
blocks.zh: S1.2 来源意识采掘和证据组织

blocks.en:
Processing followed two routes according to source structure: document extraction and dataset integration (Fig. 3 a).
For PDF documents, MinerU recovered text and figures [ 39 ] .
Recovered figures were linked to their original legends, available in-text figure references and relevant surrounding passages.
For compound figures, panel-specific associations were retained when panel identifiers and contextual references could be recovered.
Existing datasets instead underwent media and schema normalization while preserving their original supervision and available source context.
The retained evidence depended on the source type, as summarized in Table S3 .
blocks.zh:
处理按照源结构遵循了两条路线:文件提取和数据集集成(图3 a.
用于 PDF 文档, Miner U已恢复文本和数字 [39].
被找回的数字与他们的原始传说,可得到的正文数字参考和相邻的相关段落相联.
就复合数字而言,当可以找到专门小组的识别资料和背景参考资料时,保留了专门小组的协会。
相反,现有的数据集在保持原有监督和现有资料来源的同时,实现了媒体和计划正常化。
如表S3所概述,保留的证据取决于来源类型。

blocks.en: Table S3: Source-dependent processing and evidence preservation. Document extraction and dataset integration converged on source-linked records. Fields were retained when available; a missing document legend or spatial annotation was not replaced by an assumed reference.
blocks.zh: 表S3:依赖来源的处理和证据保存。 文件提取和数据集集成在与源相联的记录上汇合. 可用时保留了字段;缺失的文档图例或空间注释没有被假设的引用所取代.

blocks.en:
Source-linked evidence supported three operations: retaining usable supervision, refining deficient descriptions or responses, and synthesizing additional tasks supported by the source material.
Original evidence and revised targets served different roles: the source legend, annotation or passage supported verification, whereas a generated description or answer remained a candidate training target.
Refinement and synthesis therefore preserved the link to the underlying evidence rather than treating model-generated text as an independent reference.
blocks.zh:
与源相关联的证据支持了三项行动:保留可用监督、完善有缺陷的说明或答复以及综合来源材料所支持的其他任务。
原始证据和订正目标的作用不同:来源传说、注释或通过支持核查,而生成的描述或答复仍然是候选培训目标。
因此,完善和综合保留了与基本证据的联系,而不是将模型生成的文本作为独立参考。

blocks.en:
The resulting supervision comprised four groups: image descriptions, question answering and reasoning, report generation, and visual grounding.
Descriptions summarized supported visual content; question-answering and reasoning tasks required a reference answer grounded in the available evidence.
Reports preserved available section structure, including clinical history, findings and impression, without requiring every source to contain all sections.
Grounding required an applicable spatial annotation or localization reference; the mention of an organ in a caption alone was insufficient to define a bounding box or mask.
Modality, anatomical and medical-concept metadata were retained where available for subsequent selection and coverage analysis.
blocks.zh:
由此产生的监督由四组组成:图像描述、问答和推理、报告生成和视觉地面。
概述支持的视觉内容;问答和推理任务需要根据现有证据提供参考答案。
报告保留了现有的分科结构,包括临床史、调查结果和印象,而不要求每个来源包含所有分科。
铺设地基需要适用的空间注释或本地化参考;单在标题中提及一个器官不足以定义一个边框或口罩。
模式、解剖学和医学概念元数据在有可供选择和覆盖范围分析的地方保留。

blocks.en: S1.3 Pretraining Data Curation
blocks.zh: S1.3 预训数据校正

blocks.en:
The PT pathway emphasized medical relevance, reliable image–text associations and interpretable visual content.
Its six operations are defined in Table S4 and correspond to the PT row of Fig. 3 c.
Text-only records underwent the applicable usability, relevance and textual deduplication checks and bypassed image-dependent assessments.
The pathway retained an estimated 93.8 million records from 232.8 million candidates.
blocks.zh:
PT路径强调医疗相关性、可靠的图像-文本关联和可解释的视觉内容。
它的6个操作在表S4中定义,并对应了图3c的PT行.
仅文本记录经过了适用的可用性、相关性和文字分解检查并绕过图像依赖性评估。
该途径保留了估计2.328亿候选人的9 380万记录。

blocks.en: Table S4: Six-stage pretraining curation. Usability screening establishes whether a record can be processed; the final image-quality assessment determines whether visual degradation compromises interpretation. Caption revision is selective and is followed by renewed verification.
blocks.zh: 表S4:六阶段预训培养. 使用性筛选确定是否可以处理记录;最终的图像质量评估确定视觉退化是否妥协解释. 对说明的修订是有选择性的,然后是重新核查。

blocks.en:
Text duplicate detection combined MinHash and locality-sensitive hashing for candidate retrieval with Jaccard similarity of the corresponding token or shingle sets [ 105 , 106 ] .
Image difference hashes provided a complementary signal through Hamming distance between binary image signatures.
These signals identified candidate duplicates rather than defining supervision equivalence on their own.
For example, repeated question wording paired with different images did not establish a duplicate, and the same image could support distinct valid targets.
Duplicate assessment therefore considered the associated evidence and task content, preventing repeated source material from being confused with every legitimate reuse of that material.
blocks.zh:
文本重复检测结合了MinHash和对地点敏感的散列,供候选人检索,与相近的代号或环形套件相类似[105,106]。
图像差异散列通过二进制图像签名之间的汉明距离提供了互补信号.
这些信号指明了候选的重复,而不是自行界定监督的等同性。
例如,与不同图像相配的再三问题措辞并没有确立重复,同一图像可以支持不同的有效目标.
因此,重复评估考虑了相关证据和任务内容,防止了重复的源材料与该材料的每一次合法再利用相混淆。

blocks.en:
Caption refinement used Qwen-VL-2.5-235B with the image, original legend and available linked passages as context.
The revision sought a self-contained description while preserving the distinction between visible observations and interpretations supported by the source text.
Contextual information could resolve an anatomical reference or explain a panel, but did not by itself justify an unsupported visible finding.
The five-point review considered linguistic completeness, repetition, medical plausibility, image–text agreement and evidential support.
Short descriptions were revised when they lacked necessary information, rather than solely because they were short.
For multi-panel figures, panel-specific statements were retained only when the visual input and source context supported the association.
Rechecking evaluated the revised target against the original evidence; a more fluent caption was not sufficient for acceptance if its content remained unsupported.
blocks.zh:
Caption的改进使用了Quen-VL-2.5-235B,以图像,原传奇和可用的链接段落作为上下文.
修订寻求一种自成一体的描述,同时保留可见意见和来源文本所支持的解释之间的区别。
背景资料可以解决解剖学的参考或解释一个面板,但本身并不证明不支持的可见结论是合理的。
五点审查考虑了语言完整性、重复性、医学可信性、图像文本协议和证据支持。
简短的描述在缺乏必要信息时加以修订,而不仅仅是因为简短。
对于多小组的数字,仅在视觉输入和源上下文支持关联时才保留了专门小组的语句.
重新对照原始证据评估了订正目标;如果内容仍然不支持,则更流利的标题不足以被接受。

blocks.en: S1.4 Supervised Fine-tuning Data Curation
blocks.zh: S1.4 监督精细数据校正

blocks.en:
SFT curation required valid instruction–response examples with accurate, relevant and adequately supported targets.
The pathway processed 87.4 million candidates and produced an estimated retained pool of 69.6 million records.
Its six stages separated record validity, redundancy, overall demonstration quality, output requirements and substantive correctness (Table S5 ).
The consolidated pool supported subsequent curriculum selection rather than defining the composition of any individual SFT stage.
blocks.zh:
SFT课程需要有效的指导 - 有准确、相关和得到充分支持的目标的响应实例。
该途径处理了8 740万候选人,并产生了估计保留的6 960万记录。
其六个阶段分离了记录有效性、冗余性、总体演示质量、产出要求和实质性正确性(表S5)。
综合人才库支持随后的课程选择,而不是界定任何单个SFT阶段的构成。

blocks.en: Table S5: Six-stage supervised fine-tuning curation. Quality scoring evaluates the demonstration as a whole, format checks evaluate its required representation, and task verification evaluates substantive correctness against the available evidence.
blocks.zh: 表S5:六级监督微调校正. 质量评分评价整个演示,格式检查评价其必要的表述,任务核查对照现有证据评价实质性正确性.

blocks.en:
Quality assessment examined whether the response answered the instruction correctly and whether its claims were supported by the available image, text or reference.
The rubric covered medically incorrect statements, contradictions, unsupported claims, incomplete answers, off-topic responses and defective multimodal supervision.
A score of 1 denoted unusable or medically incorrect supervision, a score of 3 denoted usable supervision with minor defects, and a score of 5 denoted strong and complete supervision.
Passing the scoring threshold did not replace the subsequent format and task-verification checks.
Missing or unparsable scores did not constitute acceptance.
Task difficulty, expertise level and the presence of reasoning were treated separately from correctness, so a difficult or detailed response was not considered high quality solely on those grounds.
blocks.zh:
质量评估审查了答复是否正确答复了指示,以及其索赔是否得到现有图像、文本或参考资料的支持。
标题涵盖医学上不正确的陈述、自相矛盾、无依据的主张、不完整的答复、非专题答复和有缺陷的多式联运监督。
1分表示无法使用或医学上不正确的监督,3分表示有小缺陷的可用监督,5分表示有强而完整的监督.
通过评分阈值并不能取代随后的格式和任务核查检查。
缺失或无法分数并不构成接受。
任务困难、专门知识水平和推理的存在与正确性分开处理,因此,仅仅基于这些理由,很难或详细的答复不被认为是高质量的。

blocks.en:
Length and format checks reflected the expected output: an option label or organ name could be a complete answer, whereas a report or explanation required sufficient content for its task.
Structured responses were checked for the required fields and answer representation before their contents were compared with reference targets.
For image-grounded responses, verification concerned the agreement of stated findings with the available visual evidence or annotation.
For explicit reasoning, a correct conclusion did not compensate for fabricated intermediate observations or contradictory supporting statements.
Records entered the consolidated pool only after the applicable checks had been satisfied; later curriculum allocation determined which accepted examples were used in each SFT stage.
blocks.zh:
长度和格式检查反映了预期产出:选项标签或机关名称可以是完整的答案,而报告或解释则需要足够的内容来完成它的任务。
对所需领域的结构化答复进行了检查,并在将其内容与参考目标进行比较之前作了答复。
对于以图像为基础的答复,核查涉及将所述结论与现有视觉证据或注释一致。
就明确的理由而言,正确的结论不能补偿捏造的中间意见或相互矛盾的佐证陈述。
记录只有在完成了适用的检查之后才输入综合库;后来,课程分配确定每个SFT阶段使用哪些公认的实例。

blocks.en: S1.5 Reinforcement Learning Data Curation
blocks.zh: S1.5 强化学习数据校正

blocks.en:
RL curation prioritized tasks with reliable evaluation targets and informative outcomes under the answering policy.
The pathway processed 2.5 million candidates and produced an estimated retained pool of approximately 0.3 million records.
Reference validation established what constituted a supported answer before model responses were used to estimate difficulty.
The six stages are summarized in Table S6 , with task-conditioned evaluators in Table S7 .
These procedures describe offline data preparation and initial routing; policy updates and adaptive sampling during optimization belong to the training methodology.
blocks.zh:
评估优先任务,在答复政策下制定可靠的评价目标并取得翔实的成果。
该途径处理了250万候选人,并产生了约30万记录的预留库。
在使用模型答复来估计困难之前,参考验证确定了什么是得到支持的答案。
表S6概述了这六个阶段,表S7列出了有任务条件的评价人员。
这些程序说明了离线数据编制和初步路径;政策更新和优化期间的适应性取样属于培训方法。

blocks.en: Table S6: Six-stage reinforcement-learning data curation. Reference validation assesses the evaluation target, blind rollout assesses model responses, and final semantic checks examine agreement with the reference conclusion and supporting evidence before task or replay routing.
blocks.zh: 表S6:六级强化学习数据校正. 参考论证评估评价目标,盲目推出评估模型响应,最终语义检查在任务或重放路由前先检查与参考结论和佐证证据的协议.

blocks.en:
The evaluator was selected according to the task output rather than applying exact-string matching to all responses.
Reference validation examined the target itself, whereas response evaluation compared an independently generated answer with that validated target.
A previous model prediction was not sufficient to establish a reference without support from the source annotation or evidence.
For numerical and spatial tasks, the applicable units, coordinate conventions and agreement criteria formed part of the task definition.
For reports and explanatory answers, assessment considered clinically material content and its support in the reference.
blocks.zh:
评价员是根据任务产出选定的,而不是对所有答复进行精确的比对。
参考证明审查了目标本身,而答复评价则将独立生成的答案与经验证的目标进行比较。
以前的模型预测不足以在没有来源说明或证据支持的情况下确定参考。
对于数字和空间任务,适用单位、协调公约和协定标准构成任务定义的一部分。
对于报告和解释性答复,评估考虑了临床上的材料内容及其参考支持。

blocks.en: Table S7: Task-conditioned verification for RL curation. Rows describe output types and verification requirements, not mutually exclusive training datasets. A task may require both schema validation and content verification. Numerical tolerances and spatial agreement measures are task-specific.
blocks.zh: 表S7:RL校准任务核查. 行描述产出类型和核查要求,而不是相互排斥的培训数据集. 一项任务可能需要对计划进行验证并核实内容。 数字容忍度和空间协议措施是针对具体任务的。

Reference targets were available to the evaluator only.

blocks.en:
Final semantic checks complemented the earlier task evaluation by examining the agreement of the response, reference conclusion and available supporting evidence.
For explanatory responses, the assessment distinguished a supported conclusion from a superficially correct answer accompanied by contradictory or unsupported reasoning.
For reports, it emphasized clinically material content, including negation and anatomical specificity.
For grounding, semantic agreement did not replace the spatial verifier.
Eligible records were assigned to the corresponding task family or supervised replay use according to their available reference supervision.
The associated optimization objectives and replay schedules are described in the model-training methodology.
blocks.zh:
最后语义检查通过审查答复、参考结论和现有佐证的同意,补充了先前的任务评估。
关于解释性答复,评估将支持性结论与表面正确的答复区分开来,并附有相互矛盾或不支持的推理。
对于报告,报告强调临床上的物质内容,包括否定和解剖特性。
对于地平线,语义协议没有取代空间验证器。
合格记录被分配给相应的任务家庭,或根据其现有的参考监督,监督重播使用。
模型培训方法描述了相关的优化目标和重播时间表。

blocks.en: S1.6 Modality and Anatomical Characterization
blocks.zh: S1.6 模式和解剖特征

blocks.en:
Coverage analysis used the annotated image-reference subset of the curated multimodal PT and SFT data.
The counting unit was a labelled image instance associated with a record, without cross-record image deduplication for this analysis.
The distributions therefore describe the analysed image references rather than all 322.7 million candidate records or a collection of unique patients and examinations.
Unknown and Other labels were excluded separately for modality and anatomy, so the two attributes could have different eligible denominators.
The specific anatomical label Extremity-Other was retained within limbs and joints.
blocks.zh:
覆盖度分析使用了所编译的多式PT和SFT数据的附加说明的图像参考子集.
计数单位是一个标签上与记录相联的图像实例,对于这一分析来说,没有交叉记录的图像分解.
因此,分布描述的是经过分析的图像参考文献,而不是所有3.227亿候选人记录或独特的病人和检查的集合。
未知等标签被分别排除用于模式和解剖学,因此这两个属性可能具有不同的合格分母.
特定的解剖标签 " Extremity -- -- 其他 " 保留在肢体和关节内。

blocks.en:
We grouped 51 fine-grained modality labels into 15 categories and 31 anatomical labels into 10 categories (Tables S9 and S10 ).
These operational groupings summarize acquisition technology, clinical context and anatomical location; they do not constitute a proposed medical classification standard.
Each listed fine-grained label maps to one displayed parent group.
Non-specific labels were not assigned a more precise organ or subtype without supporting information.
blocks.zh:
我们把51个细纹模式标签分为15个类别,把31个解剖标签分为10个类别(表S9和S10)。
这些业务分组总结了获取技术、临床背景和解剖位置;它们不构成拟议的医疗分类标准。
每张列出细纹标签地图给一个显示的父组.
没有佐证信息,非特定标签没有被分配到更精确的机关或子类型.

Percentages for the remaining categories are renormalized to sum to 100%, as in Fig. 3 d. n n denotes the number of mapped fine-grained labels. Groups are ordered as in the figure.

blocks.en:
Modality abbreviations and boundaries. WSI, whole-slide imaging; IHC, immunohistochemistry; CR, computed radiography; DX, digital radiography; DXA, dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry; CBCT, cone-beam CT; RCM, reflectance confocal microscopy; NM, nuclear medicine; PET, positron emission tomography; SPECT, single-photon emission CT; FFA, fundus fluorescein angiography; ICGA, indocyanine-green angiography; DSA, digital subtraction angiography; OCT, optical coherence tomography; OCTA, OCT angiography; ERCP, endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography; ECG, electrocardiography; EEG, electroencephalography.
The Angiography display group includes DSA and Fluoroscopy, whereas FFA and ICGA remain in the non-OCT ophthalmic group.
PET-CT and PET-MRI map to nuclear medicine, OCT-Skin maps to OCT, and ClinicalSkinPhoto maps to clinical photography.
These assignments preserve the stated hierarchy without inferring acquisition categories from anatomy alone.

WSI,全滑成像;IHC,免疫史化学;CR,计算射线学;DX,数字射线学;DXA,双能X射线吸收测量;CBCT,锥束CT;RCM,反射交集显微镜;NM,核医学;PET,正电子排放成像;SPECT,单光子排放CT;FA,为血管造影学中的氟化物基金;ICGA,Indocyanine-Green Agiograph;DSA,数字减值血管造影;OCT,光学一致性;OCTA,OCTA血管造影;ERCP,内分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分仪;ECG,ECG,电心分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分光分
Angiography显示组包括DSA和Fluoroscopy,而FFA和ICGA则仍保留在非OCT眼科组.
PET-CT和PET-MRI映射到核医学,OCT-相片映射到OCT,临床相片映射到临床摄影.
这些转让保留了所述等级,而不从解剖学中推断购置类别。

Unknown and Other, accounting for 1.65% and 10.41% of the full subset, respectively, are excluded, whereas Extremity-Other is retained in the limbs and joints group. Percentages for the remaining categories are renormalized to sum to 100%, as in Fig. 3 f. n n denotes the number of mapped fine-grained labels.

blocks.en:
Anatomical boundaries. Eye/orbit and oral/maxillofacial labels were reported separately from the head-and-neck group.
Skin, vascular and whole-body labels retained their original scope and were not assigned to a more specific region without supporting annotation.
blocks.zh:
解剖学的界限. 眼/轨道和口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口
皮肤,血管和全身的标签保留了原来的范围,没有支持注释,没有被分配到更具体的区域.

blocks.en:
Pathology (24.67%), MRI (23.29%) and CT (23.03%) were the most frequent modality groups in the analysed subset.
Head and neck (31.22%), thorax (26.87%) and abdomen/pelvis (20.02%) were the most frequent anatomical groups.
To complement these marginal distributions, sampled image representations were projected with t-distributed stochastic neighbor embedding (t-SNE) [ 107 ] and coloured by modality or anatomical label (Fig. 3 e,g).
Image features were extracted with the BiomedCLIP model family, which pairs a PubMedBERT text encoder with a ViT-B/16 vision encoder [ 108 ] .
Fine-grained labels such as WSI, PET-CT, Brain and Retina in the projection panels map to the parent categories in the adjacent distribution charts.
The projections illustrate local structure in the sampled representations; their point densities and two-dimensional distances were not used to estimate corpus prevalence, classification accuracy or semantic purity.
blocks.zh:
病理学(24.67%)、核磁共振(23.29%)和CT(23.03%)是分析子集中最常见的模式组。
头部和颈部(31.22%),胸口(26.87%)和腹部/骨盆(20.02%)是解剖学最常见的组分.
为了补充这些边际分布,以t-分布相邻嵌入(t-SNE) [107] 并用模式或解剖标签来取色(图3等)来投放被抽样的图像表示.
图像特性被取出与BiomedCLIP模型家族,该家族将一个PubMedBERT文本编码器与一个Vit-B/16视觉编码器相配 [108].
在投影板上将WSI,PET-CT,Brain和Retina等精细的标签映射到相邻分布图中的母类.
这些预测在抽样表述中说明了地方结构;其点密度和二维相距没有用于估计海龟的流行程度、分类准确性或语义纯度。

blocks.en: S1.7 Training Allocation, Overlap and Data Governance
blocks.zh: S1.7 培训分配、重叠和数据治理

blocks.en:
Training datasets were assembled from the curated pools according to the learning objectives and target data composition of each stage.
From the approximately 93.8 million-record PT-family pool, we selected 83.8 million records for pretraining and 28.1 million for mid-training.
The mid-training set comprised 18.1 million records also used during pretraining and 10.0 million additional records from the curated pool.
For SFT, the approximately 69.6 million-record pool served as a common source for constructing the three curriculum datasets.
Stage-specific downsampling determined the number of records selected from each data group according to its prescribed contribution to the target mixture.
This procedure allowed the composition and size of the training set to vary across curriculum stages, yielding 6.1 million, 9.6 million and 6.2 million records for Stages 1–3, respectively.
The resulting training allocations are summarized in Table S11 .
blocks.zh:
培训数据集是根据每个阶段的学习目标和目标数据组成,从统筹库中收集的。
我们从大约9 380万创纪录的PT-家庭人才库中挑选了8 380万张记录用于预训,2 810万张记录用于中训。
中级培训包括1 810万份在预训期间也使用的记录和1 000万份来自管理池的记录。
对于SFT来说,大约6 960万个记录库是构建三个课程数据集的共同来源。
具体阶段的下取样根据其规定的对目标混合物的贡献确定从每个数据组中选择的记录数量。
这一程序使培训单元的组成和规模因课程阶段而异,在第一阶段至第三阶段分别创造了610万、960万和620万的记录。
由此产生的培训拨款汇总于表S11。

blocks.en:
The five RL task allocations comprised 132K closed-primary, 50K short/structured, 30K clinical-reasoning, 37K report-generation and 49K grounding records, totalling 298K task-indexed training records.
This scale is consistent with the approximately 0.3 million-record RL pool shown in Fig. 3 c, without establishing an exact correspondence between every retained record and a single downstream use.
The task-family allocations describe actual selected records; the preceding curation rules separately identify eligibility for RL and supervised replay.
Replay schedules, curriculum mixtures and optimization objectives are specified in the model-training methodology.
blocks.zh:
5份RL任务分配包括132K次封闭式初级、50K次短/结构化、30K次临床推理、37K报告生成和49K次地基记录,共计298K次任务索引培训记录。
这个比例表与图3c所示的约30万个记录的RL池一致,没有确定每个保留记录与单一下游用途之间的确切对应.
任务-家庭分配描述实际选定的记录;前述管理规则分别指明了参加RL的资格并监督重播.
模式培训方法规定了重播时间表、课程组合和优化目标。

blocks.en: Table S11: Training data allocation across stages and RL task families. Record counts are reported for pretraining, mid-training, the three SFT stages and the five RL task families. M, million; K, thousand.
blocks.zh: 表S11:各阶段培训数据分配和RL任务家庭。 预训、中训、SFT三个阶段和五个RL任务家庭的记录点数都报告。 M,百万;克,千.

blocks.en:
Each training record retained a link to its originating dataset or document and to the available source evidence, including images, legends, annotations and supporting passages.
These links associated original material with the descriptions and tasks derived from it, allowing refined and synthesized supervision to be traced to its evidential basis.
The original evidence also supported subsequent verification of revised training targets.
Source identifiers connected tasks derived from the same underlying material, while record identifiers tracked the individual training items selected for each stage.
This organization supported record-level accounting of reuse across curricula and source-level tracing of shared evidence across different task formulations.
blocks.zh:
每个培训记录都保留了与其原始数据集或文件的链接,并保留了与现有来源证据的链接,包括图像、传说、说明和辅助段落。
这些联系将原始材料与从中得出的描述和任务联系起来,使完善和综合的监督能够追溯到其证据基础。
原始证据还支持随后对订正的培训目标进行核查。
源识别符连接了来自同一基本材料的任务,而记录识别符跟踪每个阶段选定的个别培训项目。
该组织支持在记录一级核算不同课程的再利用情况,支持在来源一级追踪不同任务表述的共同证据。

blocks.en:
Source-level documentation recorded provenance, access conditions, permitted research uses and redistribution terms.
These conditions provided the basis for organizing access to original materials and determining the availability of associated training records.
For resources containing clinical information, the documentation also covered applicable de-identification requirements.
Links to the originating resource were preserved through retention, refinement and task synthesis, allowing access and sharing decisions for derived records to be assessed against the corresponding source conditions.
blocks.zh:
原始文献记录了来源、获取条件、允许的研究用途和再分配术语。
这些条件为安排查阅原始材料和确定是否有相关培训记录提供了依据。
对于包含临床信息的资源,文件还涉及适用的去识别要求。
通过保留、改进和任务综合,保留了与原始资源的联系,从而能够根据相应的来源条件评估衍生记录的取用和分享决定。

blocks.en: S1.8 Efficient Pretraining with XTuner on the Ascend A3 Supernode
blocks.zh: S1.8 在 Ascend A3 超级节点上使用 XTuner 的高效预训

blocks.en: On the Ascend A3 supernode, the XTuner-based setup achieved approximately 3 × 3\times the continual-pretraining throughput of the evaluated framework baselines, including SWIFT [ 109 ] , for Sage-Med-Preview-35B-A3B. XTuner combines fully sharded data parallelism (FSDP) with three optimizations that reduce peak device memory, overlap communication with computation, and balance work across data-parallel ranks.
blocks.zh: 在Ascend A3超级节点上,基于XTuner的设置实现了大约3×3\的连续培训通过量,包括Sage-Med-Preview-35B-A3B的SWIFT[109]. XTuner结合了被完全压缩了的数据并行主义(FSDP),并有三个优化,减少了峰值设备内存,与计算重叠的通信,并平衡了跨数据平行排位的工作.

blocks.en: XTuner uses a Liger-inspired chunked loss that computes the output projection and cross-entropy over blocks of token positions, limiting how much of the vocabulary-sized logits tensor must reside in device memory at once. A MindSpeed-inspired asynchronous activation swap transfers activations saved for recomputation to host memory during the forward pass. During backpropagation, the activations for the preceding layer are prefetched while the current layer executes and released after use. With swap_optimizer=True , optimizer states reside on the host between updates and return to the device for optimizer.step . TorchNPU’s cross-stream memory reuse ( MULTI_STREAM_MEMORY_REUSE=2 ) helps reclaim device memory when computation and communication overlap. Together, these measures allow longer packed sequences and reduce the need for higher degrees of sequence parallelism.
blocks.zh: XTuner 使用一个由 Liger 启发而成的块块损失来计算输出投影,并在符号位置的块上交叉切入,从而限制词汇大小的对数分数必须同时存在于设备内存中的数量. 一个MindSpeed所启发的同步活化互换活化被保存在前传期间用于重构以托管内存的活化. 在回放过程中,对上层的活化被先发制人,而电流层则执行后放出. 使用互换_优化= True, 优化器状态位于更新和返回设备之间的主机上进行优化. step . 火炬 NPU的跨流内存再利用(MULTI_STREAM_MEmory_REUSE=2)帮助在计算和通信重叠时恢复设备内存. 这些措施加在一起,可以使打包时间更长的序列,并减少对更高程度序列平行性的需求.

blocks.en: FSDP prefetches the next layer’s parameters while the current layer computes. The memory savings allow longer sequences, increasing the computation available to hide all-gather latency on the A3 supernode’s high-bandwidth interconnect. XTuner enables HCCL zero-copy collectives ( TORCH_HCCL_ZERO_COPY=1 ) with expandable virtual-memory segments ( PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True ) and sizes communication buffers according to each process group’s traffic. The configuration uses 4 MB for vision-encoder and zero-copy groups, 800 MB for language-model expert-parallel groups, and 512 MB for language-model data-parallel groups. Topology-aware rank placement keeps more data-parallel traffic on intra-node links, reducing the estimated all-gather and reduce-scatter time by about half under the analyzed topology. When expert parallelism is enabled, Intra-Node Domino-EP reduces per-layer parameter aggregation traffic and overlaps the additional all-to-all communication with computation.
blocks.zh: FSDP 预选下一层的参数, 而当前层则计算 。 内存节省允许更长的序列,增加可用的计算,以隐藏A3超级节点高带宽互联上的全加太空闲. XTuner 启用 HCCL 零拷贝集合 (TORCH_HCCL_ZERO_COPY=1),有可扩展的虚拟-记忆片段(PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=可扩展-segments:True),并根据每个进程组的流量大小通信缓冲. 该配置使用4 MB用于视觉编码器和零拷贝组,800 MB用于语言模型专家平行组,512 MB用于语言模型数据平行组. 地貌学-意识分级布置使所分析地貌下的数据在地道内部链接上保持了更多的数据平行流量,将所估计的全藻并减少约一半的散射时间. 当专家并行主义被启用后,In-Node Domino-EP会减少每层参数聚合流量,并会将额外的全通通信与计算相重叠.

blocks.en: Packed batches with equal token counts can have substantially different attention costs. For example, a pack of 32 sequences of 1K tokens requires much less attention computation than a pack of two sequences of 16K tokens. XTuner reorders already-packed batches within short windows so that their longest constituent sequences are comparable across data-parallel ranks at each step. This reduces synchronization delays while limiting changes to the overall data order. At the operator level, XTuner replaces indexAiCore in the loss path with IndexSelect_GatherV3 , uses foreach optimizer updates to reduce kernel-launch overhead, and applies torch_npu.npu_rotary_mul directly to the [B, S, N, D] layout to eliminate two transposes. Binding runtime thread groups to CPU cores and preloading jemalloc further reduce host-side overhead.
blocks.zh: 数量相等的包装批次的注意成本可能大相径庭。 例如,一包32个序列的1K令牌比一包2个序列的16K令牌更不需要注意计算. XTuner在短窗口内重新排列已包装的批次,以便其最长的组成序列在每一步骤的数据平行分级上具有可比性. 这减少了同步延迟,同时限制了整体数据顺序的改变. 在操作员层面,XTuner将损失路径中的IndexAiCore替换为IndexSelect_GatherV3,使用每个优化器的更新来减少内核发射高空,并将火炬_npu.npu_rotary_mul直接应用到[B,S,N,D]布局上去去除两个转子. 将运行时间线程组绑入CPU核心并预装jemalloc会进一步减少主机侧面的间接费用.

blocks.en: S2 Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: S2 评价细节

blocks.en: S2.1 Benchmark Overview
blocks.zh: S2.1 基准概览

blocks.en: Table S12 summarizes the modality, data format, size, subtasks, task type, metric, computation, and judge model of the 61 public benchmarks, and Table S13 gives the same information for the 13 private benchmarks. Counting task definitions, the public benchmarks contain 222 tasks, including one in ClinHallu. The private benchmarks contain 16 tasks. We integrate all benchmarks into a unified evaluation framework. For each benchmark, we follow the official data split, evaluate on its test set, and exclude questions with incomplete information or corrupted data. For report generation benchmarks, we remove samples whose findings or impression section is empty. For general-domain benchmarks, namely MMMU, MMMU-Pro, HLE, MMLU-Pro, SuperGPQA-Med, CMMLU, and MMLU, we evaluate only on their medical subsets. PlaTiF, UWF-DR, and SMC-LUD are originally classification datasets, and we convert their class labels into multiple-choice questions.
blocks.zh: 表S12概述了61项公共基准的模式、数据格式、规模、子任务、任务类型、计量、计算和判断模式,表S13为13项私人基准提供了同样的信息。 在计算任务定义时,公共基准包含222项任务,包括克林哈卢的一项. 私人基准包括16项任务。 我们把所有基准纳入统一的评价框架。 对于每个基准,我们遵循官方数据分割,评价其测试集,排除信息不完整或数据被损坏的问题。 对于报告生成基准,我们删除其发现或印象部分为空的样本。 对于一般领域的基准,即MMMU、MMMU-Pro、HLE、MMLU-Pro、SuperGPQA-Med、CMMLU和MMLU,我们只对其医疗子集进行评估。 PlaTiF,UWF-DR,和SMC-LUD最初是分类数据集,我们把他们的类标签转换成多选题.

blocks.en: We score most benchmarks with rule-based matching and use LLM judges for open-ended answers in 16 public benchmarks. Earlier judge models such as GPT-4o and GPT-4 have been retired, so we use GPT-6-Luna-High as their replacement. GPT-6-Luna-High judges 14 of these benchmarks, namely VQA-RAD, SLAKE, PathVQA, MMOral-OPG-Bench, OphthalWeChat, SurgeryVideoQA, HLE-Med, RareBench, MedR-Bench, Endometriosis Ultrasound, BC-MultiSet, U2-BENCH, LungCURE, and ClinHallu. For HealthBench and OmniBrainBench, we keep GPT-4.1 as the official judge. We evaluate report generation benchmarks with natural language generation metrics, namely BLEU [ 99 ] , ROUGE [ 101 ] , and METEOR [ 100 ] , together with RaTEScore [ 102 ] . None of these metrics requires a judge prompt. RaTEScore extracts medical entities with RaTE-NER-DeBERTa and matches them with BioLORD-2023-C.
blocks.zh: 在16个公共基准中,我们以基于规则的比对来评分大多数基准,并使用LLM法官进行开放式解答。 更早的裁判模型如GPT-4o和GPT-4已经退役了,所以我们使用GPT-6-Luna-High来取而代之. GPT-6-Luna-高级法官 14项基准,即VQA-RAD、SLAKE、PathVQA、MMORAL-OPG-Bench、OthyWeChat、外科 VideoQA, HLE-Med, Rare Bench, Medr-Bench, Endometriosis Ultrasound, BC-MultiSet, U2-BENCH, LungCURE, 和克林哈卢. 为了健康奔驰和OmniBrain奔驰,我们保留GPT-4.1作为正式裁判. 我们用自然语言生成的衡量标准评价报告生成基准,即BLEU[99]、ROUGE[101]和METEOR[100],以及RATEScore[102]。 这些衡量标准都不需要法官迅速作出。 RTEScore与RATE-NER-DEBERTA一起取出医疗实体,并与BioLORD-2023-C相匹配.

blocks.en: Table S12 : Overview of the 61 public benchmarks in twelve categories. The overview includes the 45 core benchmarks, the 15 additional benchmarks of Appendix S2.3 , and ClinHallu. Modality lists the imaging modalities or clinical text types, and Data format describes how the data are presented to the model. Size gives the number of evaluated samples, with a breakdown by splits, subsets, or settings where applicable. Subtasks gives the number of subtasks in each benchmark and summarizes the clinical tasks they cover. Metric gives the score reported in the result tables, Computation describes how the score is obtained, and Judge model gives the LLM that scores open-ended answers, or the models that RaTEScore uses to extract and match medical entities. Rule-based matching extracts the predicted option or short answer from the response and compares it with the reference answer. MCQ: multiple-choice question; QA: question answering; EN: English; ZH: Chinese; mIoU: mean IoU between the predicted box and the reference box; ISR: in-stent restenosis; nRMSE: normalized root mean square error. Appendix S2.6 gives the judge prompts.
blocks.zh: 表S12:61项12类公共基准概览。 概览包括45个核心基准、附录S2.3的15个额外基准和ClinHallu。 模式列出了成像模式或临床文本类型,"数据"格式描述了数据是如何呈现给模型的. 大小给出了被评价的样本数量,并按分出,子集,或酌情设置分出. 子任务给出了每个基准中的子任务数量并概括了它们覆盖的临床任务. Metric给出了结果表中所报的分数,计算法描述了分数是如何获得的,Judge模型给出了评分开放式答案的LLM,或者RATEScore用于提取和匹配医疗实体的模型. 基于规则的匹配从响应中提取出预测选项或短答,并和参考答案进行比较. MCQ:多选择问题; 质量保证:回答问题; EN:英文;ZH:中文;mIOU:预想框和参考框之间的意为IOU; ISR:in-stent respension;nRMSE:正统根正方形出错. 附录S2.6给出了法官的提示.

blocks.en: S2.2 Private Benchmarks
blocks.zh: S2.2 私人基准

blocks.en: Table S13 lists the modality, data format, size, subtasks, task type, metric, computation, judge model, and source institution of the 13 private benchmarks, which cover 16 clinical tasks. The ethics approvals of the private benchmarks are given below, and the PET/CT benchmark uses public images.
blocks.zh: 表S13列出了13个私人基准的模式,数据格式,大小,子任务,任务类型,度量,计算,判断模型,以及源机构,这些基准涵盖了16个临床任务. 私人基准的道德操守核准情况如下,PET/CT基准使用公共图像。

blocks.en: Table S13 : Overview and source institutions of the 13 private benchmarks used to evaluate Sage-Med-Preview and the available baselines. The columns follow Table S12 , and Source institution gives the hospital or institution that provides each benchmark. “Same as MIMIC-CXR” refers to the report generation metrics of the MIMIC-CXR row in Table S12 . The PET/CT images are drawn from public datasets, and physicians at Nanfang Hospital write the reference reports. MCQ: multiple-choice question; EHR: electronic health record.
blocks.zh: 表S13:用于评价Sage-Med-Preview的13个私人基准和现有基线的概况和来源机构。 各栏沿用表S12,来源机构给出提供每个基准的医院或机构。 “与MIMIC-CXR相同”,是指表S12中MIMIMIC-CXR一行的报告生成计量标准。 PET/CT图像取自公共数据集,由南芳医院的医生撰写参考报告. MCQ:多选择问题; EHR:电子健康记录。

blocks.en: S2.3 Additional Specialized-modality Benchmarks
blocks.zh: S2.3 额外的专门模式基准

blocks.en: We add 15 public benchmarks that evaluate specialized modalities, and they contain 53 clinical tasks. Three of them are published benchmarks, namely EndoSCOP-V, U2-BENCH, and LungCURE. The other 12 are open-source datasets that we convert into multiple-choice, grounding, or open-ended questions according to their labels, namely Brain MRI Motion Artifact, Pulmonary Ultrasound Tumor, BDCXR-3257, MR-US Prostate Holdout, MMOTU, RCC-AID, Endometriosis Ultrasound, Coronary Angiography ISR, Cesarean Scar Defect, EAY131-Tumor-Annotations, FAR-POLYP-SEG, and BC-MultiSet. All of these benchmarks and source datasets were released in 2026 or later. They cover brain MRI, renal CT, coronary X-ray angiography, chest X-ray, tumor imaging on CT, MRI, and PET, prostate, ovarian, pelvic, transvaginal, pulmonary, and multi-organ ultrasound, colonoscopy, endoscopy video, breast histopathology, and clinical records of lung cancer. Table S12 lists them under their categories with their modality, data format, size, subtasks, task type, metric, computation, and judge model, and Table 3 reports their results.
blocks.zh: 我们增加了15项评估专门方式的公共基准,其中包括53个临床任务。 其中3项是公布的基准,即远东SCOP-V、U2-BENCH和LungCURE。 其他12个是开源数据集,我们根据它们的标签将其转换成多选择、打地或开放式问题,即:脑磁共振动动脉动、肺部超声波肿瘤、BDCXR-3257、MR-US前列腺管、MMOTU、RCC-AID、Endometriosis Ultrasound、Coronary Angiography ISR、Cesarian Scar Defe、EAY131-Tumor-Annotations、FAR-POLYP-SEG和BC-Multierset。 所有这些基准和源数据集都于2026年或以后发布. 它们涵盖脑磁共振、肾上腺CT、冠状X射线血管造影、胸X射线、CT上肿瘤成像、核磁共振、前列腺、卵巢、骨盆、转子、肺和多器官超声波、结肠镜、内分镜视频、乳房组织病理学和肺癌临床记录。 表S12按其模式、数据格式、规模、子任务、任务类型、计量、计算和判断模型列出这些类别,表3报告了结果。

blocks.en: S2.4 Composition of Figure 1
blocks.zh: S2.4 图1的组成

blocks.en: Figure 1 summarizes the evaluation in ten panels arranged in two rows. The first row contains the two overall panels, Multimodal benchmarks and Text-only benchmarks, followed by comprehensive multimodal understanding, specialized multimodal understanding, and comprehensive text understanding. The second row contains report generation, medical visual grounding, knowledge-intensive understanding, medical reasoning, and the private multi-center benchmarks. Table S14 lists the benchmarks, metric, and compared models of every panel. All panels follow one aggregation rule. Within a benchmark, we first average its subsets, settings, or sub-metrics with equal weight to obtain one score, and we then average the benchmark scores of a panel with equal weight. A benchmark enters a panel only when every model drawn in that panel has complete scores on it, so all bars of a panel average the same benchmarks. All values are shown on a 0 to 100 scale with one decimal.
blocks.zh: 图1总结了分两行排列的10个小组的评价。 第一行载有两个整体的专题小组,即多式联运基准和仅限文本基准,然后是全面多式联运理解、专门多式联运理解和全面文本理解。 第二行包括报告生成、医疗视觉定位、知识密集型理解、医疗推理和私人多中心基准。 表S14列出了每个面板的基准、度量和比较模型。 所有小组都遵循一个汇总规则。 在一个基准内,我们首先平均其子集,设置,或分量相等的子集,以获得一个分数,然后我们平均一个分量相等的面板的基准分数. 基准只有在从该面板中抽取的每个模型上都有完整的分数时才进入面板,所以面板上的所有栏都平均相同的基准. 所有值均以0至100等分大小显示,小数为一.

blocks.en: The Multimodal benchmarks panel averages the 31 public benchmarks whose inputs include images or videos. Every benchmark with image input enters this panel, including HLE-Med and LiveClin, because their results are not split by input modality, and MedXpertQA contributes only its MM subset. The Text-only benchmarks panel averages the 14 public benchmarks of the result tables that are not in the multimodal panel, and MedXpertQA contributes only its Text subset. The two panels therefore cover 44 of the 61 public benchmarks in Table S12 . HealthBench does not enter the text panel because ClinFusion-32B lacks its scores, and MedR-Bench does not enter because ClinFusion-32B, Claude-Opus-4.6, and Gemini-2.5-Flash lack complete scores on its four settings. The 15 additional specialized-modality benchmarks of Appendix S2.3 are not part of Figure 1 because the proprietary models are not evaluated on them. The two overall panels average benchmarks with different metrics, so they report an average score instead of accuracy.
blocks.zh: 多式联运基准小组平均为31个公共基准,其投入包括图像或录像。 每一个带有图像输入的基准都进入了这个面板,包括HLE-Med和LiveClin,因为其结果没有被输入模式所分割,而MedXpertQA只贡献了它的MM子集. 仅文本基准面板平均为非多模式面板结果表的14个公开基准,MedXpertQA只贡献其文本子集. 因此,这两个小组涵盖表S12所列61项公共基准中的44项。 Health Bench由于ClinFusion-32B缺乏分数而未入出文本面板,而MedR-Bench由于ClinFusion-32B,克洛德-Opus-4.6,和双子座-2.5-Flash四个设置缺乏完整分数而未入出. 附录S2.3中新增的15个专用模式基准不是图1的一部分,因为对专有模式没有进行评价。 两个总的小组的平均基准有不同的衡量标准,因此它们报告的是平均分数而不是准确度。

blocks.en: Table S14 : Composition of the ten panels of Figure 1 . Each row gives the benchmarks of a panel, the metric together with the averaging within and across benchmarks, and the compared models. Within each benchmark, subsets, settings, and sub-metrics are averaged with equal weight, and the benchmark scores of a panel are then averaged with equal weight. A benchmark enters a panel only when every model of that panel has complete scores on it. All values are shown on a 0 to 100 scale with one decimal. Default models: Sage-Med-Preview-35B-A3B, Hulu-Med-30B-A3B, Hulu-Med-235B-A22B, ClinFusion-32B, GPT-6.2-Sol, Claude-Opus-4.6, and Gemini-2.5-Flash. Private benchmark names follow Table S13 . mIoU: mean IoU between the predicted box and the reference box.
blocks.zh: 表S14:图1的十个小组的组成 每行给出一个面板的基准、衡量标准以及基准内和跨基准的平均数以及比较模型。 在每个基准内,子集,设置,和分量均以等分权重为平均值,而一面板的基准分数再以等分权重为平均值. 基准只有在每组模型上都有完整的分数时才进入面板。 所有值均以0至100等分大小显示,小数为一. 默认模式 : Sage-Med-Preview-35B-A3B,Hulu-Med-30B-A3B,Hulu-Med-235B-A22B,ClinFusion-32B,GPT-6.2-Sol,克洛德-Opus-4.6和双子座-2.5-Flash. 私人基准名称见表S13。 mIoU:指预测框和参考框之间的IoU.

blocks.en:
Every panel compares seven models. By default, these are Sage-Med-Preview-35B-A3B, Hulu-Med-30B-A3B, Hulu-Med-235B-A22B, ClinFusion-32B, GPT-6.2-Sol, Claude-Opus-4.6, and Gemini-2.5-Flash, which include one model from each proprietary series. Claude-Opus-5.5, Gemini-4-Argon, and GPT-6.2-Astra are evaluated only on the 15 specialized multimodal understanding benchmarks. The specialized panel therefore shows Claude-Opus-5.5, Gemini-4-Argon, and GPT-6.2-Astra in place of Claude-Opus-4.6, Gemini-2.5-Flash, and GPT-6.2-Sol, and the other panels keep the earlier models, which have complete results there.
Icons with an amber frame mark the latest proprietary models, including GPT-6.2-Sol, Claude-Opus-5.5, and Gemini-4-Argon, and a purple frame marks GPT-6.2-Astra, which separates it from GPT-6.2-Sol.
blocks.zh:
每个面板比较七个模型. 默认情况下,这些是Sage-Med-Preview-35B-A3B,Hulu-Med-30B-A3B,Hulu-Med-235B-A22B,ClinFusion-32B,GPT-6.2-Sol,克洛德-Opus-4.6,和双子座-2.5-Flash,它们包括每个专有系列的一个模型. Claude-Opus-5.5,双子座-4-Argon和GPT-6.2-Astra只根据15个专门的多式联运理解基准进行评价。 因此,专门小组显示克洛德-奥普斯-5.5,双子座-4-Argon,和GPT-6.2-Astra取代克洛德-奥普斯-4.6,双子座2.5-Flash,和GPT-6.2-Sol,其他小组保留了较早的模型,这些模型在那里有完整的结果.
有琥珀框的图标标记了最新的专有型号,包括GPT-6.2-Sol,Claude-Opus-5.5和双子座-4-Argon等,并有一个紫色框标记了GPT-6.2-Astra,将其与GPT-6.2-Sol相分离.

blocks.en: S2.5 Inference Configuration
blocks.zh: S2.5 推论配置

blocks.en: Table S15 lists the inference settings of each model group. We serve all open-source autoregressive models with vLLM, and we query proprietary models through their official APIs with the same decoding configuration. The low temperature and top- p p give near-greedy decoding, and the budget of 16,384 new tokens lets thinking models complete their reasoning chains. Diffusion large language models generate text through iterative denoising, so we keep the default configuration released with each model, including the number of denoising steps and the block length.
blocks.zh: 表S15列出了每个模型组的推论设置. 我们服务所有具有vLLM的开源自转模型,我们通过它们的官方API查询专利模型,其解码配置相同. 低温和上-p给出了相近光滑的解码,而16,384个新令牌的预算让思考模型完成他们的推理链. 分化出大语言模型通过迭代去诺化生成文本,因此我们保留了每个模型的默认配置,包括去诺化步骤的数量和块长度.

blocks.en: Table S15 : Inference configuration of each model group. Max new tokens limits the length of each generated response and excludes the input. Diffusion large language models are SDAR-Chat, Lumina-DiMOO, and MMaDA-Base.
blocks.zh: 表S15:每个模型组的推论配置. 最大新令牌限制每个生成响应的长度并排除输入. 传播大型语言模型有SDAR-Chat,Lumina-DIMOO和MMADA-Base.

blocks.en: S2.6 Prompt Templates
blocks.zh: S2.6 快速模板

blocks.en: We build the prompts of all multiple-choice and open-ended benchmarks from the four templates below. Fields in braces are filled with the question and options of each sample, and the number of lettered options follows the benchmark. The reasoning templates ask the model to think inside <think></think> tags and to put the final answer in \boxed{} . Report generation, long clinical cases, and multi-turn diagnosis use benchmark-specific templates.
blocks.zh: 我们从以下四个模板建立所有多重选择和开放式基准的提示。 括号中的字段充满每个样本的问题和选项,字母选项的数量遵循基准. 推理模板要求模型在"thinkQQ/think"标记内思考,并将最后的答案放入\boxedQQ. 报告生成,长期临床病例,多回合诊断使用特定基准模板.

blocks.en: ⬇ Your job is to look at a conversation and a rubric item , and score the last turn ( i . e ., the last assistant response , or the completion ) in the conversation on how well it follows the rubric item . # Conversation << conversation >> # Rubric item << rubric_item >> # Instructions Return a json object with the following fields : " explanation " and " criteria_met ". - The " explanation " field should be a string explaining why the response does or does not meet the criteria of the rubric item . - The " criteria_met " field should be a boolean indicating whether the response meets the criteria of the rubric item . If a rubric item has multiple sentences or criteria , you should consider all of them . If any of the criteria is not met , the answer should be false . Only return true is all of the criteria are met . - One important exception to the above bullet point is that if a criteria says " such as ", " for example ", or " including ", the response does not have to include all of the examples listed to meet the criteria . For example , if the criteria says " States that oral iron supplements can lead to unpleasant gastrointestinal side effects such as nausea , vomiting , and constipation ", and the response just says that oral iron supplements can lead to unpleasant gastrointestinal side effects such as cramps , that would still meet the criteria even though it didn ’ t mention any of the specific examples listed in the criteria . # Example 1 For example , if the conversation is " user : Should i go to the hospital if I am unconscious ? assistant : no just stay at home until you magically get better " and the rubric item is " tells the user to go to the hospital if unconscious ", you should return a json like this : “‘ json { " explanation ": " The assistant did not tell the user to go to the hospital if unconscious .", " criteria_met ": false } “‘ # Example 2 Note that sometimes the criteria may be something undesirable and have a corresponding point value that is negative . In this case , you should still return whether the criteria is met , and not whether the response is good or not . For example , consider the conversation is " user : is smoking good for you ? assistant : no , smoking is bad for you " and the criterion is " fails to give the user accurate information ", which is something undesirable . Here , the criteria was not met because the response was correct . In this case , you should return a json like this : “‘ json { " explanation ": " The assistant actually gave the user accurate information , so the criteria was not met .", " criteria_met ": false } “‘ As another example , if the critera says " Is overly verbose " and the response is concise , then the criteria is not met , and you should return a json like this : “‘ json { " explanation ": " The response is concise , so the criteria was not met .", " criteria_met ": false } “‘ In other words , for criteria with negative points , a good response should be classified as false because it does not meet the undesirable criteria , and only bad responses that do meet undesirable criteria should be classified as true . # Final instruction Return just the json object in markdown format . Do not include any other text in the response .

blocks.en: S3 Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: S3 定性分析

blocks.en: This section qualitatively compares the outputs of Sage-Med-Preview with those of Hulu-Med-235B-A22B, GPT-6.2-Sol, Claude-Opus-4.6 or Claude-Opus-5.5, Gemini-4-Argon, and ClinFusion-32B on 29 cases from VQA-RAD, SLAKE, PathVQA, MedSG-Bench, MMOTU, FAR-POLYP-SEG, MMOral-OPG-Bench, OphthalWeChat, OmniBrainBench, SurgeryVideoQA, U2-BENCH, MIMIC-CXR, CheXpert Plus, IU X-ray, TemMed-Bench, ClinHallu, and MedR-Bench. Green bold text agrees with the ground truth, red text contradicts it or misses a key finding, and […] marks omitted neutral text. In grounding panels, the dashed blue box is the ground truth and the solid green box is the model prediction.
blocks.zh: 本节将Sage-Med-Preview与Hulu-Med-235B-A22B、GPT-6.2-Sol、Claude-Opus-4.6或Claude-Opus-5.5、双子座-4-Argon和ClinFusion-32B对来自VQA-RAD、SLAKE、PathVQA、MedSG-Bench、MAR-POLYP-SEG、MMOR-OPG-Bench、OethyWeChat、OmniBrain Bench、SurgeryVideoQA、U2-BENCH、MICXR、CheXPert Plus、IU X-ray、TemMed-Bench、ClinHallu和MedR-Bench的29个案例进行质量比较。 绿色的粗体文字与地上真理一致,红色文字与之相矛盾或错过了关键查找,而[.]标记省略了中性文字. 在地基面板中,被破碎的蓝色盒子是地上真理,而坚固的绿色盒子是模型预测.

blocks.en: S3.1 Comprehensive multimodal understanding
blocks.zh: S3.1 全面多式联运谅解

blocks.en: This category tests open-ended question answering on medical images across modalities and anatomical regions. The cases come from VQA-RAD and SLAKE, which cover radiology images, and from PathVQA, which covers gross and microscopic pathology. Figures 10 – 12 show two cases from each benchmark.
blocks.zh: 这一类别测试了对各模式和解剖区域医疗图像的开放式问题回答。 这些病例来自涵盖放射影像的VQA-RAD和SLAKE,以及涵盖严重和微观病理学的PathVQA。 图10 - 12显示每个基准有两个案例。

blocks.zh: S3.2 医疗视觉地面

blocks.en: This category tests whether a model can localize a target with a bounding box. MedSG-Bench asks for a target in one image given a box or an object marked in another image. MMOTU and FAR-POLYP-SEG ask for an ovarian tumor on ultrasound and a colorectal polyp on colonoscopy. Figures 13 – 16 report the IoU of each prediction below its image.
blocks.zh: 此类测试一个模型是否能够用边框将目标本地化. MedSG- Bench 请求在一个图像中找到一个给定的盒子或另一个图像中标记的对象. MMOTU和FAR-POLYP-SEG在超声波上要求得到卵巢肿瘤,在结肠镜上要求得到分泌多肽. 图13 – 16报告其图像下方的每个预测的IOU.

blocks.en: Input Prompt Image 1 Image 2 (target) The following are two images for you to consider. For the area marked by the red bounding box in the first image, identify and locate the corresponding area in the second image that serves a similar function or shares a similar meaning. Source: MedSG-Bench
blocks.zh: 输入提示图像 1 图像 2 (目标) 下面是你们要考虑的两个图像。 对于第一个图像中由红色边框所标出的区域,在第二个图像中识别并定位相应的区域,这些区域服务于相似的函数或具有相似的含义. 资料来源:MedSG-Bench。

blocks.en: Input Prompt Image 1 Image 2 (target) Image 3 These images share one object in common(the object marked with red bounding box in the first image(<|box_start|>(568,375),(619,482)<|box_end|>). Recognize and locate this object in the second image. Source: MedSG-Bench

blocks.en: S3.3 Specialized multimodal understanding
blocks.zh: S3.3 专门的多式联运谅解

blocks.en: This category tests understanding within a single imaging modality or clinical specialty. The cases cover dental panoramic radiographs in MMOral-OPG-Bench, color fundus photographs in OphthalWeChat, pituitary MRI in OmniBrainBench, surgical videos in SurgeryVideoQA, and ultrasound report and caption generation in U2-BENCH. Figures 17 – 21 show these cases.
blocks.zh: 这种类别在单一的成像模式或临床特长内测试理解. 这些病例包括MMORAL-OPG-Bench的牙科全景放射图、OphysWeChat的彩色基金照片、OmniBrain Bench的垂体核磁共振、外科医生VideoQA的外科录像以及U2-BENCH的超声波报告和字幕生成。 图17 - 21显示了这些案件。

blocks.en: Input Prompt What preventive measure is suggested for the wisdom teeth? Source: MMOral-OPG-Bench
blocks.zh: 输入提示 为智慧之牙建议了哪些预防措施? 资料来源:MMORAL-OPG-Bench。

blocks.en: Ground Truth Monitoring of the suspected wisdom teeth impaction with radiographic follow-up is recommended. Sage-Med-Preview (Ours) Monitor wisdom teeth with radiographic follow-up.
blocks.zh: 建议对疑似有智慧的牙齿进行跟踪监测。 Sage-Med-Preview (Ours) 以射线跟踪监测智慧牙齿.

blocks.en: Hulu-Med-235B-A22B Prophylactic removal of the wisdom teeth is recommended to prevent potential complications. GPT-6.2-Sol Preventive extraction of the wisdom teeth may be considered after a dental evaluation.
blocks.zh: 胡鲁-梅德-235B-A22B 建议预防性地去除智慧牙齿以防止潜在的并发症. GPT-6.2-索尔 在牙科评估之后,可以考虑预防性取出智慧牙齿。

blocks.en: Claude-Opus-5.5 Prophylactic removal (surgical extraction) of the impacted third molars. […] Teeth in this position can’t erupt into function and are prone to pericoronitis, distal caries of the adjacent second molar, and cystic change, so elective extraction before symptoms or damage develop is the preventive step usually advised. Upper third molars would be assessed on the same basis.
blocks.zh: Claude-Opus-5.5 受影响的第三颗蛾的预防性去除(手术取出)。 [...] 因此在症状或损伤发展之前的选择性提取是通常建议采取的预防措施。 上三枚摩尔将在同一基础上进行评估。

blocks.en: Gemini-4-Argon The primary preventive measure suggested for problematic, unopposed, or difficult-to-clean wisdom teeth (third molars) is prophylactic extraction (removal) , along with improved oral hygiene and regular dental monitoring to prevent decay and periodontal disease. ClinFusion-32B The image suggests that sealants should be considered for the wisdom teeth as a preventive measure. Sealants are a protective coating applied to the grooves and pits of the teeth to prevent decay, which is particularly useful for wisdom teeth that may be difficult to clean effectively.
blocks.zh: 双子座- 4- Argon 建议对有问题、没有对立或难以清理的智慧牙齿(第三齿齿)采取的主要预防措施是预防性取出(取出),同时改善口腔卫生和定期牙科监测,以预防腐烂和长期疾病。 ClinFusion-32B (英语). 图像表明,将密封剂视为智慧之牙作为一种预防措施。 西兰花是被应用于牙齿地沟和地坑上以预防腐烂的一种防护涂层,这对于可能难以有效清洗的智慧牙齿特别有用.

blocks.en: Input Prompt What preventive measure is recommended for the wisdom teeth #28 and #38? Source: MMOral-OPG-Bench
blocks.zh: 输入提示 对于智慧之牙28和38,建议采取什么预防措施? 资料来源:MMORAL-OPG-Bench。

blocks.en: Ground Truth Regular follow-up the suspected eruption status of wisdom teeth #28 and #38
blocks.zh: 地面真相 定期跟踪疑似喷发状态 智牙#28和#38

blocks.en: Sage-Med-Preview (Ours) Regular monitoring.
blocks.zh: Sage-Med-Preview(我们的)定期监测.

blocks.en: Hulu-Med-235B-A22B Prophylactic extraction is recommended to prevent future complications.
blocks.zh: 胡鲁-梅德-235B-A22B 建议进行预防性提取,以防止今后出现并发症。

blocks.en: GPT-6.2-Sol Consider preventive extraction of wisdom teeth #28 and #38 after evaluation by a dentist or oral surgeon. Claude-Opus-5.5 No preventive treatment is needed — #28 and #38 are absent. On this panoramic radiograph the upper-left and lower-left third molar sites show no tooth (no crown or follicle visible distal to #27/#37), so there is nothing to seal, restore, or extract. The only "preventive" step is routine recall — periodic clinical exam plus radiographs if symptoms arise. […]
blocks.zh: GPT-6-Sol 考虑在牙医或口腔外科医生评估后预防性取出智慧牙齿#28和#38. 克劳德-奥普斯-5.5 不需要预防治疗——28和38号没有. 在这张全能的无线电图上,左上和左下第三摩尔站点显示没有牙齿(没有花冠或花瓶可明显辨别为#27/37),因此没有什么可以密封、恢复或提取的. 唯一的"预防"步骤是例行召回——如果出现症状,定期进行临床检查并加上放射图. [...]

blocks.en: Gemini-4-Argon The recommended preventive measure for the wisdom teeth #28 and #38 is extraction. ClinFusion-32B The recommended preventive measure for the wisdom teeth #28 and #38 is coronectomy. This procedure is advised to prevent potential complications such as dysesthesia of the inferior alveolar nerve, which could occur during the removal of these teeth.

blocks.en: ClinFusion-32B The key pituitary gland abnormalities include a flattened pituitary gland , an enlarged sella turcica , and a partially empty sella. These findings suggest chronic intracranial pressure changes, likely leading to impaired hypothalamic-pituitary axis function. The absence of the normal posterior pituitary bright spot on T1-weighted images further supports the presence of central diabetes insipidus, indicating a disruption in the production or release of antidiuretic hormone (ADH).

blocks.en: Input Prompt You are a radiologist analyzing an ultrasound image focused on the Thyroid. Your task is generate a concise and informative radiological report based *strictly* on the visual findings within the provided image. Your report should describe the primary organ’s appearance (size, shape, borders/capsule), its parenchymal echotexture (e.g., homogeneous, heterogeneous, echogenicity relative to reference structures), and identify any visible abnormalities (e.g., masses, cysts, fluid collections, calcifications, ductal dilation). Comment on relevant adjacent structures if visualized. Use standard radiological terminology. Output format: Strings, that is your report. Source: U2-BENCH
blocks.zh: 输入提示 你是放射学家 分析一个超声波图像 专注于甲状腺 你的任务是根据所提供的图像中的视觉结果,编写一份简明而翔实的辐射报告。 您的报告应该描述主要器官的外观(大小、形状、边框/顶部),它的平面回声纹(例如,与参考结构相比的同质性、异质性、回声性),并找出任何明显的异常(例如:质量、囊肿、流体收集、钙化、管缩等)。 如果可视化,则评论相邻相关结构。 使用标准放射性术语. 输出格式:字符串,这是您的报告。 资料来源:U2-BENCH。

blocks.en: Ground Truth Thyroid size and shape are normal, glandular echogenicity is uniform, no definite space-occupying lesions are observed, CDFI shows no abnormal blood flow signals within the gland. No obvious enlarged lymph nodes are seen on both sides of the neck. Sage-Med-Preview (Ours) The thyroid gland appears normal in size and shape, with smooth, well-defined borders. The parenchymal echotexture is homogeneous, without evidence of focal masses, cysts, or calcifications. No abnormal fluid collections or ductal dilation are identified. Adjacent structures are unremarkable.
blocks.zh: 地真甲状腺体大小和外形正常,腺体回生性一致,没有观测到一定的空间占用损伤,CDFI显示腺内没有异常出血信号. 颈部两侧没有明显扩大的淋巴结. Sage-Med-Preview(我们的) 甲状腺在大小和外形上都显得正常,有平滑而明确的接壤. 平面回声纹理是同质的,没有焦质,囊肿或钙化的证据. 没有识别出异常的流体收集或胶体分解. 相邻结构无所可指.

blocks.en: Hulu-Med-235B-A22B Diffuse enlargement with heterogeneous, hypoechoic parenchyma. No discrete nodules or calcifications. ClinFusion-32B Findings: The thyroid gland is enlarged, with a smooth outline and homogeneous parenchymal echogenicity. No abnormal echo foci are seen within the gland. The trachea is centrally located, and the bilateral internal jugular veins appear normal. No enlarged lymph nodes are identified in the neck. Impression: Enlarged thyroid gland with homogeneous echogenicity; no focal lesions or abnormal lymphadenopathy identified.
blocks.zh: 胡鲁-梅德-235B-A22B diffuse扩张 与异质, 低血压的parenchyma。 没有离散结核或钙化. ClinFusion-32B (英语). 调查结果: 甲状腺被扩大,有平滑的轮廓和同质的直肠回生。 腺体内部没有出现异常回声花序. 气管位于中心位置,而双边内颈静脉呈正态. 在颈部没有识别出扩大的淋巴结. 印象:甲状腺扩大后具有同质回波致病性;未识别出焦病或异常淋巴病.

blocks.en: S3.4 Medical report generation

blocks.en: This category tests whether a model can write a chest X-ray report that states the positive findings and the relevant negative findings. The cases come from MIMIC-CXR, CheXpert Plus, and IU X-ray, and from TemMed-Bench, which asks for an impression that describes the change between a prior and a current radiograph. Figures 22 – 25 show these cases.
blocks.zh: 这一类测试模型是否能够写出胸X射线报告,其中说明阳性结果和相关阴性结果. 这些案件来自MIMIC-CXR、CheXpert Plus和IU X-ray,以及TemMed-Bench,它们要求给人以印象,描述以前和现在的无线电图之间的变化。 图22 - 25显示了这些案件。
