blocks.en: Ground Truth Findings: Patient is status post median sternotomy and CABG with multiple fractured sternotomy wires again demonstrated , better seen on the prior CT. Heart size remains mildly enlarged . Mediastinal and hilar contours are normal. Pulmonary vasculature is normal. No focal consolidation, pleural effusion or pneumothorax is identified. Biliary stent is seen within the upper abdomen on the lateral view. No acute osseous abnormalities present. Impression: No acute cardiopulmonary abnormality. Sage-Med-Preview (Ours) Findings: The patient is status post sternotomy. Several of the sternal wires are fractured, but appear unchanged. The heart is mildly enlarged. The mediastinal and hilar contours appear unchanged. There is no pleural effusion or pneumothorax. The lungs appear clear. A biliary stent projects over the right upper quadrant. Impression: No evidence of acute disease.
blocks.zh: 地面真知灼见:患者是胸切除和CABG的中位位置, 心脏体积仍然微乎其微。 中相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 肺脉虚而为常. 没有确定焦合,胸膜充血或肺炎。 在平面取景处的上腹部内可见有比利活性刺. 没有急性骨折异常 印象 : 没有急性心肺异常. Sage-Med-Preview(我们的)调查结果: 病人是胸切除后状态 有几根胸线断裂,但似乎没有改变。 心地稍有膨胀. 介质和hilar轮廓没有变化。 没有胸膜充血或肺炎。 肺气显清. 右上方四角上方的双层工程 印象 : 没有急性病的证据。

blocks.en: Hulu-Med-235B-A22B Findings: The patient is status post median sternotomy and CABG . The cardiac silhouette is mild to moderately enlarged . No focal consolidation is seen . There is no large pleural effusion or pneumothorax . No overt pulmonary edema is seen . Enlarged cardiac silhouette without overt pulmonary edema. No definite focal consolidation.
blocks.zh: 胡鲁-梅德-235B-A22B 调查结果: 病人处于中位子胸切除和CABG状态。 心平面呈温和至中度膨胀。 没有看到协调中心合并的情况。 没有大型胸膜充血或肺炎 不见有出露出肺水肿. 扩大心血管而无出露出肺水肿. 没有明确的协调整合。

blocks.en: GPT-6.2-Sol Findings: Mild enlargement of the cardiac silhouette with prior median sternotomy and coronary artery bypass grafting. Mild streaky bibasilar opacities, greater on the right, likely reflect atelectasis or scarring. No focal consolidation, pulmonary edema, pleural effusion, or pneumothorax. Impression: Mild cardiomegaly without pulmonary edema. Mild bibasilar atelectasis or scarring. Claude-Opus-4.6 […] The heart is enlarged […] There is opacification in the right lower lobe with air bronchograms, consistent with consolidation. There is blunting of the bilateral costophrenic angles, more prominent on the right, suggesting bilateral pleural effusions, right greater than left. […] the sternal wires are intact […] with intact sternal wires […] Cardiomegaly. 3. Right lower lobe consolidation […] Bilateral pleural effusions, right greater than left. […]
blocks.zh: GPT-6.2-索尔 检测结果:心肌收缩扩大,前中性胸切除和冠状动脉绕行. 右侧更明显 可能反射出异形或疤痕 无焦结,取肺水肿,取胸出血,或取肺出血. 印象:没有肺水肿而有心肌虚弱. 乳臭未干或有伤疤 克劳德-奥普斯-4.6[.] 心脏扩大[.] 右下叶有与合并一致的空气支气管相接的透明化. 双边成本偏差角度存在钝化现象,右上更突出,暗示了双边胸膜分泌,右上大于左. . . . . . . . . . . 心发心相. 3. 右下叶合并[.] 双边胸膜出血 右比左多 [...]

blocks.en: ClinFusion-32B Findings: The patient is status post median sternotomy. The cardiac silhouette is mildly enlarged and the aortic knob is calcified. There are diffuse reticular opacities seen in the bilateral lung fields suggestive of mild interstitial edema. […] Mild interstitial edema. No focal consolidation concerning for pneumonia is identified.
blocks.zh: ClinFusion-32B (英语). 调查结果: 病人是胸腔中位数的状态 心肌淤积会轻度膨胀,主动脉收缩会被钙化. 在双边肺部出现扩散性静脉不透明现象,显示出轻微的间质水肿。 [...] 密地间水肿. 未查明肺炎的集中情况。

blocks.en: Ground Truth The distal tip of a left-sided Mediport catheter projects over the left brachiocephalic vein […] Degenerative changes are seen within the thoracic spine. blocks.en: Ground Truth The lungs are hyperexpanded consistent with emphysema. The heart size and pulmonary vascularity appear within normal limits. No pneumothorax or pleural effusion is seen. Patchy airspace disease is present in the right middle lobe. Degenerative changes are present spine. 1. Hyperexpanded lungs suggesting emphysema. 2. Patchy right middle lobe airspace disease. May represent pneumonia. Followup examination is suggested following treatment to confirm clearing of the opacities. A 4 to 6 XXXX post treatment interval film would be reasonable to allow clearing of inflammatory opacities.
blocks.zh: 地面真相 肺部有与肺气肿相符合的超扩张. 心脏大小和肺血管在正常限度内出现. 不见肺炎或胸膜取血. 右中叶有补丁气相病. 变性变化是现在的脊椎. 1. 肺部扩张后出现肺气肿。 2. 右中叶空心病。 5月代表肺炎. 建议进行后续检查,以确认是否消除不透明。 4至6后处理间隔胶片是合理的,以便消除煽动性不透明。

There is a right middle lobe airspace opacity. There is no pleural effusion or pneumothorax. There are degenerative changes of the spine. Impression: Right middle lobe airspace opacity, concerning for pneumonia.

THERE IS A NEW RIGHT MIDDLE LOBE OPACITY CONSISTENT WITH PNEUMONIA. THERE IS ALSO A NEW LEFT LOWER LOBE OPACITY WHICH MAY REPRESENT ATELECTASIS VERSUS A SECOND SITE OF INFECTION. 2. blocks.en: Ground Truth 1. The left sided chest tube is unchanged in position. 2. There is a persistent, small left apical pneumothorax which does not appear significantly changed from the prior study. 3. The remainder of the chest is unchanged in appearance, with redemonstration of stranding opacities at the left base, which likely represents atelectasis . Sage-Med-Preview (Ours) 1. Left chest tube remains in place. 2. No significant change in left pneumothorax. 3. Persistent left lower lobe atelectasis.

blocks.en: Hulu-Med-235B-A22B Interval removal of left chest tube. No pneumothorax. Stable left subcutaneous emphysema. Stable cardiomediastinal silhouette. blocks.en: This category tests whether a model can reason over a whole clinical case and select a treatment. Both cases come from the OracleTreatment setting of MedR-Bench, which gives a text-only case summary with the final diagnosis and asks for a treatment plan. Figures 27 and 28 show these cases.

blocks.en: Input Prompt Please carefully study the following patient case summary, conduct a comprehensive and in-depth treatment planning analysis, and clearly provide the selected treatment for the patient. - Patient Demographics: 58-year-old male with cerebral palsy. - Chief Complaint: Enlarging tumor in the remnant pancreatic body. - History of Present Illness: - Underwent pancreatoduodenectomy (PD) with modified Child’s reconstruction for distal cholangiocarcinoma (T4N0M0) three years prior. - Diagnosed with a 12-mm pancreatic neuroendocrine neoplasm (PNEN G1), initially managed with lanreotide acetate, but eventual tumor growth to 19 mm prompted consideration for surgery. - Social background: Cerebral palsy with mental retardation and living alone, limiting his ability to manage insulin therapy. - Past Medical History: Cerebral palsy, diabetes mellitus. Previous PD for distal cholangiocarcinoma. […] - Social History: Living alone with limited ability due to mental retardation from cerebral palsy. […] - Lab Events: Perioperative amylase levels were monitored and were stable. - Imaging Events: - CT findings: 12-mm tumor in remnant pancreas, later enlarged to 19 mm. - Atrophic remnant pancreas with a volume of 7.6 mL preoperatively. - Final Diagnostic Results: Pancreatic neuroendocrine neoplasm (PNEN G1), confirmed via biopsy (Ki-67 index of 2.8%, mitosis <1/10 HPF). No metastasis was detected. Source: MedR-Bench
blocks.zh: 输入提示 请认真研究以下患者病情摘要,进行全面深入的治疗规划分析,明确为患者提供选定的治疗. - 患者人口统计: 58岁男性患有脑瘫痪. - 首席检举:在残留的胰脏中增加肿瘤。 - 目前疾病的历史: - 三年前,经过修改的Child重建了Distal Cholangiocarcinoma(T4N0M0)的胰腺内切除术。 - 诊断出12毫米胰腺神经内分泌肿瘤(PNEN G1),最初用环乙酸酐管理,但肿瘤最终会增长到19毫米,促使考虑进行手术。 - 社会背景: 脑性麻痹与智力迟钝并单独生活,限制了他管理胰岛素疗法的能力. - 过去医学史:脑瘫痪、糖尿病。 前任Distal Cholangiocarcinoma警局的警员 [.]- 社会史:因脑瘫痪而智力迟钝而独活,能力有限. [...] -- -- 实验室事件:对氨酰酶过敏水平进行监测并保持稳定。 - 图像事件: 残留胰腺中的12毫米肿瘤,后被扩大为19毫米. - 体积为7.6毫升的营养残留胰腺,手术前为7.6毫升。 - 最终诊断 结果:通过活检确认的胰腺神经内分泌肿瘤(PNEN G1)(Ki-67指数为2.8%,线粒体硬化<1/10HPF). 没有检测到元化物。 资料来源:MedR-Bench。

blocks.en: Ground Truth Perform a central pancreatectomy with resection of the pancreatic tumor and transection of the pancreatic tail without reconstruction of the remnant pancreas. Sage-Med-Preview (Ours) […] <step 5> Considering the above factors, a surgical approach that balances oncological safety with functional preservation is essential. A distal pancreatectomy with splenectomy (DP) would remove the tumor but could lead to significant loss of pancreatic function. A more conservative approach, such as a central pancreatectomy (CP), could potentially preserve more pancreatic tissue while still achieving complete resection. </step 5> […] Answer: Central pancreatectomy (CP)
blocks.zh: 地真进行中性胰腺切除术,进行胰腺瘤再分解并转出胰尾部而未重建出残存的胰腺. Sage-Med-Preview(我们的)[.] " 第5步 " 考虑到上述因素,必须采取一种将肿瘤安全与功能保存相平衡的外科手术方法。 带有子宫外切除术(DP)的分泌胰外切除术可以去除肿瘤,但可能导致胰腺功能的重大丧失. 更保守的方法,如中央胰外科切除术(CP),有可能保留更多的胰脏组织,同时仍然实现完全的分解. </第5步 > [.] 答复:中央胰外科

blocks.en: Hulu-Med-235B-A22B […] <step 2> Anatomical Considerations: The patient previously underwent a pancreatoduodenectomy (PD). The current tumor is located in the remnant pancreatic body. To achieve an R0 resection (complete removal of the tumor), the standard surgical approach is a distal pancreatectomy. Given the previous PD, removing the remnant body effectively results in a total pancreatectomy. […] <step 5> Formulating the Treatment Plan: The selected treatment is surgical resection. However, the plan must be comprehensive. It involves a distal pancreatectomy (resection of the remnant pancreas). Crucially, the perioperative and postoperative plan must address the diabetes. This includes securing a reliable caregiver or social support system to assist with insulin administration, as the patient cannot manage this independently. The small volume of the remnant pancreas (7.6 mL) suggests that Islet Autotransplantation (TPIAT) to preserve insulin function is likely not feasible due to insufficient tissue volume. Answer: Distal pancreatectomy (resection of the remnant pancreas) with a comprehensive post-operative plan for insulin management involving caregiver support.
blocks.zh: Hulu-Med-235B-A22B [.] <步骤2>解剖考虑: 患者之前曾接受过胰腺通心术(PD). 目前的肿瘤位于残留的胰腺体. 为了实现R0再分解(完全去除肿瘤),标准的外科手术方法是一种Distal胰腺切除术. 鉴于之前的PD,去除残存的躯体有效导致全胰腺切除. [.] < 第5步 > 制定治疗计划: 选定的治疗是外科手术分解。 然而,该计划必须是全面的。 它涉及到分解性胰腺切除(残留胰腺分解). 至关重要的是,术后和术后计划必须解决糖尿病问题。 这包括确保可靠的护理者或社会支助系统,以协助胰岛素的服用,因为病人无法独立管理。 残留的胰腺体积小(7.6毫升)表明,由于组织体积不足,维持胰岛素功能的岛式自转(TPIAT)可能不可行. 答:分泌性胰腺切除术(残留胰腺分泌术),有包括护理者支持在内的胰岛素管理综合手术后计划.

blocks.en: GPT-6.2-Sol […] Enucleation is appropriate only if the tumor can be separated safely from the main pancreatic duct and the existing pancreaticojejunostomy. Answer: Parenchyma-sparing resection of the remnant pancreatic body tumor, preferably by enucleation if anatomically feasible. ClinFusion-32B […] A distal pancreatectomy with splenectomy is a viable option to remove the tumor while preserving as much pancreatic function as possible. This procedure would also allow for the removal of the spleen, which can be beneficial in reducing the risk of postoperative complications and improving the patient’s overall prognosis. […] Overall, the distal pancreatectomy with splenectomy is a well-considered treatment plan that addresses the tumor’s progression and the patient’s unique medical and social circumstances.</step> Answer: Distal pancreatectomy with splenectomy using a surgical stapler for the pancreatic stump.

blocks.en: Input Prompt Please carefully study the following patient case summary, conduct a comprehensive and in-depth treatment planning analysis, and clearly provide the selected treatment for the patient. - Patient Demographics: 18-year-old female - Chief Complaint: Severe right-sided headache associated with neurological symptoms including right eye pain, paresthesia in the right hemiface, photophobia, left hemiparesis, and generalized tonic-clonic seizure. - History of Present Illness: Symptoms began at age 16 with a pulsatile headache (5/10 intensity), which worsened to severe intensity (10/10) during physical exertion. Associated symptoms included right eye pain, facial weakness, vomiting, dizziness, and tonic-clonic seizure followed by postictal drowsiness. Neurological deficits (left hemiparesis and right-sided facial asymmetry) persisted. She was prescribed acetylsalicylic acid (ASA) and antiepileptic prophylaxis during her hospital stay. - Past Medical History: Born prematurely by cesarean section at 36 weeks due to premature rupture of membranes, requiring 5 days of neonatal intensive care. No other significant medical history. […] - Physical Exam: Alert and oriented. Neurological findings include right-sided labial commissure deviation, effacement of the left nasolabial fold, left-arm plegia, left-leg paresis (3/5 strength), left Babinski sign, and central facial paralysis without aphasia, agnosia, or apraxia. - Lab Events: Workup suggested an autoimmune etiology as a possible cause of the event. - Imaging Events: Cerebral angiography showed a 20x24 mm dissecting aneurysm in the M1 segment of the right middle cerebral artery with an undefined neck and poor collateral circulation. - Final Diagnostic Results: Diagnosed with a dissecting aneurysm in the M1 segment of the right middle cerebral artery, associated with high rupture risk and vascular wall damage. Source: MedR-Bench
blocks.zh: 输入提示 请认真研究以下患者病情摘要,进行全面深入的治疗规划分析,明确为患者提供选定的治疗. - 患者人口统计: 18岁女性-首席申诉: 严重的右侧头痛与神经症状有关,包括右眼疼痛,右外脸有截肢,有光恐惧症,左侧肝发作,以及通肠-结膜普遍癫痫. - 目前疾病的历史:症状始于16岁时,脉搏头痛(5/10发),在身体锻炼期间恶化为严重(10/10发)。 相关的症状包括右眼疼痛,面部虚弱,呕吐,眩晕等,以及通心粉发作后发作后发作后发作. 神经缺血症(左肝病和右侧面部不对称)持续存在. 在住院期间,她被开出乙酰甲酰乙酸和抗败血症的处方。 - 过去医学史:由于膜过早破裂,在36周内由剖腹产,需要5天新生儿特别护理。 没有其他重要的医疗记录。 [...]-物理考试:警报并定向. 神经学的发现包括:右侧的阴唇杂交偏差,左侧的纳索拉比折叠被擦去,左臂平起子,左腿平起子(3/5强度),左巴宾斯基标志,以及中央面部瘫痪而无麻痹,不可知论,或无出子. - 实验室事件:Workingup建议一种自体免疫病理作为事件可能的原因。 - 成像事件:脑血管造影显示右中脑动脉的M1段有20x24毫米分解动脉瘤,颈部未定和附属环流差. - 最终诊断 结果: 诊断出右中脑动脉的M1段有分解动脉瘤,与高破裂风险和血管壁损伤有关. 资料来源:MedR-Bench。

blocks.en: Ground Truth Perform endovascular treatment with flow-diverting stents and platinum coils to reconstruct the dissecting aneurysm of the M1 segment and preserve distal circulation. Sage-Med-Preview (Ours) […] <step 5> The recommended treatment for this patient is endovascular treatment with a flow diverter. This approach is suitable for the large, dissecting aneurysm with an undefined neck and poor collateral circulation. The flow diverter will help to redirect blood flow away from the aneurysm, promoting thrombosis and reducing the risk of rupture. </step 5> Answer: Endovascular treatment with a flow diverter.
blocks.zh: 地真进行内分血管治疗,用流道分泌活塞和白金圈来重建M1分泌的动脉瘤并保存分泌. Sage-Med-Preview (Ours) [.] < step 5> 这名患者的推荐治疗是使用流转器进行内血管治疗. 这种方法适合大而分解的动脉瘤有未定义的颈部和不良的附带环流. 流动分流器将有助于将血液流出动脉瘤,促进血栓化并降低破裂风险。 </step 5> 答:用流转器进行内血管治疗.

blocks.en: Hulu-Med-235B-A22B […] <step 3> Endovascular treatments like coiling are difficult due to the "undefined neck" and the dissecting nature of the aneurysm. Flow diversion is risky in the MCA due to high flow rates and the potential for thrombosis, especially given the poor collaterals. […] <step 5> Therefore, the most appropriate treatment is an extracranial-intracranial (EC-IC) bypass, specifically a superficial temporal artery (STA) to MCA bypass. This procedure reroutes blood flow to the brain tissue distal to the aneurysm. Once the bypass is functioning, the diseased M1 segment containing the aneurysm can be safely trapped or resected without causing ischemia. Answer: Extracranial-intracranial (EC-IC) bypass (specifically STA-MCA bypass) followed by trapping or resection of the aneurysm. GPT-6.2-Sol […] Answer: Urgent microsurgical MCA bypass followed by trapping of the dissecting right M1 aneurysm, provided angiographic review confirms that critical perforators can be preserved. ClinFusion-32B […] <step 7> Considering the patient’s age, the size of the aneurysm, and the high risk of rupture, endovascular coiling is a less invasive option that can be performed with a high degree of precision. This approach aims to occlude the aneurysm and prevent rupture while preserving blood flow through the MCA. Answer: Endovascular coiling of the dissecting aneurysm in the M1 segment of the right middle cerebral artery.
blocks.zh: Hulu-Med-235B-A22B [.] <step 3>外出血管治疗如卷曲,由于"未定义的颈部"和动脉瘤的解剖性质而困难. 流动转移在MCA中具有风险,因为流动率高并有可能出现血栓,特别是考虑到抵押品差。 [.] " 第5步 " 因此,最适当的治疗是外-内-外(EC-IC)绕行,具体来说是表面的时动脉(STA)到MCA绕行. 这种程序使血液流向脑组织分解为动脉瘤. 一旦绕道正常运行,含有动脉瘤的已发病的M1段可以安全地被困入或重新分解而不会引起异血症. 答:外接-内接(EC-IC)绕道(具体为STA-MCA绕道),再接入或分解出动脉瘤. GPT-6.2-Sol [.] 答:紧急微外科MCA绕行,再对解剖右侧M1动脉瘤进行陷阱,但血管学审查确认,可保留临界穿孔器。 ClinFusion-32B [.] < step 7> 考虑到患者的年龄,动脉瘤的大小,以及破裂的高度风险,内分泌血管接合是一种侵入性较低的选择,可以高度精确地进行. 这种方法旨在避免动脉瘤并预防破裂,同时通过MCA保持血液流动。 答:右中脑动脉M1部分解出动脉瘤的内出血管相接.

blocks.en: S4 Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: S4 道德操守声明

blocks.en: Ethical approval for the clinical studies underlying the evaluation benchmarks was obtained from the relevant ethics committees or institutional review boards of Alfred Hospital (Melanoma; approval no. 349/23); the Central Hospital of Guangdong Provincial Nongken (Nasopharyngeal carcinoma); Ruijin Hospital, Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine (Orthopedic admission; approval no. 2025-42); Shenzhen People’s Hospital (Surgical attention; approval no. LL-KY-2024170-01); the Department of Otolaryngology-Head and Neck Surgery, Shenzhen University General Hospital (Ear disease; approval no. KYLLMS-2025-25); the First Affiliated Hospital of Wenzhou Medical University (Lung cancer; approval no. KY2024-R173); Beijing Tiantan Hospital, Capital Medical University (Intracranial tumor; approval no. KY2024-380-02); Shanghai Ninth People’s Hospital, Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine (Intraoral; approval no. SH9H-2026-T222-1); and Shanghai Chest Hospital (Endoscopic location; approval no. KS(Y)21328). The Pneumonia study was approved by the Biomedical Ethics Committee of Huashan Hospital, Fudan University (approval no. [2024] Clinical Review (1440)). The Fundus benchmark was obtained from the ethics-approved Beijing Tongren Eye Disease Clinical Database Biobank (approval no. TRECKY2018-056-GZ (2022)-07). The Lung diagnosis and progression benchmark was derived from the MASS cohort, a prospective multicenter study approved by the Ethics Committee of the First Affiliated Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine (approval nos. IIT20230371B and IIT20230183B-R1), and the ethics committees of other participating hospitals, and registered on ClinicalTrials.gov (NCT06114784). The Alfred Hospital Human Research Ethics Committee provided primary oversight of the international multisite melanoma study, with participating sites following their institutional policies and applicable ethical and regulatory requirements. The nasopharyngeal carcinoma study was registered with the Chinese Clinical Trial Registry (ChiCTR2400080515). Informed consent was waived for the retrospective melanoma, nasopharyngeal carcinoma and intracranial tumor studies; for melanoma, research consent had previously been obtained where applicable. For fundus data, informed consent was obtained or waived by the ethics committee for retrospective use of fully anonymized data. Written informed consent was obtained before data collection for the surgical attention, ear disease and intraoral studies from participants or their legal guardians, as applicable. The approved consent forms for these three studies and the lung cancer study authorized scientific research and academic publication using de-identified clinical data, with the lung cancer consent forms also covering clinical testing. Enrollment in the MASS cohort required signed informed consent from patients, with next of kin signing on behalf of unconscious patients. The melanoma, fundus, surgical attention, ear disease, lung cancer, intracranial tumor and intraoral studies followed the Declaration of Helsinki, and their data were de-identified or anonymized before use. For melanoma, interinstitutional data sharing complied with institutional agreements and applicable data protection regulations, and access was restricted to authorized personnel. Ethics approval was not required for the PET/CT benchmark.
